cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests0.descrip: To begin your journey as an Ars Novice, you must first obtain the &bWorn Notebook&r. This can be found in your &bAkashic Tome&r, by right clicking and choosing the right book.
To return your Akashic Tome to its base state, &ahold it and left click&r while &atargeting the air&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests1.descrip: To obtain the &bNovice Spell Book&r, you must &6remove the Worn Notebook&r and craft it with &bGold&r in a &bCrafting Table&r.

To retrieve your &bWorn Notebook&r from your &bAkashic Tome&r, &6select the Worn Notebook in the tome&r, then &6crouch and throw the book&r. This will eject the Worn Notebook so you can craft with it.
The name will look funny. That's normal, you can craft with it just fine.
Once you have your &bNovice Spell Book&r, you can &6hold it and press c&r to access the interface.
The top tab is &athe worn notebook, a reference guide for the mod&r. The next tab lets you &abuild and save spells&r. We'll address the rest later.
Note that &dwhile holding your book, you cannot use the ` key&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests1.title: Obtain a Novice Spell Book
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests2.descrip: To make a spell, you must choose the &aForm&r (touch, self, or projectile) and the &aEffect&r (harm or break). These are called &bGlyphs&r, and you'll unlock more as you go.

For example, you could &6choose Projectile and Break&r to have a remote way of breaking blocks. Input the &aspell name&r in the bottom left, and click &dCreate&r in the bottom right. It will save to your &afirst spell slot&r (the 10 tabs on the right are your &aSpell Slots&r.
&6Cast your spells&r by holding your Spellbook in your main or offhand, and right click. &aSelect your spells with v&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests2.subtitl: Tick the box when you're ready
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests3.descrip: You can &aupgrade your spell book&r in order to &alearn higher tiers of glyphs&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests4.descrip: The ultimate spell book! Become an &aArchmage&r and learn Tier 3 Glyphs!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests5.descrip: Your next step is to obtain &bArchwood&r of some type. These trees are found somewhat rarely in many biomes.
From the Archwood, you can craft the &bAmethyst Dowsing Rod&r, which will help you find &bAmethyst Geodes&r. This is an important magical material, so collect lots of it!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests5.subtitl: A rare tree and a rare gem
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests5.title: Obtain Archwood and Make an Amethyst Dowsing Rod
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests6.descrip: Magic such as &aImbuement&r requires &dSource&r, a force which flows through all living things. You may craft a &bSourcelink&r to collect it, and a &bSource Jar&r to contain it,

But where does Source come from? The natural world. One way you can obtain it is via an &bAgronomic Sourcelink&r. &6Place your Sourcelink and Jar within 6 blocks&r of your livestock or garden, and it will slowly collect. &dBonemealed crops will not contribute to Source production&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests6.subtitl: A place to keep the universe's energy
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests6.title: Obtaining Source
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests7.descrip: The &bImbuement Chamber&r is how you can create &bSource Gems&r. Simply &6place an Amethyst or Lapis&r inside the Chamber and wait for it to slowly transform.
This can be sped up later by &agiving it access to Source&r, such as that contained in a &bSource Jar&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests7.title: Make an Imbuement Chamber
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests8.descrip: Craft a &bScribe's Table&r to take your next steps. The Scribe's Table is where you will do your &amagical crafting&r and acquire new Glyphs!
To see the new Glyphs, &6right click on the Table with your Spellbook&r. You can use the tabs on the right to &asort by tier&r. Find the Glyph you'd like to craft and select it.
Once a Glyph is selected, gather the items and &6throw them onto the table&r. The floating item will disappear when it is accepted by the table.
You may need &asome unique items called Essences&r. These are crafted on the &bImbuement Chamber&r and will require the use of &bPedestals&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests8.subtitl: I would explain it to you but that would de-scribe it
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests8.title: Obtain a Scribe's Table
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests9.descrip: &bSpell Parchment&r is a way for you to store a spell on paper. They are &asingle-use&r, and can be printed at the &bScribe's Table&r.
First, make a &bBlank Parchment&r with Paper and &bMagebloom Fiber&r. Then, combine that with &bSource Gems&r to create the final product.

Once you have placed your Scroll on the Scribe's Table, &dset your desired spell in your Spellbook&r and then &6shift right click your Spellbook on the Table&r. This will inscribe the spell onto the Parchment for you!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests9.title: Make a Spell Parchment
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests10.descri: Craft an &bArcane Pedestal&r in a Crafting Bench using &bSourcestone&r.
These Pedestals need to be placed surrounding the &bImbuement Chamber&r or &bEnchanting Apparatus&r. You can do either a + pattern or an x pattern. Both are valid.
&6Use JEI to find the recipe&r for each Glyph. Only the Source Gem is consumed, so don't worry about using expensive reagents.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests10.title: Make some Arcane Pedestals
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests11.descri: &bSourcestone&r is a material used in magical crafting recipes. It can be created at a basic &bCrafting Table&r, by surrounding a &bSource Gem&r with &bany kind of Stone&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests11.subtit: It's also a lovely decorative block
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests11.title: Obtain Some Sourcestone
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests12.descri: For starters, let's make the &bHarvest Glyph&r. As you can see in &lJEI&r, it requires an &bIron Hoe&r and an &bEarth Essence&r.

To make the Earth Essence, you'll need to have your &aArcane Pedestals set up around your Imbuement Chamber&r. You will need &bDirt, Seeds, and an Iron Ingot&r. &6Right click each reagent on a pedestal&r (the order doesn't matter). Once they're in place, put a &bSource Gem&r into the Imbuement Chamber.
If you have done everything correctly, it will begin crafting! It may go slowly unless there is a &bfilled Source Jar&r within 6 blocks.
Once it's done, pull it from the Chamber and &6throw both items&r onto your Scribe's Table. Then, grab your finished &bGlyph&r and &6right click while holding it&r to unlock the knowledge!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests12.title: Making a Glyph
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests13.descri: To move forward, you'll want an &bEnchanting Apparatus&r, which requires an &bArcane Core&r beneath it, and &bPedestals&r surrounding it.
You can either bury the Arcane Core and place everything on floor-level, or you can place the Core on floor level and raise the Pedestals up.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests13.subtit: A more mystical method of crafting
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests14.descri: &bMagebloom&r is an intensely magical plant which cannot be found naturally. You must create it using an &bEnchanting Apparatus&r. It requires &bSource Gems&r and &bSeeds&r.
&6Place the Source Gems&r on 4 of the Pedestals (order doesn't matter), and then &6place the Seeds in the Apparatus&r.
Magebloom is used in many recipes, but is especially valued for its &bFiber&r, from which &amana-infused clothing, and spell parchments&r can be made.
&dDon't forget to read your Spellbook's documentation in the top left tab!&r It has more information than these quests do.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests14.title: Craft a Magebloom Seed to get Fiber
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests15.descri: Use your newly-acquired &bMagebloom Fiber&r to craft yourself a set of &bNovice Robes&r, which will &aincrease the amount of mana&r you have access to.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests15.subtit: Unlike Witches, Mages do wear pants.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests15.title: Obtain Novice Robes
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests16.descri: The &bPotion Jar&r can hold up to 100 doses of a single potion.
You can use it to refill your &bPotion Flask&r, which is a container able to hold up to 8 doses of the same potion type.
There are two variants of the Potion Flask: &aExtend Time&r and &aAmplify&r. I think you can guess what each does.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests16.subtit: The Potion Jar, Melder, and Flasks
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests16.title: New Potion Options
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests17.descri: The &bPotion Melder&r allows you to &amix the effects of two or more potions&r. It draws from &bPotion Jars&r which surround it on either side, and when &6provided with Source&r, outputs to a Jar beneath it.
Only two Potion Jars can be used at a time, however, you can &6fill one Jar with a Melded Potion&r to add even more effects to it.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests17.subtit: Combine multiple effects into a single bottle!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests17.title: Potion Melding
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests18.descri: This armor grants additional &aMana&r over the basic set.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests18.title: Obtain Mage Armor
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests19.descri: The highest tier armor, this &bArchmage set&r is almost as good as &bNetherite&r, with hefty bonuses to &amana&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests19.title: Obtain Archmage Armor
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests20.descri: The &bCasting Wand&r is an item which you can assign a single spell to. It will automatically have the form &aProjectile&r and the Glyph of &aAccelerate&r.
&6Place it on your Scribe's Table&r and then create the desired spell in your Book. You can then &6shift right click&r on the Table with your Spellbook to write the spell to the wand.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests21.descri: In order to make magical accessories, you must make their mundane counterparts!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests21.subtit: Are you a little bit curio-us?
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests21.title: Time to Accessorize
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests22.descri: Despite the worrisome name, this Curio is all positive! The &bBelt of Unstable Gifts&r will &agrant you random positive potion effects&r periodically.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests23.descri: Unfortunately, this won't get you better deals with villagers. The &bRings of Discount&r (lesser and greater) make your spells cost less mana!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests24.descri: The &bFocus of Summoning&r allows your summoned companions to last longer.
It also &adamages nearby enemies&r which try to attack them, and &acauses the \"self\" form to count them&r as well as the player.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests25.descri: To move on, you'll need a &bRitual Brazier&r, which accepts various &bRitual Tablets&r in order to work.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests26.descri: These two &bJars&r each have a unique effect.

The &bJar of Voiding&r will delete specified items upon pickup, in exchange for mana. Helpful to get rid of extra Cobblestone! &6Shift click&r to toggle it on or off. To add an item to the void list, &6hold that item in your offhand and right click&r with the Jar.
The &bJar of Light&r summons a light source to follow the player, which can be dismissed at any time. &6Right click&r to toggle this summon.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests26.title: Special Jars
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests27.descri: The &eWeald Walkers&r are Archtrees which have been awoken. In order to perform this Ritual, &6place the brazier near an Archwood tree&r and &6right click&r it with the Tablet. &6Right click&r the Brazier to get started.
Once the &eWeald Walker&r is ambling about, &6right click it&r with the &bDominion Wand&r, and then right click it on the block you want as the Walker's &ahome&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests27.title: Ritual of Awakening
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests28.descri: In order to perform a &aRitual&r, you'll need a &bTablet&r for the Ritual you want to perform. You can check your &aspell book documentation&r to find out what each ritual does.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests28.subtit: You know I wanna get ritual, ritual
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests28.title: Craft a Ritual Tablet
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests29.descri: In order to make certain items, you'll need to defeat the boss, &eThe Wilden Chimera&r. This does not spawn naturally, and must be summoned via &aRitual&r.
It's suggested to be using tier 2 armor and spells before engaging this boss.
To summon him, you'll need to find a &eWilden Hunter&r, &eWilden Guardian&r, and &eWilden Stalker&r, and obtain their &btrophies&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests29.subtit: To become an Archmage, you must fight
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests29.title: Summon the Wilden Chimera
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests30.descri: &eFamiliars&r are small creatures who help you with your magical duties. These differ from &eCrows&r in both how you meet them, and what they can do.

Firstly, you must obtain the &bCharm&r of each Familiar. This is done differently depending on which one you're trying to summon. But you will need to &6activate their Charm&r before beginning the Ritual.

You must &6place a Ritual Brazier&r nearby the Familiar and &6put the &bTablet of Binding&6 on it&r. Then &6right click&r the Brazier. It will ensnare the &eFamiliar&r and produce a &bBound Script&r, which you can then &6right click&r to learn - from then on, that Familiar may be summoned from the &athird tab in your spellbook&r!
Read on for more information about each Familiar, both in Familiar mode and out.
You can dismiss your summoned Familiar with a &aDispel&r Spell. Break the blocks they came from to &aget back their Charm&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests30.title: Obtaining New Familiars
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests31.descri: &bStarbuncles&r are small, squirrel-like creatures which love &bGold Nuggets&r. Find a wild Starbuncle and toss them one to receive a &bStarbuncle Shard&r in return, which is used to craft its &bCharm.&r You can simply &6right click the charm on the ground&r to summon its tame counterpart.
When following you, the &eStarbuncle&r will grant you &aSpeed II&r and, when fed Gold Nuggets, it will give you the ability to &asee gold veins through blocks&r.
The &eStarbuncle&r is capable of &aitem transport&r. Use a &bDominion Wand&r to assign it to certain inventories. It will also &aharvest fully-grown &bSource Berries&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests32.descri: The &eWhirlisprig&r looks like an unripe tomato helicopter. Once you locate a wild one, &6grow a tree near it&r in order to receive its &bShards&r, used to make its &bCharm&r! You can then &6right click the charm&r on any small flower to summon one.
While in Familiar mode, they &areduce the cost of earth spells&r by half. Food you eat will also grant you more saturation.
The &eWhirlisprig&r, when bound to its flower, will &aduplicate nearby &borganic items&r - trees, flowers, etc. They need to be provided with a chest and &bSource&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests33.descri: The &eDrygmy&r is a small gnome-like creature with antlers, and can be found in the wild. In exchange for a &bWilden Horn&r dropped at its feet, it will give you a &bDrygmy Shard&r, which can be used to create its &bCharm&r. &6Right click the Charm on &bMossy Cobblestone&r.
When it is following you, it increases your Earth spell damage, and boosts &aLooting&r.

Multiple &eDrygmy&r can be assigned to a single &bHenge&r, and these creatures will &aharvest drops and experience gems&r from &eLivestock&r in a 10 block radius, without harming them! After it harvests, it will place items in a nearby inventory, and must recharge its ability &awith Source&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests34.descri: The &eBookwyrm&r is a small flying creature that resembles a wyvern, with book pages for wings. You can summon it using a &bBookwyrm Charm&r (made with &bIron&r and &bSource Gems&r and &ba book&r), which you &6shift right click on a &bLectern&r. After the Lectern finishes drawing magic to itself, the Bookwyrm will appear!
When following you, the &eBookwyrm&r &adecreases your spell cost and increases your spell damage&r.

When it is simply bound to a Lectern, it will &acast spells on the surrounding area&r, based on what &bParchment Scrolls&r you give it. It can be &adyed&r for color-coding purposes. To cast spells, there must be a filled &bSource Jar&r nearby.
This &ditem is under construction&r and so the quest is temporarily a &acheckmark&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests34.subtit: Take a look, it's in a book
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests35.descri: The &bWixie&r's &bShards&r are obtained by using the &aDispel&r effect on a &aWitch&r when they're under half health. Once you craft the &bCharm&r, you can &6right click it on a &bCauldron&r to summon the &aWixie&r.
Wixies will &aincrease the duration of consumed potions&r while they are following you. They will also &aapply negative potion effects on enemies&r.
When a Wixie is bound to a Cauldron, it will &aautomatically craft an item or potion&r it is told to. It will draw from nearby inventories, and can be paused if it receives a redstone signal.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests36.descri: &bSpell Turrets&r can cast &aTouch&r and &aProjectile&r spells when provided with &bParchment Scrolls&r, &bSource&r, and a redstone signal.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests37.descri: There is much more that this mod has to offer! &bRunes&r, &bEnchanter's Weapons&r, &bSource Relays&r and more! Check out the documentation in your &bSpell Book&r to help you learn even more!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests38.descri: The &bAmethyst Golem&r can be summoned by using the &6Ritual of Awakening&r on some &bBudding Amethyst&r.
&6Right click&r the shard on a block to summon the &eGolem&r, and then &6set its home block&r with your &bDominion Wand&r.

&eAmethyst Golems&r will convert Amethyst into &bBudding Amethyst&r, speed up &aamethyst growth&r, and will also &aharvest amethyst clusters&r, so long as their home block is an inventory such as a chest or barrel.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests39.descri: &eSirens&r can be found rarely in &aOcean Biomes&r, and you can obtain their &bShards&r by giving them a &bSea Pickle&r, their favorite snack!
Use the &bSiren Charm&r on a piece of Prismarine to summon it. &eSirens&r will change color if given &bkelp&r or &bcorals&r.

The &bSiren Shrine&r will generate &afishing loot&r, as long as it is provided with &bSource&r. The &eSirens&r will produce faster if they have lots of aquatic plants and animals to keep them company!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests40.descri: Unlike the other &bCharms&r, the &eFlarecannon&r's does not require &bShards&r, and can be simply crafted.
The &eFlarecannon&r will &adefend its territory&r much like the &eWeald Walkers&r, by firing homing projectiles at enemies.
You can give them &bSoul Sand&r or &bMagma Blocks&r to change their appearance.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests41.descri: Each type of &aArchwood Tree&r bears its own &bfruit&r! You can find it &agrowing from the tree like Cocoa Beans&r.
The &bBastion Fruit&r comes from the &aVexing Archwood&r Tree. When consumed, it will grant you &aShielding&r, a form of &aResistance&r.
The &bFrostaya&r comes from the &aCascading Archwood&r Tree. When consumed, it will &abegin to freeze you&r.
The &bMendosteen&r comes from the &aFlourishing Archwood&r Tree. It grants the &aRecovery&r effect, which increases healing you receive from health items.
The &bBombegranate&r comes from the &aBlazing Archwood&r Tree. &dIts effects are unknown&r, as the journal from which I got this information ends at this entry.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests41.title: Fruitful Labors
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests42.descri: The &bVitalic Sourcelink&r generates source when it is around &eAnimals&r. When animals &abreed, grow up, or die&r, it will generate source.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests43.descri: The &bMycelial Sourcelink&r generates &aSource&r from &afood items&r. Provide it with delicious delectables and it will provide you with magic!
It will also &agenerate mushrooms&r and &bMycelium&r in the surrounding area.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests44.descri: The &bVolcanic Sourcelink&r produces Source when provided with &bHeat&r. They will &dmelt blocks around them&r and will also cause &bLava Lilies&r to spawn.
Change the color of your &bLava Lily&r by placing it over Lava or Magma.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests45.descri: The &bAlchemical Sourcelink&r generates source when provided with &bPotions&r. The more complex the potion, the more Source is produced.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests46.descri: Gift a &eWild Starbuncle&r a &bGold Nugget&r and see what happens!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests47.descri: Although charming, &eStarbuncles&r are not the hardiest creatures, and it can be a pain to reinstruct them should something unpleasant happen to them.
Thankfully, the &bScroll of Save Starbuncle&r will &apreserve all their settings&r. Just be sure to &6right click the scroll&r on your Starby after you've finished setting them up!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests48.descri: There are so many options for &bmagely gear&r... How can you choose? Well, you may not have to!
The &bWizard's Armarium&r is a &aBelt curio&r which can contain up to &athree sets of armor&r and even &ahotbar items&r for you to swap on the fly.
By default, you'll &6press 0&r to bring up a radial wheel of armor sets. But &dfirst you need to load the Armarium&r with gear.

To begin, &6equip your robes and set up your hotbar&r. Then, open the radial and &6select the slot&r to save them to. Open your radial again, and &6switch to a different slot&r. Equip your second set of armor and then &6repeat the previous&r steps until all 3 slots are filled. Now, you can &aeasily swap between them&r using the radial.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests48.title: Multiple Sets At Once
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests49.descri: Equip your &eStarbuncles&r with a &bStarbucket&r to allow them to &atransport fluid back and forth&r. You may wish to store the fluid in a &bFluid Containment Jar&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests49.title: Starbuncles Carry Liquid!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests50.descri: The &eStarbuncles&r are capable of taking lessons from &eBookwyrms&r using the &bWyrm Degree&r. Now that they're much smarter, they can &aoperate on only certain sides of their blocks&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests51.descri: The &bStarbin&r will allow your &aStarbuncle&r to &adelete items it picks up&r. Be sure to set a filter first!
You can set a filter by &6preparing an Allow/Deny Scroll&r and &6clicking your Starbuncle&r with it.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests52.descri: Although it lacks polish, the &bStarddle&r allows you to do what the best of us have only dreamed of: &ariding a giant Starbuncle&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests53.descri: A &bCasting Crystal&r is an item which can have a &aspell bound to it&r, and then you can &6equip it as a Curio&r, and access its spell via a hotkey.
You can &awear up to three&r of these, and by default they are accessible with &6CTRL+1-3&r.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests55.descri: Did you know that &eUndead&r are susceptible to &aSpores&r and &aGrow&r spells? You should test it out sometime.
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.quests56.descri: &bSkyweave&r is an item which &amimics the look of the sky&r, so you can see sunlight even when underground!
cottagewitch.ars_nouveau.title: Wired's Ars Redux
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests0.descrip: To begin your journey as an Ars Novice, you must first obtain the &bWorn Notebook&r. This can be found in your &bAkashic Tome&r, by right clicking and choosing the right book.
To return your Akashic Tome to its base state, &ahold it and left click&r while &atargeting the air&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests1.descrip: To obtain the &bNovice Spell Book&r, you must &6remove the Worn Notebook&r and craft it with &bGold&r in a &bCrafting Table&r.

To retrieve your &bWorn Notebook&r from your &bAkashic Tome&r, &6select the Worn Notebook in the tome&r, then &6crouch and throw the book&r. This will eject the Worn Notebook so you can craft with it.
The name will look funny. That's normal, you can craft with it just fine.
Once you have your &bNovice Spell Book&r, you can &6hold it and press c&r to access the interface.
The top tab is &athe worn notebook, a reference guide for the mod&r. The next tab lets you &abuild and save spells&r. We'll address the rest later.
Note that &dwhile holding your book, you cannot use the ` key&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests1.title: Obtain a Novice Spell Book
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests2.descrip: To make a spell, you must choose the &aForm&r (touch, self, or projectile) and the &aEffect&r (harm or break). These are called &bGlyphs&r, and you'll unlock more as you go.

For example, you could &6choose Projectile and Break&r to have a remote way of breaking blocks. Input the &aspell name&r in the bottom left, and click &dCreate&r in the bottom right. It will save to your &afirst spell slot&r (the 10 tabs on the right are your &aSpell Slots&r.
&6Cast your spells&r by holding your Spellbook in your main or offhand, and right click. &aSelect your spells with v&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests2.subtitl: Tick the box when you're ready
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests3.descrip: You can &aupgrade your spell book&r in order to &alearn higher tiers of glyphs&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests4.descrip: The ultimate spell book! Become an &aArchmage&r and learn Tier 3 Glyphs!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests5.descrip: Your next step is to obtain &bArchwood&r of some type. These trees are found somewhat rarely in many biomes.
From the Archwood, you can craft the &bAmethyst Dowsing Rod&r, which will help you find &bAmethyst Geodes&r. This is an important magical material, so collect lots of it!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests5.subtitl: A rare tree and a rare gem
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests5.title: Obtain Archwood and Make an Amethyst Dowsing Rod
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests6.descrip: Magic such as &aImbuement&r requires &dSource&r, a force which flows through all living things. You may craft a &bSourcelink&r to collect it, and a &bSource Jar&r to contain it,

But where does Source come from? The natural world. One way you can obtain it is via an &bAgronomic Sourcelink&r. &6Place your Sourcelink and Jar within 6 blocks&r of your livestock or garden, and it will slowly collect. &dBonemealed crops will not contribute to Source production&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests6.subtitl: A place to keep the universe's energy
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests6.title: Obtaining Source
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests7.descrip: The &bImbuement Chamber&r is how you can create &bSource Gems&r. Simply &6place an Amethyst or Lapis&r inside the Chamber and wait for it to slowly transform.
This can be sped up later by &agiving it access to Source&r, such as that contained in a &bSource Jar&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests7.title: Make an Imbuement Chamber
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests8.descrip: Craft a &bScribe's Table&r to take your next steps. The Scribe's Table is where you will do your &amagical crafting&r and acquire new Glyphs!
To see the new Glyphs, &6right click on the Table with your Spellbook&r. You can use the tabs on the right to &asort by tier&r. Find the Glyph you'd like to craft and select it.
Once a Glyph is selected, gather the items and &6throw them onto the table&r. The floating item will disappear when it is accepted by the table.
You may need &asome unique items called Essences&r. These are crafted on the &bImbuement Chamber&r and will require the use of &bPedestals&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests8.subtitl: I would explain it to you but that would de-scribe it
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests8.title: Obtain a Scribe's Table
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests9.descrip: &bSpell Parchment&r is a way for you to store a spell on paper. They are &asingle-use&r, and can be printed at the &bScribe's Table&r.
First, make a &bBlank Parchment&r with Paper and &bMagebloom Fiber&r. Then, combine that with &bSource Gems&r to create the final product.

Once you have placed your Scroll on the Scribe's Table, &dset your desired spell in your Spellbook&r and then &6shift right click your Spellbook on the Table&r. This will inscribe the spell onto the Parchment for you!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests9.title: Make a Spell Parchment
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests10.descri: Craft an &bArcane Pedestal&r in a Crafting Bench using &bSourcestone&r.
These Pedestals need to be placed surrounding the &bImbuement Chamber&r or &bEnchanting Apparatus&r. You can do either a + pattern or an x pattern. Both are valid.
&6Use JEI to find the recipe&r for each Glyph. Only the Source Gem is consumed, so don't worry about using expensive reagents.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests10.title: Make some Arcane Pedestals
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests11.descri: &bSourcestone&r is a material used in magical crafting recipes. It can be created at a basic &bCrafting Table&r, by surrounding a &bSource Gem&r with &bany kind of Stone&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests11.subtit: It's also a lovely decorative block
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests11.title: Obtain Some Sourcestone
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests12.descri: For starters, let's make the &bHarvest Glyph&r. As you can see in &lJEI&r, it requires an &bIron Hoe&r and an &bEarth Essence&r.

To make the Earth Essence, you'll need to have your &aArcane Pedestals set up around your Imbuement Chamber&r. You will need &bDirt, Seeds, and an Iron Ingot&r. &6Right click each reagent on a pedestal&r (the order doesn't matter). Once they're in place, put a &bSource Gem&r into the Imbuement Chamber.
If you have done everything correctly, it will begin crafting! It may go slowly unless there is a &bfilled Source Jar&r within 6 blocks.
Once it's done, pull it from the Chamber and &6throw both items&r onto your Scribe's Table. Then, grab your finished &bGlyph&r and &6right click while holding it&r to unlock the knowledge!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests12.title: Making a Glyph
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests13.descri: To move forward, you'll want an &bEnchanting Apparatus&r, which requires an &bArcane Core&r beneath it, and &bPedestals&r surrounding it.
You can either bury the Arcane Core and place everything on floor-level, or you can place the Core on floor level and raise the Pedestals up.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests13.subtit: A more mystical method of crafting
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests14.descri: &bMagebloom&r is an intensely magical plant which cannot be found naturally. You must create it using an &bEnchanting Apparatus&r. It requires &bSource Gems&r and &bSeeds&r.
&6Place the Source Gems&r on 4 of the Pedestals (order doesn't matter), and then &6place the Seeds in the Apparatus&r.
Magebloom is used in many recipes, but is especially valued for its &bFiber&r, from which &amana-infused clothing, and spell parchments&r can be made.
&dDon't forget to read your Spellbook's documentation in the top left tab!&r It has more information than these quests do.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests14.title: Craft a Magebloom Seed to get Fiber
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests15.descri: Use your newly-acquired &bMagebloom Fiber&r to craft yourself a set of &bNovice Robes&r, which will &aincrease the amount of mana&r you have access to.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests15.subtit: Unlike Witches, Mages do wear pants.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests15.title: Obtain Novice Robes
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests16.descri: The &bPotion Jar&r can hold up to 100 doses of a single potion.
You can use it to refill your &bPotion Flask&r, which is a container able to hold up to 8 doses of the same potion type.
There are two variants of the Potion Flask: &aExtend Time&r and &aAmplify&r. I think you can guess what each does.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests16.subtit: The Potion Jar, Melder, and Flasks
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests16.title: New Potion Options
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests17.descri: The &bPotion Melder&r allows you to &amix the effects of two or more potions&r. It draws from &bPotion Jars&r which surround it on either side, and when &6provided with Source&r, outputs to a Jar beneath it.
Only two Potion Jars can be used at a time, however, you can &6fill one Jar with a Melded Potion&r to add even more effects to it.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests17.subtit: Combine multiple effects into a single bottle!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests17.title: Potion Melding
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests18.descri: This armor grants additional &aMana&r over the basic set.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests18.title: Obtain Mage Armor
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests19.descri: The highest tier armor, this &bArchmage set&r is almost as good as &bNetherite&r, with hefty bonuses to &amana&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests19.title: Obtain Archmage Armor
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests20.descri: The &bCasting Wand&r is an item which you can assign a single spell to. It will automatically have the form &aProjectile&r and the Glyph of &aAccelerate&r.
&6Place it on your Scribe's Table&r and then create the desired spell in your Book. You can then &6shift right click&r on the Table with your Spellbook to write the spell to the wand.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests21.descri: In order to make magical accessories, you must make their mundane counterparts!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests21.subtit: Are you a little bit curio-us?
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests21.title: Time to Accessorize
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests22.descri: Despite the worrisome name, this Curio is all positive! The &bBelt of Unstable Gifts&r will &agrant you random positive potion effects&r periodically.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests23.descri: Unfortunately, this won't get you better deals with villagers. The &bRings of Discount&r (lesser and greater) make your spells cost less mana!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests24.descri: The &bFocus of Summoning&r allows your summoned companions to last longer.
It also &adamages nearby enemies&r which try to attack them, and &acauses the \"self\" form to count them&r as well as the player.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests25.descri: To move on, you'll need a &bRitual Brazier&r, which accepts various &bRitual Tablets&r in order to work.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests26.descri: These two &bJars&r each have a unique effect.

The &bJar of Voiding&r will delete specified items upon pickup, in exchange for mana. Helpful to get rid of extra Cobblestone! &6Shift click&r to toggle it on or off. To add an item to the void list, &6hold that item in your offhand and right click&r with the Jar.
The &bJar of Light&r summons a light source to follow the player, which can be dismissed at any time. &6Right click&r to toggle this summon.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests26.title: Special Jars
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests27.descri: The &eWeald Walkers&r are Archtrees which have been awoken. In order to perform this Ritual, &6place the brazier near an Archwood tree&r and &6right click&r it with the Tablet. &6Right click&r the Brazier to get started.
Once the &eWeald Walker&r is ambling about, &6right click it&r with the &bDominion Wand&r, and then right click it on the block you want as the Walker's &ahome&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests27.title: Ritual of Awakening
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests28.descri: In order to perform a &aRitual&r, you'll need a &bTablet&r for the Ritual you want to perform. You can check your &aspell book documentation&r to find out what each ritual does.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests28.subtit: You know I wanna get ritual, ritual
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests28.title: Craft a Ritual Tablet
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests29.descri: In order to make certain items, you'll need to defeat the boss, &eThe Wilden Chimera&r. This does not spawn naturally, and must be summoned via &aRitual&r.
It's suggested to be using tier 2 armor and spells before engaging this boss.
To summon him, you'll need to find a &eWilden Hunter&r, &eWilden Guardian&r, and &eWilden Stalker&r, and obtain their &btrophies&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests29.subtit: To become an Archmage, you must fight
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests29.title: Summon the Wilden Chimera
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests30.descri: &eFamiliars&r are small creatures who help you with your magical duties. These differ from &eCrows&r in both how you meet them, and what they can do.

Firstly, you must obtain the &bCharm&r of each Familiar. This is done differently depending on which one you're trying to summon. But you will need to &6activate their Charm&r before beginning the Ritual.

You must &6place a Ritual Brazier&r nearby the Familiar and &6put the &bTablet of Binding&6 on it&r. Then &6right click&r the Brazier. It will ensnare the &eFamiliar&r and produce a &bBound Script&r, which you can then &6right click&r to learn - from then on, that Familiar may be summoned from the &athird tab in your spellbook&r!
Read on for more information about each Familiar, both in Familiar mode and out.
You can dismiss your summoned Familiar with a &aDispel&r Spell. Break the blocks they came from to &aget back their Charm&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests30.title: Obtaining New Familiars
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests31.descri: &bStarbuncles&r are small, squirrel-like creatures which love &bGold Nuggets&r. Find a wild Starbuncle and toss them one to receive a &bStarbuncle Shard&r in return, which is used to craft its &bCharm.&r You can simply &6right click the charm on the ground&r to summon its tame counterpart.
When following you, the &eStarbuncle&r will grant you &aSpeed II&r and, when fed Gold Nuggets, it will give you the ability to &asee gold veins through blocks&r.
The &eStarbuncle&r is capable of &aitem transport&r. Use a &bDominion Wand&r to assign it to certain inventories. It will also &aharvest fully-grown &bSource Berries&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests32.descri: The &eWhirlisprig&r looks like an unripe tomato helicopter. Once you locate a wild one, &6grow a tree near it&r in order to receive its &bShards&r, used to make its &bCharm&r! You can then &6right click the charm&r on any small flower to summon one.
While in Familiar mode, they &areduce the cost of earth spells&r by half. Food you eat will also grant you more saturation.
The &eWhirlisprig&r, when bound to its flower, will &aduplicate nearby &borganic items&r - trees, flowers, etc. They need to be provided with a chest and &bSource&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests33.descri: The &eDrygmy&r is a small gnome-like creature with antlers, and can be found in the wild. In exchange for a &bWilden Horn&r dropped at its feet, it will give you a &bDrygmy Shard&r, which can be used to create its &bCharm&r. &6Right click the Charm on &bMossy Cobblestone&r.
When it is following you, it increases your Earth spell damage, and boosts &aLooting&r.

Multiple &eDrygmy&r can be assigned to a single &bHenge&r, and these creatures will &aharvest drops and experience gems&r from &eLivestock&r in a 10 block radius, without harming them! After it harvests, it will place items in a nearby inventory, and must recharge its ability &awith Source&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests34.descri: The &eBookwyrm&r is a small flying creature that resembles a wyvern, with book pages for wings. You can summon it using a &bBookwyrm Charm&r (made with &bIron&r and &bSource Gems&r and &ba book&r), which you &6shift right click on a &bLectern&r. After the Lectern finishes drawing magic to itself, the Bookwyrm will appear!
When following you, the &eBookwyrm&r &adecreases your spell cost and increases your spell damage&r.

When it is simply bound to a Lectern, it will &acast spells on the surrounding area&r, based on what &bParchment Scrolls&r you give it. It can be &adyed&r for color-coding purposes. To cast spells, there must be a filled &bSource Jar&r nearby.
This &ditem is under construction&r and so the quest is temporarily a &acheckmark&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests34.subtit: Take a look, it's in a book
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests35.descri: The &bWixie&r's &bShards&r are obtained by using the &aDispel&r effect on a &aWitch&r when they're under half health. Once you craft the &bCharm&r, you can &6right click it on a &bCauldron&r to summon the &aWixie&r.
Wixies will &aincrease the duration of consumed potions&r while they are following you. They will also &aapply negative potion effects on enemies&r.
When a Wixie is bound to a Cauldron, it will &aautomatically craft an item or potion&r it is told to. It will draw from nearby inventories, and can be paused if it receives a redstone signal.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests36.descri: &bSpell Turrets&r can cast &aTouch&r and &aProjectile&r spells when provided with &bParchment Scrolls&r, &bSource&r, and a redstone signal.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests37.descri: There is much more that this mod has to offer! &bRunes&r, &bEnchanter's Weapons&r, &bSource Relays&r and more! Check out the documentation in your &bSpell Book&r to help you learn even more!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests38.descri: The &bAmethyst Golem&r can be summoned by using the &6Ritual of Awakening&r on some &bBudding Amethyst&r.
&6Right click&r the shard on a block to summon the &eGolem&r, and then &6set its home block&r with your &bDominion Wand&r.

&eAmethyst Golems&r will convert Amethyst into &bBudding Amethyst&r, speed up &aamethyst growth&r, and will also &aharvest amethyst clusters&r, so long as their home block is an inventory such as a chest or barrel.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests39.descri: &eSirens&r can be found rarely in &aOcean Biomes&r, and you can obtain their &bShards&r by giving them a &bSea Pickle&r, their favorite snack!
Use the &bSiren Charm&r on a piece of Prismarine to summon it. &eSirens&r will change color if given &bkelp&r or &bcorals&r.

The &bSiren Shrine&r will generate &afishing loot&r, as long as it is provided with &bSource&r. The &eSirens&r will produce faster if they have lots of aquatic plants and animals to keep them company!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests40.descri: Unlike the other &bCharms&r, the &eFlarecannon&r's does not require &bShards&r, and can be simply crafted.
The &eFlarecannon&r will &adefend its territory&r much like the &eWeald Walkers&r, by firing homing projectiles at enemies.
You can give them &bSoul Sand&r or &bMagma Blocks&r to change their appearance.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests41.descri: Each type of &aArchwood Tree&r bears its own &bfruit&r! You can find it &agrowing from the tree like Cocoa Beans&r.
The &bBastion Fruit&r comes from the &aVexing Archwood&r Tree. When consumed, it will grant you &aShielding&r, a form of &aResistance&r.
The &bFrostaya&r comes from the &aCascading Archwood&r Tree. When consumed, it will &abegin to freeze you&r.
The &bMendosteen&r comes from the &aFlourishing Archwood&r Tree. It grants the &aRecovery&r effect, which increases healing you receive from health items.
The &bBombegranate&r comes from the &aBlazing Archwood&r Tree. &dIts effects are unknown&r, as the journal from which I got this information ends at this entry.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests41.title: Fruitful Labors
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests42.descri: The &bVitalic Sourcelink&r generates source when it is around &eAnimals&r. When animals &abreed, grow up, or die&r, it will generate source.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests43.descri: The &bMycelial Sourcelink&r generates &aSource&r from &afood items&r. Provide it with delicious delectables and it will provide you with magic!
It will also &agenerate mushrooms&r and &bMycelium&r in the surrounding area.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests44.descri: The &bVolcanic Sourcelink&r produces Source when provided with &bHeat&r. They will &dmelt blocks around them&r and will also cause &bLava Lilies&r to spawn.
Change the color of your &bLava Lily&r by placing it over Lava or Magma.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests45.descri: The &bAlchemical Sourcelink&r generates source when provided with &bPotions&r. The more complex the potion, the more Source is produced.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests46.descri: Gift a &eWild Starbuncle&r a &bGold Nugget&r and see what happens!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests47.descri: Although charming, &eStarbuncles&r are not the hardiest creatures, and it can be a pain to reinstruct them should something unpleasant happen to them.
Thankfully, the &bScroll of Save Starbuncle&r will &apreserve all their settings&r. Just be sure to &6right click the scroll&r on your Starby after you've finished setting them up!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests48.descri: There are so many options for &bmagely gear&r... How can you choose? Well, you may not have to!
The &bWizard's Armarium&r is a &aBelt curio&r which can contain up to &athree sets of armor&r and even &ahotbar items&r for you to swap on the fly.
By default, you'll &6press 0&r to bring up a radial wheel of armor sets. But &dfirst you need to load the Armarium&r with gear.

To begin, &6equip your robes and set up your hotbar&r. Then, open the radial and &6select the slot&r to save them to. Open your radial again, and &6switch to a different slot&r. Equip your second set of armor and then &6repeat the previous&r steps until all 3 slots are filled. Now, you can &aeasily swap between them&r using the radial.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests48.title: Multiple Sets At Once
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests49.descri: Equip your &eStarbuncles&r with a &bStarbucket&r to allow them to &atransport fluid back and forth&r. You may wish to store the fluid in a &bFluid Containment Jar&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests49.title: Starbuncles Carry Liquid!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests50.descri: The &eStarbuncles&r are capable of taking lessons from &eBookwyrms&r using the &bWyrm Degree&r. Now that they're much smarter, they can &aoperate on only certain sides of their blocks&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests51.descri: The &bStarbin&r will allow your &aStarbuncle&r to &adelete items it picks up&r. Be sure to set a filter first!
You can set a filter by &6preparing an Allow/Deny Scroll&r and &6clicking your Starbuncle&r with it.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests52.descri: Although it lacks polish, the &bStarddle&r allows you to do what the best of us have only dreamed of: &ariding a giant Starbuncle&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests53.descri: A &bCasting Crystal&r is an item which can have a &aspell bound to it&r, and then you can &6equip it as a Curio&r, and access its spell via a hotkey.
You can &awear up to three&r of these, and by default they are accessible with &6CTRL+1-3&r.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests55.descri: Did you know that &eUndead&r are susceptible to &aSpores&r and &aGrow&r spells? You should test it out sometime.
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.quests56.descri: &bSkyweave&r is an item which &amimics the look of the sky&r, so you can see sunlight even when underground!
cottagewitch.ars_twoveau.title: Ars Nouveau
cottagewitch.building__decorating.quests: The &bAdvancement Frame&r is an item which can be used to show off your achievements! Simply place this frame in your gallery and &6right click&r it to choose which advancement to display.
Show off a little
Obtain an Advancement Frame
The mod &lFantasy's Furniture&r adds beautiful and intricate furniture for you to decorate with.

The crafting system is a little different from usual, however. Each recipe costs only 1 each of &bClay, Cobbled Stone, and Planks&r, and must be created in a &bFurniture Station&b, which can be &acrafted in a Smithing Table&a using a &bCrafting Table&r and &bLeather&r.
Ideas above your station

The &bBuilding Gadget&r is a useful tool for building larger structures quickly. It &aplaces multiple blocks at once&a from your inventory. &6Shift right click a block in world&r to set that as your building block.

The &bExchanging Gadget&r is a tool which will &areplace blocks in the world with a specific block from your inventory&r. As with the BG, &6shift right click the replacer block&r and then you can &6right click with the gadget&r.
The Building Gadget and Exchanging Gadget
Gadgets, Part 1

The &bCopy Paste Gadget&r is a robust and therefore complicated tool. It allows you to use &aSchematics found online&r to build automatically, and also allows you to - as you could guess - &acopy and paste structures you've built&r.
In order to use it, you'll need &bPaper&r, and the &bTemplate Manager&r.
I cannot put all the information in this quest description. &oMore information can be found on YouTube, at 8:12 into the \"Mod Spotlight Building Gadgets v2\" video by Direwolf20&r.
Copypasta but for buildings
Gadgets, Part 2
The &bDestruction Gadget&r is a dangerous tool which will &acompletely delete blocks&r. It is mostly used to clear a large area for building.
Delete! Delete! Delete!
&bConstruction Paste&r allows you to build with blocks you technically don't have.

When you are pasting in a structure, if you are missing blocks from the build, but have &bPaste&r, it will &atake on the appearance of that block&r. When broken, it will drop &bConstruction Paste&r, however.
The &bPaste Containers&r allow you to hold significantly more paste than you would be able to, otherwise.
Don't eat the paste
These &bGlass Item Frames&r display items on a surface just like the normal kind, but they will &abecome invisible&r once they have an item inside them.
&6Place a Banner inside&r to display its pattern on that block.
I've been framed!
Obtain a Glass Item Frame
The &bTrowel&r will place a random block from your hotbar when you &6right click with it&r. Perfect for easily &arandomizing your build's palette&r.
The builder's dream
Obtain a Trowel
Lanterns can now be placed on walls! That's it, that's the tweet.
I love lantern
Obtain a Lantern
There are two types of &bFlower Box&r. One can hold 2 flowers, and the other one 3.

cottagewitch.create.quests0.description0: &lCreate&r is an incredible mod focusing on low-tech automation and machinery. I am sure I don't need to explain to you that physics, science, and magic are all closely interrelated. Why not dabble a bit in &atech witchery&r? Unlike many tech mods, the basic energy type Create uses is &arotational force&r, which can be generated in a number of ways.
cottagewitch.create.quests0.description1: These quests will help to guide you through the basics, but ultimately the final products will be up to you and your imagination! Thankfully, there is a robust in-game documentation system called &dPondering&r, which can be accessed by &6holding the “w” key down when hovering over an item&r in your inventory or in JEI. Make sure you aren’t typing in a text field first, though!
cottagewitch.create.quests0.description2: To begin with, take this &bWrench&r. You can &6right click on most Create blocks&r to rotate them or alter them in some way. &dWhich side of the block you click on&r determines which way the object rotates. Additionally, you can &6shift right click&r most Create items (and some vanilla, such as levers or hoppers) &ato instantly remove them directly into your inventory&r. An incredibly useful feature!
cottagewitch.create.quests0.tasks0.title: I'm Ready!
cottagewitch.create.quests0.title: Beginning the Create-ive Process
cottagewitch.create.quests1.description0: One of the first machines you'll want to build is the &bMechanical Press&r. This, well, presses items down to create things like &bBrass and Iron Sheets&r, which you'll need for future projects.
cottagewitch.create.quests1.description1: To begin with, make a &bHand Crank&r to power it. Going forward, you'll &aautomate your power&r, but in a pinch, some elbow grease does the trick just as well.
cottagewitch.create.quests1.description2: Take this &bIron&r and place it underneath the &bMechanical Press&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests1.title: Your First Machine
cottagewitch.create.quests2.description0: &bAndesite&r is one of the foundational blocks of beginning your factory. However, though stone by itself is strong, it is not malleable. So, it is best to mix it with &bIron&r to create a more versatile material: &bAndesite Alloy&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests2.description1: &bAndesite Alloy&r is used in making both &bShafts&r (which are then used to make &bCogs&r), and also to reinforce stripped logs into &bAndesite Casing&r. Together, these make up the basis of most of the recipes in this mod.
cottagewitch.create.quests2.description2: &6Equip these Goggles in your Curio slot&r to &aeasily see detailed information&r about all your machines.
cottagewitch.create.quests2.title: A Better Stone
cottagewitch.create.quests3.description0: &bShafts&r can be used to convey &arotational force&r, and &bCogs&r both &6convey and manipulate&r that force. Many machines have cogs in-built, which require an external &bCog&r to power them. Others can connect to either a &bShaft&r or the side of a &bCog&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests3.title: Getting the Shaft
cottagewitch.create.quests4.description0: As mentioned, &bCogwheels&r - or Cogs - can &aconvey and manipulate rotational force&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests4.description1: The way that &bCogs&r connect is fairly simple: &bSmall Cogs&r can connect in a + pattern (ie, on the cardinal directional sides, as well as at the shaft). &bLarge and Small Cogs&r connect diagonally, as well as at the shaft.
cottagewitch.create.quests4.description2: If you connect the shafts of a &bSmall&r and then a &bLarge Cog&r, it will &aincrease the speed&r of the rotation. These can be &dstacked multiple times&r, by &6placing a second Small Cog at the diagonal&r of the Large Cog, and then another Large Cog at its shaft. You can continue this as many times as you have space for.
cottagewitch.create.quests5.description0: As mentioned, &bCogwheels&r - or Cogs - can &aconvey and manipulate rotational force&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests5.description1: The way that &bCogs&r connect is fairly simple: &bLarge Cogs&r connect perpendicularly to one another, allowing you to &atransfer from horizontal to vertical rotation&r without a &bGearbox&r (more on that later). &bLarge and Small Cogs&r connect diagonally, as well as at the shaft.
cottagewitch.create.quests5.description2: &bLarge Cogwheels&r in particular are helpful, as they can connect to the top of the &bRotation Speed Controller&r, allowing you to &6customize the rotations per minute - rpm - of the subsequent machinery&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests5.description3: If you connect the shafts of a &bSmall&r and then a &bLarge Cog&r, it will &aincrease the speed&r of the rotation. These can be &dstacked multiple times&r, by &6placing a second Small Cog at the diagonal&r of the Large Cog, and then another Large Cog at its shaft. You can continue this as many times as you have space for.
cottagewitch.create.quests6.description0: An early game method of generating rotational force is with water wheels. They require &aat least one flowing water block&r to function. Any additional flowing water blocks &awill not generate more stress units or rotational speed&r. The two types of water wheels are the standard &bWater Wheel&r and the &bLarge Water Wheel&r. The standard &bWater Wheel&r generates &a256 su&r at a speed of &a8 rpm&r, while the &bLarge Water Wheel&r generates &a512 su&r at a speed of &a4 rpm&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests6.description1: You can connect items such as &bShafts&r, &bCogs&r, or &bGearboxes&r to the center of the wheel, allowing you to distribute rotational force to your machines.
cottagewitch.create.quests6.description2: You can also &6right-click&r the water wheel with a &bwooden plank&r to change the texture of the water wheel to the corresponding plank texture. Keep in mind that modded planks &dmay cause odd textures&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests6.title: Rotational Force: Water
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description0: A mid-game method of generating rotational force is with a windmill. A small windmill can be made relatively easily, and can be expanded later on to generate more stress units.
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description1: A windmill requires a &bWindmill Bearing&r, which can be &aplaced facing any direction&r. The front face of the Bearing is sticky, and &6a block placed on it&r will become part of the windmill. The back of the bearing is where shafts can be connected to distribute the windmill’s rotational force.
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description2: &dNow you have two choices&r, using &bSails&r or &bWools&r as the “sail-like” blocks.
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description3: Once you have attached 8 or more &bSails&r or sail-like blocks, &6right click the &bWindmill Bearing&r to activate the structure&r. &6Hold right-click while looking at the side of bearing&r to configure the rotational direction of the windmill. If &bWools&r are used, you have to &6apply glue to attach the blocks together&r as they do not automatically connect like sails do.
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description4: You can expand a windmill up to 128 sail/sail-like blocks to generate a maximum of &a8192 su&r at a speed of &a16 rpm&r. Any additional &bSails&r or &bWools&r &adoes not generate more stress units or rotational speed&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests7.description5: Other non-&bSails&r or &bWools&r blocks can also be attached to the windmill structure. These additional blocks &awill not affect the efficiency of the windmill&r so feel free to decorate the windmill as you please!
cottagewitch.create.quests7.title: Rotational Force: Wind
cottagewitch.create.quests8.description0: Another power option is &bStarbuncle Wheels&r. It turns out that the industry of the &eStarbuncle&r goes beyond collecting and transferring items - they &alove to run&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests8.description1: Give them a &awheel to run around in&r, and they will reliably generate you &d256 su&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests8.title: Rotational Force: Exercise
cottagewitch.create.quests9.description0: &bAndesite Casing&r is one of three different tiers of Casing, used to craft various machinery. It is crafted by applying &bAndesite Alloy&r to a &bStripped Log&r. You can do this &6manually by placing the &bStripped Log&r in world and &6right clicking it with the &bAndesite Alloy&r. It can also be automated by using a &bDeployer&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests10.description: Turning a &bHand Crank&r is hungry work! Quick, eat this before you pass out.
cottagewitch.create.quests11.description: The &bGearbox&r helps you &amanipulate rotation&r in a small space by &aforming a right angle&r for 2 or more &bCogs&r or &bShafts&r.
The &bGear Shift&r can be &6rotated on either x or y axis&r to help you &dturn corners&r and &achange directions&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests12.description: Among other things, the &bGearshift&r allows you to &areverse the direction of rotation&r, by placing it between two &bShafts&r or &bCogs&r, and &6applying a Redstone signal&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests13.description: Congratulation on operating your first machine! Hopefully if you were feeling intimidated, you now feel a little more confident.
cottagewitch.create.quests14.description: &aRotational force&r is measured in &dStress Units, or su&r. The more force you generate, the more su you have access to. Machines require a certain amount of su to run, and if you try to place too many operations on a single network, your system can become &dOverstressed&r. You can view this in individual parts by &6wearing Goggles&r, but it is also recommended to craft a &bStressometer&r to attach to your network.
The Stressometer allows you to &aview your maximum su and how much of it is remaining&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests14.title: The Power of Rotational Force
cottagewitch.create.quests15.description: This is just the basics of what you can do with the magic of engineering. Explore on your own and see what kind of &amystical machines&r you can craft.
cottagewitch.create.quests15.title: Continue On
cottagewitch.create.quests16.description: The &bSteam Engine&r is another method of creating power, but it is &asignificantly more difficult&r and not recommended for beginners.
To find out how to power a &bSteam Engine&r, as well as how to &dupgrade the output&r, please &6search &lJEI&r for \"steam engine\" and &6hold \"W\" to ponder&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests17.description: The &bMechanical Mixer&r is used for multiple functions such as &acreating alloys&r and &aautocrafting shapeless recipes&r.
It must be paired with a &bBasin&r, which holds the ingredients for it to mix.
Let's test it out by &dmaking some &bChocolate Bars&r.
Take these ingredients and &6set up your Basin above a Heat Source&r. This should make one bucket of &bMelted Chocolate&r. You can either &6extract it with a &bPump&r, or with a &bBucket&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests17.title: Mixing and Crafting
cottagewitch.create.quests18.description: Many &bMixer&r recipes will require heating via a &bBlaze Burner&r.
You can craft an &bEmpty Blaze Burner&r, and then you must &6find a &eBlaze&6 and right click it&r with the &bBlaze Burner&r to capture it.

The &bBlaze Burner&r must be &afed to function&r. You can feed it by &6right clicking it with flammable things&r such as &blogs&r, &btorches&r, &bBlaze Rods&r, and most efficiently: &bBlaze Cakes&r. You'll be able to make those later, but for now, take this one.
cottagewitch.create.quests18.subtitle: your very own Calcifer!
cottagewitch.create.quests18.title: Heating with Blaze Burners
cottagewitch.create.quests19.description: Now that you have your &bMelted Chocolate&r, you'll want to &6compact it into Bars using a &bMechanical Press&r.
Place a &bBasin&r beneath a &bMechanical Press&r and either &apump or bucket&r the Chocolate into the Basin.
With enough power, the &bPress&r will automatically turn the liquid into &bChocolate Bars&r, which can be retrieved by &6right clicking with an empty hand&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests19.title: Liquid to Solid via Compaction
cottagewitch.create.quests20.description: For certain recipes you may wish to use &bFluids&r, and for that you'll need &bTanks&r, &bPipes&r, and &bPumps&r.
To test it out, why not &dset up an infinite &bLava&d source&r? Set up a basic &aLava Generator&r with &bDripstone&r and a &bCauldron&r.
Then, place a &bPump&r and/or some &bFluid Pipes&r beside it, as well as a &bTank&r to hold the liquid. Power the pump and &6use the Wrench to change the Pump's direction&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests20.title: Moving and Storing Fluids
cottagewitch.create.quests21.description: Another important &aalloy&r is &bBrass&r, which is formed of &bCopper&r and &bZinc&r.
To craft it, you'll need a &bMixer&r with a &bBlaze Burner&r underneath. Throw the ingredients into the mixer, &6feed the Blaze Burner&r, and make sure the &bMixer&r is receiving enough su.
You can remove the finished product by setting up a &bConveyor Belt&r, or just by &6right clicking with an empty hand&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests22.description: &bRose Quartz&r is a glassy crystal that can be both decorative and useful. Its most important usage is in &bElectron Tubes&r, which help to power &a\"intelligent\" machines&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests23.description: The &bElectron Tube&r is a source of magical intelligence, allowing machines to &aperform actions like players&r, for example: The &bDeployer&r is capable of using many tools: shears, buckets, swords, and more.
&bElectron Tubes&r also provide the basis for most of &lCreate's&r sorting mechanisms, or anything else which requires &aintelligent function&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests24.description: The &bBrass Hand&r is used to craft both &bDeployers&r and the &bExtend-o Grip&r, the latter of which &aallows you to extend your main hand reach&r. It's very... handy. I'll see myself out.
cottagewitch.create.quests25.description: &bDeployers&r are used to automate &bCasings&r, craft &bPrecision Mechanisms&r, and to &agenerally simulate right or left clicks&r. This allows the &bDeployer&r to automate things which &lArs Nouveau&r cannot.
cottagewitch.create.quests26.description: &bMechanical Belts&r convey items between machines and inventories &ahorizontally or diagonally&r. Items placed on a &bMechanical Belt&r will stick to it and not despawn.

&bChutes&r can transport items &avertically and diagonally&r. By default they transport downward, but &6hook them up to &bEncased Fans&r to change the direction. Unlike hoppers, they do not have a multi-slot inventory, and can transport multiple items at once.
You can learn more about how they work by &6holding w to Ponder&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests26.title: Moving Items
cottagewitch.create.quests27.description: The &bPrecision Mechanism&r is crafted by setting up a &bMechanical Belt&r and &bthree Deployers&r.
You can view the recipe in &lJEI&r by selecting the second tab at the top, &d\"Recipe Sequence\"&r.

The first Deployer should hold a &bCogwheel&r, the second a &bLarge Cogwheel&r, and the third a &bIron Nugget&r. Each mechanism must &6go through the process 5 times&r. There is only an &d80%% change of receiving&r the final product.
cottagewitch.create.quests28.description: The &bRotational Speed Controller&r is a machine which can &aincrease, decrease, or reverse&r the speed and direction of rotation.
&6Place it down and connect one of the sides&r to your su network. Then, &6attach a &bLarge Cogwheel&r as shown in the image, and &6connect the subsequent machinery&r to that &bCogwheel&r.
The machinery will then adopt whatever speed you &aset the Controller to&r. &6Scroll to the negatives to reverse direction&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests29.description: You can enhance your Create machines by integrating &bGlass Casings&r, which are both aesthetic and functional blocks with connective textures.
cottagewitch.create.quests29.title: Glass Casings as Deco
cottagewitch.create.quests31.description: Interested in &aauto-crafting, but don't have any &eWixies&r yet? Try &bMechanical Crafters&r.
Set them up in the correct shape and provide them with &aRotational Force&r to get them going. You can feed items into them using many options - &bMechanical Arms, Hoppers, Pipez&r, or others!
You need to be sure to &6align their arrows correctly using the &bWrench&r, so that they all &aoutput to a single slot&r. This is required for them to work.
This image is only &aone example&r of a shape you can place them in. You can do a simple 3x3 for most recipes, but &dyou'll need the above setup for the next quest&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests31.title: Crafting Beyond The Table
cottagewitch.create.quests32.description: One of the recipes that you can craft with your &bMechanical Crafters&r is the &bCrushing Wheel&r. A pair of these wheels will &aprocess raw ores and many other items&r, giving you access to &abonus items&r when compared with preparing them manually.
You'll also need them in your quest to &amake &bBlaze Cakes&r. Take this &bNetherrack&r and put it through the &bCrushers&r!
cottagewitch.create.quests32.title: Crushing Power
cottagewitch.create.quests33.description: &bBlaze Cakes&r begin with a crust, or &bBase&r. This is made by &acompacting &bCinder Flour&r with &bSugar&r and &ban Egg&r.
Use the &bCompactor&r setup you created earlier!
cottagewitch.create.quests33.title: Making The Crust
cottagewitch.create.quests34.description: Now that you have a &bPump and Pipes&r, what do you do with the fluid?

Well, you have a few options. You could &acompact the fluid&r into solids using a &bMechanical Press&r (see the other quests for this!), or you could use a &bSpout&r to &adispense fluid onto or into items&r on a Depot.
Spouts can be used in making &bChocolate-Covered Berries&r, &bHoneyed Apples&r, &bSweet Rolls&r, and eventually also &bBlaze Cakes&r!
cottagewitch.create.quests34.title: Dispensing Fluids
cottagewitch.create.quests35.description: Using your &bSpout&r setup from earlier, you can &apipe lava into your &bBlaze Cake Base&r! The resulting &bBlaze Cake&r can be used to power &bBlaze Burners&r very significantly.
cottagewitch.create.quests35.subtitle: its a piece of cake to bake a pretty cake
cottagewitch.create.quests35.title: Baking a Cake
cottagewitch.create.quests36.description: Did you know there is an &ainfinite &bBlaze Cake&r? Normally it's only available in Creative, but you can &6earn one by trading in&r 1000 regular &bBlaze Cakes&r.
cottagewitch.create.quests36.subtitle: blaze it lol
cottagewitch.create.quests36.title: A Creative Way To Cook
cottagewitch.create.title: Create
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests0.descr: Have yourself a beachy delight with a &bTropical Stew&r. Authentic crab meat, savory onions, and rice inside a coconut shell - perfection!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests0.title: Cook some Tropical Stew
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests1.descr: One feature of this modpack is that &aeating a variety of foods grants you extra hearts&r! Make sure to &6maintain a wide diet&r, as these bonus hearts will diminish if you find yourself living off a stack of egg sandwiches or Everlasting Beef.
You can see which foods you've eaten by checking your &bFood Book&r, which is inside your &bAkashic Tome&r and can be accessed by &6right clicking the Tome and then selecting the Food Book&r.
You can also find what you've yet to eat by searching \"yet\" in the right side of your inventory screen (&lJEI&r).
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests1.title: The Spice of Life
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests2.descr: &bTea&r is a small bush which can be grown in order to produce &btea leaves&r, which can be brewed into &btea&r. Let me say &btea&r some more. &bTea&r.
You'll need a &bkettle&r to brew it, which is made with some &bleather&r, a &bbucket&r, and &bcopper&r.

You can find &bWild Tea Bushes&r in &cSwamps&r. To obtain different kinds of tea, &6allow the bush to continue growing&r until it changes color. This will allow you to gather &byellow&r and &bblack&r tea leaves!
You cannot grow tea on &bFarmland&r, it must be planted on grass.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests2.subti: The beginning of a beautiful thing
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests2.title: Obtain Tea Seeds
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests3.descr: &bCoffee Beans&r can be acquired from &aBasalt Deltas&r in the Nether.
What, are you surprised coffee comes from the Nether? Why do you think it's so hellishly good?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests3.title: Obtain Coffee Beans
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests4.descr: Rose hip tea will grant you a small amount of &aRegeneration&r!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests5.descr: The &bKettle&r must be &6placed on a heat source&r in order to brew tea. You can use a &bcampfire&r, &bmagma block&r, or other source of warmth.
Use a &bwater bucket&r or 3 &bwater bottles&r to fill the &bkettle&r with water by &6right clicking them&r on the block. Then, &6right click&r and place your brewing ingredients inside!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests5.subti: Don't let it call your Cooking Pot black.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests5.title: Obtain a Kettle
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests6.descr: Black tea is the leaf with the greatest amount of tannins, making it the most resistant to heat and also the most strongly-flavored.
Oh, it's also the most &aCaffeinated&r, and will grant you that effect.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests7.descr: Yellow tea, known to most as Oolong, is an earthier flavored tea with the &aability to grant resistance&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests8.descr: This tea is bright, grassy, and delicious! It also grants you the &aHaste&r effect.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests8.subti: Green is for fresh, delicate, and delightful!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests9.descr: Brew some delightful Dandelion Tea for a sunny afternoon picnic. It will grant you the &dComforting&r effect, which &akeeps you healing regardless of hunger&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests10.desc: Make some purulent tea. It may give you weakness, but it also extends a random effect by 15 seconds. So that's kinda good, right?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests11.desc: Much like Mushroom colonies, &bNether Fungus&r can be grown in &acomplete darkness&r using &bRich Soul Soil&r. If you &6harvest one with shears&r, you will get the whole colony. &6Harvest it with your hand&r and you will get up to 5 fungi. I've heard they're enjoyable to hang out with.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests11.subt: I bet you're a really fun Gus
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests12.desc: Are you a trophy hunter? Well, look no further than this tasteful and bold decoration - the &bHoglin Mount&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests13.desc: You can also use &bHoglin Hides&r to create Soul &bCompost&r, which will slowly convert into &bRich Soul Soil&r. Simply &6place the Compost near Lava&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests13.subt: Soul Compost? Boy that's a mood
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests14.desc: &bHoglin Hide&r can be used in cooking recipes, or cleaned on a &bCutting Board&r to create &bLeather&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests15.desc: This moldy meat is frankly pretty gross. But if you want to complete all your quests, you &6need to make it&r. Bwahahaha.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests16.desc: By killing &eHoglins&r with your trusty &bKnife&r, you can gain &bHoglin Loin&r, &bHoglin Hide&r, and sometimes &bHam&r! These can be used in cooking recipes.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests17.desc: In order to obtain &bStrider Slices&r, you need to slay &eStriders&r with a &bKnife&r. It's quite tragic, really. But if you do so, you can &6cook them as they are&r, or place the Slices on the &bCutting Board&r to obtain &bGround Strider&r, which has further recipe uses.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests18.desc: Make yourself a &bRaw Stuffed Hoglin&r and &6place it in a &bCooking Pot&r with 2 &bNether Salads&r to create a &bStuffed Hoglin&r, which can be placed down and eaten as the centerpiece of the most indulgent feast!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests19.desc: &bPropelplants&r can be found in the Nether. They look similar to Bamboo, but are black in color, with glowing globules at the top. &dBe careful when harvesting them&r! You'll need &bShears&r to obtain the &bPropelpearls&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests20.desc: This meal is deeply nourishing, but it never cools down no matter how much you blow on it.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests21.desc: &bPropelcane&r is obtained from &bPropelplants&r, but must be &6harvested with a Knife&r. It can be chopped into &bGunpowder&r at a Cutting Board, or used to &acreate special &bPropelplant Torches&r.
The &bCane&r can also be &aplanted on &bRich Soul Soil&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests21.subt: Are you Abel to get Cain?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests22.desc: Before you can chow down on your &bStuffed Hoglin&r, you must first &6carve off the finest delicacy&r - the &bears&r. Delicious!
Then, you can &aobtain dishes&r from the remainder of the meal by &6clicking on the Hoglin with a bowl&r. Don't waste any!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests22.subt: He even carved the Roast Beast!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests23.desc: &bKnives&r from this mod will guarantee you &aadditional drops from animals&r, such as &bfeathers&r or &bleather&r, as well as &aadditional drops when breaking grass&r. This makes it much easier to get started on your agricultural journey.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests24.desc: The &bCooking Pot&r will allow you to make uniquely filling and delicious dishes! The more different foods you try, the &amore hearts you'll gain&r, making this an important tool for the kitchen witch adventurer.
Place the &bCooking Pot&r on top of a heat source such as &bfire&r, &bcampfire&r, &bmagma block&r, or &bstove&r, to heat it. Then, &6place your ingredients inside&r.
You'll also need something to serve your dish in, such as a &bbowl&r, &bbottle&r, or a &bpumpkin&r!
When the &bCooking Pot&r is broken, it retains its contents.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests24.subt: Despite the name, it's not for cooking pot.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests25.desc: A &bStove&r is an incredibly useful tool. Thanks to your inherent magic, it is fueled at all times! You can &6place up to 6 food items&r on the grill in order to cook them. They'll pop up into items when they're ready! You can &6place an upside-down &bBasket&r above it to collect them automatically.
The &bStove&r can also be used as a heat source for the &bCooking Pot&r, but if you do it that way, you cannot place items on the grill.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests26.desc: &bBark&r is obtained by &6placing a log on a Cutting Board and right clicking with an Axe&r.
It can be used when making &bCompost&r, &bPaper&r, or even &abrewing Ale&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests26.subt: Yer barking up the wrong tree...heehee
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests27.desc: A &bcutting board&r will allow you to prepare advanced ingredients for your meals, such as &bbacon&r or &bfish filets&r. Simply &6place the item on the cutting board&r and &6right click it&r with your knife.
This isn't the only use for the &bcutting board&r! Try experimenting with items like &bwooden logs&r (using an &baxe&r) or even unwanted &bleather armor&r (with &bshears&r)!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests27.subt: Back to the ol' Cutting Board
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests28.desc: &bDog food&r, and its companion, &bHorse Food&r, will grant potion effects to their users such as &aspeed&r, &aresistance&r, or &ajump boost&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests28.subt: Hmmm... Maybe YOU should try eating it... Go on...
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests29.desc: You can make &bPasta with Meatballs&r in a &bCooking Pot&r. Eating Full-Course meals, such as this one, will grant you the &aNourishing&r effect, which &aprevents you from losing hunger and saturation&r for a time. Helpful if you'll be going somewhere dangerous, as it will keep your health regenerating!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests30.desc: &bHot Cocoa&r is made with &bBottled Milk&r. While &bBottled Milk&r will remove one effect from you, positive OR negative - &bHot Cocoa&r will &aonly remove negative effects&r! I always knew Swiss Miss knew what she was doing.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests31.desc: Some meals, like &bGlazed Ham&r or &bShepherd's Pie&r, need to be &6placed in world&r in order to eat them. They also make great decoration for your (visual) feasting pleasure!
You'll also need a &bbowl&r in order to eat them, so here, take this one.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests31.subt: Stuffed Pumpkin is the new cake
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests32.desc: With &bAcorns&r you can make &bNut Butter&r. Combine that with some fresh-reduced &bJelly&r and some &bBread&r and you've got yourself a nutritionally sound, delicious lunch.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests32.subt: A classic meal for both depression and joy
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests33.desc: Ahh, there we are! The ultimate meal. Veggies, protein, dairy, grains...a balanced meal to tempt the tums.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests34.desc: This quest exists purely so that when you make a &bS'more&r...you get some more!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests35.desc: I'm not sure who pioneered the idea of eating &bEnder Pearls&r, but hey...why not?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests36.desc: Is it wrong to take carefully prepared, ceremonial-grade &bMatcha&r and then fill it with sugar and make it into a latte?
Well, if it is, then I don't wanna be right.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests37.desc: Step one on your journey to the ultimate burger is this: the humble &bHamburger&r.
The humbleburger, if you will. Hambumble? I don't know.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests37.subt: Don't think too hard about the reward
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests38.desc: Already twice as good by virtue of adding &bCheese&r, this burger could still be better...
