cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests39.desc: Eat a bunch of cake! It's a delicious treat and you deserve it.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests40.desc: Achieve this advancement by &6eating a course of every meal available&r! You can search for \"food\" in JEI or your storage, but &donly foods from the &lFarmer's Delight&r &dmod&r count.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests41.desc: To complete this quest, you'll want to trigger the advancement by doing some real Cooking On The Go with your &bskillet&r. Simply &6stand next to a heat source&r (&bcampfire&r, &bmagma block&r, &blava&r, you name it!) while &6holding the skillet in your main hand&r and &6your raw ingredients in your off hand&r! Right click and hold to start sizzling.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests42.desc: Vegetarian? No worries, we got you covered! Why not make some delicious &avegetarian dishes?&r
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests43.desc: There are many meals which can be &6placed down and eaten&r. Craft one of each and show your prowess as a kitchen witch.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests44.desc: Who doesn't love pie? &6Make each type of pie and cake&r, and at the end you'll have a sumptuous feast!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests45.desc: &bAzalea Tea&r is a delicious way to enjoy the beauty of the Azalea!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests47.desc: Did you know that you can &aautomate your cooking with &lCreate&r? You can!
Right click the &bCooking Guide&r onto a &bBlaze Burner&r to &6create a Blaze Stove&r.
Hold \"w\" to &6ponder&r the &bCooking Guide&r for more information.

Be sure that the &bCooking Guide&r is outside of your &bAkashic Tome&r! &dThe book will be consumed&r by this process. Check the &atutorial quests&r for info on removing a book from the &bAkashic Tome&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests48.desc: Time to put that Keg to use! &bMead&r grants the effect &dSweetheart&r, which increases all incoming healing.
&bRice Wine&r gives &dSatisfaction&r, which causes Hunger to regen the same way Health does.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests49.desc: To get your brewery started, you'll first need a &bKeg&r, and some &bTankards&r. Place the Tankards into the Keg with some &bWater&r and &aIngredients&r, such as Wheat for Beer, or Honey for Mead.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests50.desc: Place &bMagma Blocks&r around your &bKeg&r to raise the temperature and craft new brews! The more blocks you use, the higher the heat.
With this method, you can even craft &bCheeses&r and &bFudge&r.
You can also &acool down&r your &bKeg&r by placing &bIce Blocks&r around it instead! This will allow you to make things like &bPickles&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests51.desc: Cheese can be created in the Keg, but must &abe aged before it can be eaten&r. Place the Cheese out to let it ripen.
Once it's ripe, you can place it on a &bCutting Board&r to obtain &bCheese Wedges&r to cook with.
&dWarning&r - the popup screen will say \\"Fully Grown\\" before the cheese is matured. Wait a little longer, until that text is gone.
You can also &aage cheese quickly&r with Create &6Haunting&r. Trauma causes the cheese to age prematurely. It also makes it &ldelicious&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests52.desc: Have you ever had lasagna so good that it was frightening? Well, &awhat are you waiting for?&r
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests53.desc: Served in a &bCauldron&r, this fanciful feast is &adevilishly good&r!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests54.desc: In order to make &bFudge&r, your &bKeg&r will need to be at &amax heat&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests55.desc: &bPickles&r need a &anice, cold&r Keg to marinate in.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests56.desc: Once you've obtained a &bDragon Egg&r, you can use them to craft a &bNourishing Dragon Egg&r.
This item can only be cut with the &aextreme sharpness&r of a &bNether Star&r on a &bCutting Board&r. Cutting open the egg will give you &aseveral ingredients&r needed for high-level meals.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests57.desc: To serve the unbridled taste sensation that is &adragon protein&r, you'll need an appropriate vessel.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests58.desc: &bDragon Meat Stew&r... what could be a greater show of power than &cconsuming your fallen enemies&r?
Was that too much? That was too much, wasn't it?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests59.desc: This dreamy steamed dish will &afulfill your wildest dreams&r... or, at least, it'll &agive you some great buffs&r!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests60.desc: Make this advancement by crafting the &bAssorted Salad&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests61.desc: Congratulations, you've cooked some of the &amost magically imbued food&r in the game! Truly a kitchen witch of supreme renown!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests62.desc: Possibly the &amost helpful item&r in the &cShulkren Forest&r, this tea helpfully &aclears the Levitation effect&r! You may want to make... a few...
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests62.subt: keep your feet on the ground
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests63.desc: Not a fan of red bean paste? Why not try &bChorus Fruit&r in your &bRice Cakes&r instead?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests64.desc: An uncommonly known fact is that &eShulkers&r are kind of like &bEggs&r! And, unsurprisingly, rather &ataste like them&r, too. As such, they make a delicious addition to your &abalanced diet&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests65.desc: Although challenging to make, the &bDragon's Breath and Chorus Stew&r grants a number of effects that make it very worthwhile!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests66.desc: &bLiquid Dragon Egg&r. Sounds appealing, doesn't it? You &ocould&r eat this as is...but why not &acook it first&r?
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests67.desc: You can also &aadd Spices to your food&r! One such spice is &bVinegar&r, which is created by leaving &bSweet Berries&r to &arest in the Dolium&r with a &bFlower Pot&r.
Adding spices to your food &agives it greater saturation&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests68.desc: The &bDolium&r is used for &aResting Conversion&r, which consists of placing your &aingredients and other items&r inside and &6letting them rest&r, for up to an &ain-game day&r.

Each recipe needs all ingredients, as well as a container to hold the result, and sometimes an additional item (such as &aAnvils for Gravy Boats&r). &dThe resting process will not begin without all components&r.
This can be sped up using the &bTime in a Bottle&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests69.desc: &lCaupona&r is a cooking mod that employs a freeform style of recipe.
With most recipes, you will &amaintain a ratio&r of ingredients, such as ensuring that you have &a\"mostly beef\"&r and &a\"some vegetables\"&r, with &a\"no fish\"&r, and so on.
You can use &bthe guidebook&r or &lJEI&r to learn the recipes.
When viewing &bStews and Soups&r, ensure that you &6click these icons&r to access their recipes.
A) This is the &bSoup Base&r. For example, for &bNail Soup&r, you &6boil water&r.
B) This is the &aratio of ingredients to liquid&r. For example, 3 or more ingredients to 1 bucket/4 bowls of liquid.
C) This is the &aoutput&r, or what the recipe will make.
D) These are ingredients which &amust not be included&r.
E and F) These are the &aratio of items to each other&r, for example, a majority of &bbeef&r and at least one &bvegetable&r.
Now that you know how to read the recipes, let's make some!
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests70.desc: The &bStove&r is a helpful and aesthetically-pleasing &aheat source&r, which can be used to heat &bStew Pots, Stir Fry Pans, and Hypocausts&r.
Strictly speaking, a &bStove&r is not the only &aheat source usable by the mod&r. However, it's very pretty.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests71.desc: To stir-fry things, you'll need two things: a &bpan or stone&r, and a &bGravy Boat&r.
The Pan must be &6placed atop a heat source&r. The &bGravy Boat&r must be placed &adirectly next to the pan&r. You can place it with &6shift right click&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests72.desc: A &bGravy Boat&r is crucial to making &aStir Fried dishes&r. It's crafted by &aresting&r, which is a unique mechanic involving &6putting things in a &bDolium&r and then &6leaving it the heck alone&r.

In this image, you can see there are &aat least 8 &bWalnuts&r, one &bAnvil&r, and one &bGlass Bottle&r (you can also use an empty Gravy Boat) in the &bDolium&r. All of these must be present in order for the &aresting process&r to begin. Be aware that this &dtakes a very long time&r. Most resting takes &dan in-game day&r to complete.
You can speed it up by using &bTime in a Bottle&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests73.desc: To begin with, you'll need a &bClay Pot&r, which you'll need to &6fire in a furnace&r. A &bStew Pot&r is used to make &aSoups, Stews, and Aspics&r.
Once placed, you can &afill the Stew Pot&r by &6right clicking it&r with a &bBucket of Milk or Water&r, or &bBowls&r of whichever ingredient.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests74.desc: Now that you're ready to cook, let's try making some &bBorscht&r. Just like babshka used to make.
As you can see, it's a &bBeetroot&r-heavy &avegetable soup&r, that doesn't have any &adenial ingredients&r.
Make sure you place &aat least 3 &bBeetroot&r and &aat least 1 &bother vegetable&r (or another &bBeetroot&r).
However, you can &dadd more than that&r! If you make it with &b9 Beetroot&r, it will give you &agreater saturation&r.
There is a &dbug where the correct Saturation won't appear&r when you hover over the item. However, it will be correct when you eat it.
Stews can also &abe placed down with &6shift + right click&r!
Additionally, you can &aadd &bPotions&a to your food&r by including them in the 9 ingredients.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests75.desc: Soups will &aconvert to Aspic&r if left to sit in a &bStew Pot&r or &bDolium&r for long periods of time. This can be a good way of &astacking your stews&r, as &bBowls&r do not stack.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests76.desc: In order to &athaw an &bAspic&r, you can either &6place it in a &bStew Pot&r and let it convert, or you can use a &bPortable Brazier&r.
The &bBrazier&r can be done while traveling, but it will require a &bBowl of Water&r and some &bVivid Charcoal&r in order to work.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests77.desc: To test your Stir-Fry Skills, why not make some &bSauteed Roots&r? This dish is made with &aroot vegetables such as &bCarrots&r or &bPotatoes&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests78.desc: To obtain a &bDragon Tooth&r, one must &6kill the &eEnder Dragon&6 with a &bKnife&r.
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.quests79.desc: A &blunchbag&r, upgradeable to an iron or gold lunchbox, is a handy-dandy way to carry a variety of foods with you wherever you go. You can &aeat the lunchbox directly&r for a randomised snack from its interior- an excellent way to easily &aincrease your food variety score&r, which increases your hearts!
A word of warning... don't trust seagulls. They'll swoop down and &asteal food right out of your inventory&r; even your whole lunchbox!
&dCaution: entering Creative Mode with the lunchbox in your inventory will cause its contents to be wiped.&r
cottagewitch.culinary_arts.title: Culinary Arts
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests0.d: Would you like to explore the &cOtherside&r? It's a dark and dangerous dimension accessible only through the &dportal in Ancient Cities&r. To access it, you'll only need to &6kill the Warden&r. Should be an easy job, right? Of course!
First, you'll need to find yourself the &cAncient City&r, often signified by the presence of &bSculk&r.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests0.s: Break on through to the Otherside
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests1.d: &bSculk&r is the signature block of the &cDeep Dark&r, a biome in which &cAncient Cities&r rest, occupied only by the Sculk and its associated creatures.
Where &bSculk&r comes from and what it does is not entirely known... but it is clear that it is &lalive&r.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests2.d: Once you have obtained &bEcho Shards&r, you can produce your own &bSculk&r and &bSculk Veins&r by &6feeding exp to a &bSculk Catalyst&r, which will &atransform the surrounding blocks&r. The primary method of doing this is to &6slay monsters nearby&r.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests2.s: a catalyst for greatness. or at least sculk.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests3.d: &bSculk Sensors&r are cute - and mildly terrifying - beings which will &atransmit a redstone signal when alerted&r. They listen for nearby sounds, such as &afootsteps, blocks placing or breaking, or opening inventories&r.
You can &6block their listening with wool&r, directionally, or &6surround them with wool&r to deactivate them.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests4.d: The &eWarden&r pulls no punches. It is easily capable of killing the unprepared witch in a single hit, and it is &aincredibly sturdy&r. However, with the right preparation one might be able to face it!
The &eWarden&r is blind, and will seek out players by &asmell and hearing&r. If it does not detect any players for one minute, it will &aburrow back underground&r.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests5.d: Wanna show off that you're made of tough stuff? Defeat 100 Wardens to win a &aprestigious &bArmor set&r and &bunique Head&r.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests6.d: The &cOtherside&r is a dark and dangerous place. It's likely you &awon't be able to see&r more than a few feet ahead of you.
Thankfully, the &bWarden Helmet&r will alleviate this issue.
Within the Otherside are &athree different biomes&r, each rather unwelcoming.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests7.d: In order to brave the &cOtherside&r, you will want to be very geared up in general, but the piece of armor you'll need most is the &bWarden Helmet&r.
Aside from its defense and armor toughness, it grants &bimmunity to Darkness&r, allowing you to see.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests8.d: You've found your way into an &bAncient City&r. Good luck adventurer, for here lie many treasures and equally many dangers.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.quests9.d: &bAncient Vases&r are loot containers which can contain &bWarden Carapaces&r in rare instances. This may help you to &acraft the Warden Helmet&r before killing the &eWarden&r.
However, be wary, as &aeach time a Vase is broken&r, there is a chance to spawn &eThe Stalker&r, which is a relative of the &eWarden&r.
In the &cheart of the Ancient City&r there is a &amassive portal&r. In order to use it, you must first &6clear away the &bSculk Veins&r.
Once it's clear, you can &6right click it&r with the &bHeart of the Deep&r to activate it.
Encounter a &bGeyser&r, a block which will &aboost you into the air&r and &agrant you Slow Falling&r for a time.
Defeat the &eSculk Centipedes&r of the &cDeeplands&r to obtain &bSculk Bones&r.
\"But wait,\" I hear you said. \"Centipedes don't have bones!\"
To which I reply, \"&aThey do if they've eaten recently&r.\" Obtain these items from their bellies, as they are &aprecious indeed&r.
Obtain &bSoul Dust&d from the &eLeechers&r and &eSnappers&r, a &bSoul Crystal&r from defeating &eStalkers&r, and &bSculk Bones&r from defeated &eSculk Centipedes&r.
Once you have these ingredients, you can convert your &bElytra&r to a &bSoul Elytra&r, which grants boosts randomly when you are midair, &anegating the need for many fireworks&r.
This biome often generates in layers consisting of &bSculk, Sculk Stone, and Echo Soil&r. Echo trees populate the biome making The Otherside more vibrant with their purple leaves and &bSculk Gleam&r. The fog color in this biome is purple much like the leaves, and &athe only mobs that spawn here are &eShattered&r, which makes this biome a pleasant change from the many horrors of the Otherside Deeplands.
However, this area is &anot safe from the &eWarden&r.
The &cOvercast Columns&r are a vast, uninhabited wasteland. They are composed of multiple amber columns, which have a biome-exclusive &bCrystallized Amber&r block in each of them. Overcast Columns also have multiple &bGeysers&r scattered throughout the terrain, which is composed of &bGloomslate&r and &bGloom Sculk&r. Nothing is known to live here due to the &ahostile and barren nature&r of the environment.
The first biome is called &cOtherside Deeplands&r. The Deeplands are made up of mostly &bSculk&r and &bSculk Stone&r. Large groups of &ePhantoms&r can be seen flying around the caverns of this biome, along with hordes of &eSculk Snappers&r. &bSculk Jaws&r and &bInfested Sculk&r are very common in the Deeplands, making it more &adifficult to navigate&r. Beware of the &eShriekworms&r which lay beneath the &bInfested Sculk&r, waiting to strike.
The &eWarden&r can be summoned here, as well.
Within the &cOtherside Deeplands&r, one can find an &aAncient Temple&r. These structures are filled with the &aspoils of those who came before&r.
In the &dcenter of the temple&r, there are some blocks which, when broken, allow you to &6descend further into the Temple&r.
Don't ask me why, but I &aneed a bunch of &bHearts of the Deep&r. Trade them to me using this &arepeatable quest&r and I will give you some sculk-tastic rewards.
cottagewitch.deeper_and_darker.title: Deep Dark
cottagewitch.exploration.quests0.descrip: Congratulations on entering the Overworld for the first time! It's good to have you here. You can &6use these quests as a sort of guide&r to help you through mods you might not be familiar with!
You now have a &bbackpack&r to help ease your loot goblin woes - take &avery good care of it&r because &dthe only place to obtain &bBackpacks&r is from &cEnd City&r chests!

This quest also grants you an &bAkashic Tome&r, which contains guidebooks to mods in the pack. &lIf you ever lose your Akashic Tome&r, you can easily &6craft a new one&r with a &bBook&r and a &bStick&r.

Your most useful tool is &lJEI&r, a mod that appears on the right of your inventory screen. It will let you view all the items in the modpack, and their recipes. &6Please explore this to see what is on offer&r!
cottagewitch.exploration.quests0.title: Begin your World
cottagewitch.exploration.quests1.descrip: So, you died. It happens to us all, eventually! Don't worry, all your items are safe in a &agrave&r marking your last resting place.

You can use your &bGrave Finder&r to locate your last death, as well as the &aminimap marker&r that's automatically placed there. Then, &6right click on your grave&r to recover all your items and gear.
Your &aexperience&r, however, drops near your grave, so make sure to collect it!
cottagewitch.exploration.quests1.title: Baby's First Death
cottagewitch.exploration.quests2.descrip: Let's face it, sometimes you want to live somewhere cute right away. And in survival, you rarely have the resources to do so.
So, if you'd like a &aprefabricated starter house&r, then &6tick off this quest&r and &6redeem the reward&r. If not, you can safely ignore this! Both methods are perfectly valid. :)
cottagewitch.exploration.quests3.descrip: Would you like a Mushroom Hat? Cool! Click the box above.
Be careful, because if you place it on the ground &dit will turn into a pumpkin&r. And it doesn't even need to be midnight.
cottagewitch.exploration.quests3.title: Mushroom Hat
cottagewitch.exploration.quests4.descrip: Congratulations on cheating death! Sorry about your totem, though.
cottagewitch.exploration.quests5.descrip: 50 deaths, and you're just getting started! Congrats...I guess? Anyway, here &6take this Totem&r, it seems like you need it.
cottagewitch.exploration.quests5.title: Die 50 Times
cottagewitch.exploration.quests6.descrip: Wow, you went a long while without dying! Nice work, buddy. Keep it up!
cottagewitch.exploration.quests6.title: Survival Skills
cottagewitch.exploration.quests7.descrip: Need to get somewhere in a hurry? Why not try &aslinging&r? The &bSlime Sling&r, when &6pointed at the ground and drawn&r, will shoot the player in the opposite direction upon release.
You can achieve &aquite a bit of air time&r this way! And the &bSlime Boots&r make it so you...you know...&adon't die from fall damage&r. A winning combination!
cottagewitch.exploration.subtitle0: a very good place to start
cottagewitch.exploration.title: Beginnings
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests0.des: You've obtained some &bseeds&r, congratulations! The first step of becoming a successful farmer (or Green Witch) is to have something to plant.
As a reward, try this &bRich Soil&r. It can be crafted from &bOrganic Compost&r, and is great for planting crops on!
It will &aperiodically grant a growth boost&r to crops (when it's provided with water) and it &acannot be trampled&r. It &acan also be used to grow &bMushroom Colonies&r in complete darkness.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests1.des: Mushroom colonies can be &agrown in complete darkness&r using &bRich Soil&r. If you &6harvest one with shears&r, you will get the whole colony. &6Harvest it with your hand&r and you will get up to 5 mushrooms. Hooray for mush!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests2.des: &bPies&r from this mod can be eaten one of two ways. You can place them down like a &bcake&r and eat them slice-by-slice, or you can place them on a &bCutting Board&r and use that to cut them into &bportable slices&r.
When eaten, they grant you a short speed boost!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests2.sub: Tastes so good, makes a grown man cry
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests3.des: &bStraw&r can be used to make &bRope&r, which is very useful. It can also be used to make &bCanvas&r, &bCompost&r, and building materials such as &bDaub&r.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests3.sub: Just don't draw the short one
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests4.des: &bCanvas&r is a versatile material which can create &bMats&r, &bSigns&r, and more!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests4.sub: A blank canvas is a powerful thing
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests5.des: &bRope&r can be used to make tools such as the &bSafety Net&r, which &anegates falling damage when landed on&r. It can also be crafted into &bRope Arrows&r, which will unroll a length of rope to the ground beneath where the arrow lands, allowing you to climb up it.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests6.des: Crops can be easily compacted into Bags or Crates in order to &asave on storage space&r. &6Place 9 of each item in a Crafting Grid&r to obtain a Crate or Bag of it!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests7.des: This pack adds a number of new crop types! Wild versions of these can be found throughout the world while exploring, and then you can plant them in your garden at home.
-&bRice&r can be found in &cWet biomes&r, but only above ground.
-&bOnions&r grow &ceverywhere&r except Mushroom Biomes and Lush Caves.
- You can find &bGinger&r in &chot climates&r, look for red flowering leaves!
- And finally, &bMint&r can be found in &cCold biomes&r, and will &aspread to a 5x5 region when planted&r.
- &bEggplant&r and &bAvocado&r can be found in &cJungle&r biomes.
- &bCave Carrots&r can be found &cunderground&r, except in Lush Caves.
- &bLimes&r are located solely in &cFlower Forest&r biomes, and require &apollination by &eBees&r to produce fruit.
- &bPomegranates&r can only be found in &cWarped Forest&r biomes, and either need to be &agrown in the &cNether&r, or &arequire &apollination by &eBees&r to produce fruit.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests8.des: With this mod, crops have a small chance of spawning &agiant crops&r, similar to Stardew Valley. This is most likely to &a happen to fully grown crops exposed to Moonlight&r.

Break them with a &bHoe&r to get significantly more regular crops than usual. Break them with an &bAxe&r or your hand to obtain the Crop Block itself. You can then &aCook&r them, &aPeel&r them, or place them on a &bCutting Board&r to gather the crops from them.
And you even have a chance of Overweight Crops when using &bPlanters&r!
&bRich Farmland&r has an increased chance of spawning Overweight Crops.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests9.des: The &bStraw Hat&r can be bartered from &aFarmer Villagers&r. It will give you a bonus to plant growth and an extra chance at &aOverweight Crops&r!
It also gives a chance of breeding twins or triplets! ...of the animals. Not you. Probably.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests9.sub: It's called fashion, sweaty, look it up
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests10.de: Peel your &bOverweight Crops&r to obtain different appearances, and gain &bVegetable Peels&r, which can be made into &bCompost&r or fed to &ePigs&r!
Peeled &bMelons&r can have their seeds removed with an &bAxe&r, and then juiced by &6right clicking them with a bottle&r.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests11.de: The &bPlanter&r is useful both as a decorative block, and as a utility. It can grow crops without the need for water, and without the danger of being trampled.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests12.de: They say not to waste your diamonds on a hoe. But you've taken this a step further.
To honor your commitment, please take this reward.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests13.de: Gather &6one of each kind of &bOverweight Crop&r, which can be used as decoration, or &6cut on a &bCutting Board&r.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests14.de: Have you &6automated your farm&r? Then you probably know the pain of excessive crop ownership. &6Submit your crops to this quest&r to earn rewards.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests15.de: Similar to &bCrates&r, many crops can be compacted into &bSacks&r. These can be used decoratively, or &aused to free up storage space&r!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests16.de: There's a way to &agrow crops more quickly&r. If you &6craft some compost&r and then &6place it near a water source&r, it will slowly turn into &bRich Soil&r. This process can be &asped up using &bTime in a Bottle&r.
Once tilled, &bRich Soil&r will &agrant extra growth&r ticks to your plants. It also &acannot be trampled&r, and &adoes not require water&r.
You'll also want it if you're planning on growing any &bMushroom Colonies&r.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests17.de: Much like its browner brother, &bRich Soul Soil&r is formed of &bSoil Compost&r that has been &aleft adjacent to Lava&r.
You can use it to grow &bNether Crops&r more quickly!
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests19.de: The &bReaping Tool&r, known in some circles as a Scythe, allows you to perform a finicky sort of magic known as &aReaping&r.

One &6right clicks&r with the &bScythe&r to reap an animal. If successful, you will &aobtain its drops without killing it&r, instead stealing its youth and transforming it into a baby. However, if you are unsuccessful, &anature takes its course&r.
You can ensure &abetter chances of success&r with &bbetter materials&r, with &bNetherite&r giving you a near 100%% success rate. &6Hover and hold shift&r over each tool to see the base failure rate.
This ritual does not work on mobs with no baby stage, such as &eCod&r. It also does not work on &ehostile mobs&r, even if they DO have a baby stage.
If you &dreap a baby animal, it does die&r, so don't be greedy! Remember, the key to sustainable agriculture is to &aharvest responsibly&r.
Placing a &bReaping Tool&r into an &bEnchanting Table&r results in &dUnbreaking only, 99%% of the time&r. It's better to enchant it with books.
&bReaping Tools&r can be enchanted with &aMending, Sharpness, and Unbreaking&r, as you might expect.
However, they can also be enchanted with &aExecutioner&r, which &dcurrently has no effect&r.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests20.de: You know what's the spice of life? Variety. And you know who loves spice? You guessed it - &ebees&r.
Oh, that's not what you guessed?
Well, nevermind that. Collect one of each type of &bBeehive&r, and see how much your &eBees&r will appreciate it.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.quests21.de: These &bCarts&r are useful for transporting &aitems and entities&r. &6Press \"r\"&r by default when either mounted or on foot to &ahaul the cart&r. Press R again to set it down.

The &bSupply Cart&r is fairly self-explanatory. &6Shift right click the cart&r to access its inventory, and &aload it up with items&r! You can then transport those items over land. However, &abreaking the cart&r will drop its inventory.
The &bAnimal Cart&r will help you &atransport entities&r! &6Right click the cart item&r onto the creature you want to move. Then, haul as normal. &aBreak the cart&r to free the animal.
cottagewitch.farmers_delight.title: Farming \& Gardening
You can now &ago fishing in lava&r! Grab yourself a &bLava Fishing Rod&r and cast your line! You'll find you can catch some &areally interesting new fish&r.
While you can still fish with a plain old &bFishing Rod&r, you can get much better results by crafting an advanced version, such as an &bIron&r, &bGold&r, or &bDiamond Fishing Rod&r.
At first glance, they don't seem all that different, but &dobtain a Tackle Box&r and you'll get more perspective on how much better these &bFishing Rods&r can be.
Why use a rod when you can just dive in to hit 'em with your sword? Well, some fish &ado not spawn in the world and can only be caught on a line&r.
Persephone would surely be proud of you!
A pomegranate branch brings undiscovered wealth or new riches to the owner. You can also use dried pomegranate skins in abundance incenses.
Write a question on a fig leaf to receive a divinatory answer. If the leaf dries out slowly, then the answer is yes. If it dries out quickly, it's no, or is a bad omen. I'm not sure how quickly fig leaves are supposed to dry, though.
A spell for curing toothache is to drive a nail into the trunk of a lime tree - but you must thank the lime tree first!
Cooking with Portobello mushrooms can be powerful magic if you are in need of emotional healing.
Historically, witches danced beneath the boughs of the walnut tree. It is also said that giving someone a bag of walnuts will make all their dreams come true. This works especially well if their dream was to own a bag of walnuts.
It is said that wolfberry allows for deep inner processing to happen without the need to consciously confront it.
Scattered around the world, you can find &bWild Crops&r growing.
Find all of them to build your &alovely witchy garden&r!
Did you know that corn hung over a mirror will bring good luck to your household?
Take a small white onion and stick it full of black-headed pins. When placed in the window, this will protect against negativity.
And carrots are said to promote... physical desire. *wink*
You can find &bEggplant&r in &cJungles&r, &bCucumber&r in &cSwamps&r, &bCorn&r in &cPlains&r, and &bAvocado&r in &cJungles&r.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests10: Lucky you, you found a &bMessage in a Bottle&r! What does it say?
I hope that someone gets my
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests11: The lava pools at the base of the &cNether&r are surprisingly full of life! Using a &bspecial Fishing Rod&r, you can &areel them in&r and enjoy the fruits of your labor!
Many of the fish can either be &acooked&r or &aprocessed into other byproducts&r. Use &lJEI&r to see what can be done with each fish!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests12: These fish live in &cFreshwater-containing biomes&r such as rivers, forests, and so on!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests13: These fish can be found in &cCold or Icy&r biomes such as Taigas, Ice Spikes, or Cold Oceans.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests14: These fish live in &cSaltwater biomes&r such as Lukewarm or Warm Oceans.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests15: Although you cannot &afillet&r the &bGoldfish&r, you can extract gold from it! Although, honestly, I'd probably just hang it on the wall with an &bitem frame&r.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests16: The &bShrooma&r can both be caught in &cMushroom Islands&r.
The &bStarshell Turtle&r can be found anywhere in the &cTwilight Forest&r.
The &bBox Turtle&r and &bLeech&r are found exclusively in &cSwamp biomes&r.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests17: These fish can be found near &cArid biomes&r such as Deserts or Plateaus.
always arid on the side of caution
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests18: These fish can be found in &cJungle-type&r biomes such as Rainforests or, well, Jungles!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests19: The &bTackle Box&r allows you to modify your new &bFishing Rod&r. Simply &6place the rod in the upper right slot&r, and you can now add a &bHook&r, some &bBait&r, a &bBobber&r, and &bFishing Line&r. These items will determine the performance of your Fishing Rod.
The &bBobbers&r and &bFishing Line&r can be colored, and are &acosmetic changes only&r.
&bBait&r can either be caught (Minnows, Leeches) or made (Worms). Bait will draw more fish to your line! It has durability, but can be &aEnchanted&r to make it sturdier.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests20: The &bWorm Farm&r gives you easy access to the most basic fishing bait. It works almost identically to a &bCompost Bin&r (because it is). &6Fill it with organic material&r to create compost for your &bWorms&r to live in.
Once you have enough compost, &6right click with an empty hand&r to dig out some &bWorms&r!
Also, in a delightful twist, you &acan Enchant your Worms&r to give them extra durability, and even &aMending&r.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests21: You can craft a &bBobber&r and &bFishing Line&r to customize your &bFishing Rod&r! These can be dyed any color, and are a cosmetic only change.
note: the &bFishing Line&r and &bUnbreakable Fishing Line&r are unrelated items. The latter is a meant to be &6equipped in your Curios&r.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests22: To fish properly, you'll need a &bHook&r. The Iron Hook grants &aDurability&r to your rod. By default, there is a 20%% chance not to use durability.
fits on your rod, not on your hand!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests23: Iron Hook not cutting it anymore? &aUpgrade your hook&r to one of these!
&bDouble Hook&r: Gives a chance to catch 2 things!
&bDiamond Hook&r: Increased chance to not use durability when fishing.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests24: Different &bHooks&r give different effects. Some are pure upgrades, but these will &agrant other effects&r!
&bHeavy Hook&r: Has a shorter cast range than other hooks.
&bRedstone Hook&r: Gives you longer to reel in a fish, helpful if you have difficulty reacting quickly.
&bNote Hook&r: Plays a note when a fish is approaching. Useful if you're not paying full attention, or have particles disabled.
&bLight Hook&r: Allows you to cast farther.
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests25: Are you drowning in &bNether Stars&r? Sure, we all are. Make this hook and get a bonus to durability and luck!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests26: You can reel in more than just aquatic creatures. Sometimes, you'll catch &bitems&r - these can be fun, like &bMessages in a Bottle&r, or disappointing, like &bDriftwood&r.
Three of these are loot containers. The &bBox&r is likely to contain &alittle of value&r - rocks, gravel, and so on.
The &bLockbox&r may contain ores or nuggets or other &aslightly valuable things&r.
The &bTreasure Chest&r can contain things like &agreater ores or gems&r.
There may be even greater, rarer treasures to be found...
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests27: The ultimate rod! The &bNeptunium Rod&r has more durability and is more enchantable than any other rod. It's also inherently more attractive to fish somehow.
the rod of ol' neptune himself
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests28: Where are all the fish...? &lAquaculture&r fish &ado not spawn in the world&r, you can only &6fish them up&r.
Don't worry though, they aren't dead- only sleeping! &6Combine that fish with a water bucket&r to wake them right up.

If you'd like something with a bit more pizazz, you can &6strike a dead fish with lightning&r to get its heart pumping. Make sure you have a bucket ready though- or you &dmay end up with a cooked fish&r!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests29: Hats! Who doesn't live the simple pleasure of a Nice Hat? &lSimple Hats&r is just that: hats, nothing else. These are exclusively equipped in your Head curio slot, and can &aonly be found through fishing&r (or a lucky neptunian chest).
Each regular hatbag contains one hat of corresponding rarity: Common, &eUncommon&r, &bRare&r, and &dEpic&r!

You also have a chance to find &bseasonal exclusives&r: Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter. These are only available for a 2-week period each (northern hemisphere) season! During those periods you will have a 100%% chance of getting a &bseasonal hat&r with your regular hat!
Some hats may allow further customizations, such as &adyeing&r or &avariant-cycling&r. Both of these tasks can be accomplished &6in a crafting grid&r!
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.quests30: Maybe you're feeling overencumbered with hats... or perhaps you just have a hat you &oreally hate&r. Time to clean up your storage space and &aupcycle those lids&r!
&6Place the&r &bhat&r &6and&r &ba pair of shears&r &6into a crafting grid&r. This will give you a &bHat Scrap&r. You can do two things with that hat scrap:
&6Combine 4 of them&r in a crafting menu to get a &bnew hatbag&r of that type:
Or &6combine 2 of them&r to get 1 &oupgraded&r &bhat scrap&r.
Unfortunately, &dEpic Hats&r are not able to be broken down as they are too epic.
I'm down to my ankles in hats
cottagewitch.fishing__gathering.title: Fishing \& Gathering
cottagewitch.for_og.quests0.description0: You can use the &bBrewing Cauldron&r to create a few &aunique &bPotions&r to help you in combat.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests0.description1: These are: &bArmor&r, &bDamage&r, and &bFeral&r (which combines the two). They can be brewed in normal and &blarge&r variants.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests0.title: Brewing Unique Potions
cottagewitch.for_og.quests1.description0: Every witch should be familiar with &aBrewing&r! The creation of &bPotions&r is a key aspect in magical livelihood, as it can significantly improve how one interacts with the world around them!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests1.subtitle: bubble bubble
cottagewitch.for_og.quests1.title: Beginner Brewing
cottagewitch.for_og.quests2.description0: It's said that there is a method by which one can condense &bknowledge&r, the very essence of our lives, into a &bliquid&r. It is known that one absorbs the &bexperience&r from &aslain foes&r and even from &aprocessing raw materials&r found in the wild. But what if you could &atransfer and hoard that &bknowledge&r?
cottagewitch.for_og.quests2.description1: Preliminary studies indicate that to begin such a process requires &bCognitive Flux&r, which is crafted from ingredients with &ahigh amounts of magical vibration&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests2.subtitle: what an experience
cottagewitch.for_og.quests2.title: The Beginning of Cognition
cottagewitch.for_og.quests3.description0: &bCognitive flux&r, by itself, is a &aloose and crumbly substance&r, and not much use for anything. However, it may be &6fired in a furnace or blast furnace&r to produce &bCognitive Amalgam&r, a much more durable and useful material.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests4.description0: &bCognitive amalgam&r can be &afurther combined&r with &bIron&r to derive a strong and rigid alloy well-suited for &amanufacturing devices&r, or with &bEmerald&r, to produce crystals remarkably suited for &atransmitting and receiving cognitium&r without the need of pipes.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests4.title: Stronger Cognition
cottagewitch.for_og.quests5.description0: The &bEnlightened Amulet&r is an item that, when active, &avacuums up all XP orbs in a 6 block radius&r and combines them into single orb at the player's position.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests5.description1: The amulet will be active &aanywhere in your inventory&r. It can be activated and inactivated by &6shift right clicking&r while holding it.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests6.description0: The &bExperience Fountain&r also provides players with an easy way to obtain &bCognitium Buckets&r or &bBottles o' Enchanting&r. Provided the bound obelisk has enough Cognitium, &6right-click a fountain with an empty bucket or an empty bottle&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests7.description0: The &bExperience Fountain&r is a device that &adispenses experience orbs&r from its top surface. This device needs to be &6bound to a nearby Obelisk by means of a &bStaff of Attunement&r in order to function. The fountain will deduct experience from the bound obelisk as it does so. The Fountain has four modes of operation:
cottagewitch.for_og.quests7.description5: These modes can by cycled by &6right-clicking the fountain&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests7.description6: The Fountain must be &6activated by a neighboring redstone signal&r, or by &6standing on it&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests8.description0: The &bAstute Assembly&r is a mystically-charged device which is used to craft items which &arun on liquid Cognitium&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description0: The &bPrecision Dispeller&r is an incredibly powerful item which allows you to &aremove both Enchantments and &bCurses&r from your items.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description1: When you &6select an enchantment to remove&r, you'll receive an &bExperience&r refund which is slightly greater than that which a &bGrindstone&r would give.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description2: To remove a curse, however, you will &6pay experience&r to remove it.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description3: Should you want to, the &bPrecision Dispeller&r can be &abound to an &bObelisk&a using a &bStaff of Attunement&r. When bound, &aexperience gained will be added to the Obelisk&r internal reservoir instead of being released as XP orbs.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description4: Likewise, the XP cost from curse removal will first be &adeducted from the Obelisk&r, and only deducted from the player if the amount of XP in the Obelisk is insufficient.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.description5: The XP returns and XP cost are &ashown in points&r, as well as base levels (the number of levels you would have if you started at 0 levels and gained that amount of points). Base levels are absolute and &ddo not scale with however much XP is on your person&r. So if you were to have 50 levels on your person, and remove a curse with a base level cost of 30, you would be left with around 44 levels. &dThis is intentional and not a bug&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests9.subtitle: deleting enchantments and curses
cottagewitch.for_og.quests10.description: The &bExperience Obelisk&r is a device that lets you easily &astore and retrieve experience&r. Every point of experience is converted into &b20mB of Cognitium&r, which is then stored in the Obelisk's internal reservoir. This fluid can be transferred to external tanks or elsewhere using fluid pipes. Each Obelisk can store 100,000,000 mB of Cognitium — which translates to &ajust over 1072 XP levels&r.

The &bObelisk&r stores not only &bCognitium&r, but also &bliquid experience&r from &lSophisticated Storage&r. The difference is that &bCognitium&r is magically charged as opposed to &bExperience&r, and as such, once &bliquid Experience&r is processed via the Obelisk, it never loses its charge, and remains &bCognitium&r forevermore.
The Obelisk will also passively &avacuum up all experience orbs in a set radius&r, adding them to its internal storage. This can be &aconfigured in the Obelisk's gui&r.

Upon right-clicking the block, you are presented with the following 6 options to store or retrieve XP. Since minecraft XP does not work in a linear fashion, with &aeach level being worth more&r the higher they get, all XP values are &dfrom the players' perspective&r. That is to say, if you had 30 levels and chose to store 10 in an empty obelisk, you would be left with 20 levels, but the Obelisk GUI would read 24 levels - since each individual level is worth more the higher you go.

In this second image, you can adjust the &arange of the exp vacuum&r, and whether or not it is active based on &aredstone signal&r. If set to \"Ignore,\" it will &abe passively active&r all the time. If \"Enabled,\" it will &aonly activate when receiving redstone signal&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests10.title: The Experience Obelisk
cottagewitch.for_og.quests11.description: The &bStaff of Attunement&r is a handheld device used for &abinding Cognitium-consuming blocks&r - such as an &bExperience Fountain&r or &bPrecision Dispelle&rr - to a nearby &bExperience Obelisk&r.

&6Shift right click an Obelisk with a &bStaff of Attunement&r in order to &asave its location&r to the staff. Afterwards, any XP-consuming block that you &6shift right click&r with the staff will be bound to the saved obelisk. Repeat the process on either block to &aundo the binding&r.
This binding interaction has a &dmaximum range of 32 blocks&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests12.description: Although it doesn't provide &amuch protection&r, this outfit will have you &aslingin' dishes&r and &aslicin' fishes&r like a pro!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests12.title: Looking like a Cook
cottagewitch.for_og.quests13.description: How you eat is almost as important as what you eat! For example, food is far more satisfying when eaten off of a &bTable Set&r. Place down these 3 items on a surface, and then &6right click your meal onto the &bplate&r
Then you can &6right click to eat&r, and you'll get &agreater saturation&r than if you'd eaten it with your fingers (you mongrel).
cottagewitch.for_og.quests13.title: Setting the Table
cottagewitch.for_og.quests14.description: The &bCopper Cooking Pot&r and &bCopper Cooking Pan&r are new tools which will allow you to make &anew and unique dishes&r, such as &bPasta&r and &bPizza&r!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests14.title: Cooking with Copper
cottagewitch.for_og.quests15.description: &bButter&r half of food's bread and butter! It's excellent on &bToast&r, &bLobster&r, and... really, basically anything.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests15.subtitle: buttuh
cottagewitch.for_og.quests15.title: Obtain Butter
cottagewitch.for_og.quests16.description: &bSpaghetti Bolognese&r is a delicious and hearty treat. To make it, you'll need to gather and prepare the ingredients!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests16.title: The Path to Bolognese
cottagewitch.for_og.quests17.description: Have you ever had &bBolognese sauce&r? It's delicious even on its own! But don't eat it just yet, we have plans for it...
cottagewitch.for_og.quests17.title: Making the Sauce
cottagewitch.for_og.quests18.description: And you've done it! &aEnjoy the fruits&r - or, well, pasta - &aof your labor&r!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests18.subtitle: success!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests21.description: To begin with the delicious art of &aBakery&r, there are a few tools one will need. The &bCaking Station&r, the &bSmall Cooking Pot&r, and, of course, an &bOven&r.
Each of these tools will allow you to do unique things.
The &bSmall Cooking Pot&r allows you to create delectable &bJams&r and &bChocolate Spreads&r and such.
The &bOven&r allows you to bake &bBreads&r, &bBuns&r, &bTarts&r, and &bmore&r!
The &bCaking Station&r is for the creation of &bCakes&r, &bCookies&r, and &bCupcakes&r!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests21.title: Baking Time
cottagewitch.for_og.quests22.description: Hmm, looks like a &bJar of Chocolate Spread&r is exactly what we're going to need for the next recipe.
Well, don't just stand there looking at me. &6Get cooking&r!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests23.description: Ah, here we are! Combine the &bChocolate Spread&r and &bCake Dough&r you made in a &bBaking Station&r.
An indulgent treat, this &bChocolate Cake&r should keep you sated for a while!

Or, if you're so inclined, you could &aprogress to the next quest&r and &afind a way to &6display it&r! Actually, here, take these two &bCake Slices&r. That way you can &aeat your cake, and have it, too&r.
Yes, I know that's now how the phrase goes. But if you think about it, it really makes more sense this way.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests24.description: Using the tools you just acquired, you can now make &bStrawberry Jam!&r
cottagewitch.for_og.quests25.description: A &bStrawberry Cupcake&r is one of many things you can make with &bSweet Dough&r, and also uses the delicious &bStrawberry Jam&r you made in the last quest!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests26.description: &bSweet Dough&r is the basis for many delicious pastries. The aspiring Kitchen Witch would do well to familiarize themself with its recipe!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests26.subtitle: sweet, dough!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests27.description: The &bWall Bread Display&r can be used to show off your &bBreads&r from the &lBakery&r mod!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests28.description: This &bBrick Sink&r is a one-block &ainfinite water source&r! Simply &6right click it&r to turn on the faucet and &afill it with water&r, then &6right click it with a &bBucket&r or &bBottle&r to collect the water!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests28.subtitle: everything AND the kitchen sink
cottagewitch.for_og.quests28.title: Obtain a Sink
cottagewitch.for_og.quests29.description: The &bCrafting Bowl&r is a ubiquitous kitchen tool used to &amix together ingredients&r for things such as &bDough&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests29.subtitle: get crafty
cottagewitch.for_og.quests30.description: To make &bCakes&r, you'll first need to &ainvent the universe&r. Wait, no, that's pies. With cakes you just need &bCake Dough&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests31.description: You can &adisplay your delicious &bpastries&r using a &bCake Stand&r, &bCupcake Display&r, or &bCake Display&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests31.title: Displaying Your Pastries
cottagewitch.for_og.quests32.description: This &bItem Display&r will allow you to, well, display any &bitems&r, &das long as they don't have a &aBlock form&r. For example, you can display a &bCupcake&r or a &bPickaxe&r, but not a &bCake&r or a &bDiamond Block&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests33.description: The &bCheese Press&r is a rudimentary machine which will help &acondense your Milk into Cheese&r. Although you can also achieve this via a &bMechanical Press&r from Create, it's always good to know the original methods of doing something!
Simply place your &bMilk&r and your &bRennet&r into the Press and then &6wait patiently&r (or use Time in a Bottle) for it to work its magic.
Different &atypes of Milk&r will make unique cheeses... but more on that elsewhere!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests33.subtitle: press cheese everyday
cottagewitch.for_og.quests33.title: Obtain a Cheese Press
cottagewitch.for_og.quests34.description: It might take a while, but why not &acollect all &bCheese&r types and have yourself a little tasting?
cottagewitch.for_og.quests34.subtitle: it's not easy being cheesy
cottagewitch.for_og.quests34.title: Collect All Cheeses
cottagewitch.for_og.quests35.description: &bRennet&r is a substance rendered from... actually, you know what? Let's not go into the details.
The important part is that it makes &bCheese&r. Which you can now do! Well, once you &amake a Cheese Press&r. Let's do that now!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests36.description: &bSalt&r is an important ingredient in &bCheesemaking&r. It can be found in &cMeadow biomes&r, embedded in &bLimestone&r.
Place this, alongside some &bRaw Beef&r and a &bGlass Bottle&r, inside a &bCauldron&r to make &bRennet&r, the next step in acquiring the most delicious food group: Cheese.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests36.subtitle: getting salty
cottagewitch.for_og.quests36.title: Obtain Alpine Salt
cottagewitch.for_og.quests37.description: Witches are no strangers to &bCauldrons&r, and they know very well that you should never brew and cook in the same place! Hence why you should &aget yourself a &bRustic Cauldron&r, to help you in making some brand new recipes.
This cooking device will help you to &arender &bRennet&r, but it can also &acook simple meats&r and even make some delicious...&abear related foods&r? Hmm.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests37.title: Obtain a Rustic Cauldron
cottagewitch.for_og.quests38.description: To enjoy a lovely &bFondue&r, simply &6place Bread above and Cheese below&r, and enjoy your tasty, molten treat.
Better blow on it a bit first. That stuff is like lava.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests38.subtitle: well that's a 'fon' how 'due' you do
cottagewitch.for_og.quests39.description: You did it! You've finally obtained the holy grail of foods: &bcheese&r. There are a number of incredible dishes which can be made with &ole fromage&r (pardon my French), but why not go straight to the source and make some &bFondue&r?
To &aobtain &bCheese Pieces&r, &6place down&r your Cheese Wheel and &6right click&r it with an empty hand.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests39.subtitle: that's the stuff, gromit!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests39.title: Obtain a Cheese Wheel
cottagewitch.for_og.quests40.description: There are a bunch of different types of &bMilk&r, which can all be made into &aunique and tasty cheeses&r.

Although most of them come from &adifferent types of &eAnimals&r, you can also craft &bGrain Milk&r (vegan-friendly!) and &bAmethyst Milk&r. These last two types of milk are crafted using the &bRustic Cauldron&r. Grain milk is made with 2 Grains and one Wooden Water Bucket. Amethyst milk is made with Amethyst and, well, milk...
&eWater Buffalo&r can be found in &cRiver&r biomes.
&eWarped Cows&r can be found in &cWarped Forest&r biomes.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests40.title: Many Milk Types!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests41.subtitle: i am perfectly clam
cottagewitch.for_og.quests41.title: Obtain Shellfish
cottagewitch.for_og.quests42.description: To begin your &acrabby journey&r, you will need a &bCrab Trap&r. Place it in the water and &afill it with bait&r to lure in creatures.
You can use &bregular Fish&r as bait to obtain &bKelp and Nautilus Shells&r, but if you want to catch &eCrabs&r, &bClams&r, &bShrimp&r, or &bClawsters&r, you'll need &b&lChum&r&r.
cottagewitch.for_og.quests42.subtitle: it's a trap!
cottagewitch.for_og.quests42.title: Beginner Crabbing
cottagewitch.for_og.quests43.title: Compact Your Marine Life
cottagewitch.for_og.title: for og
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests0.descr: Is there much overlap between Ninjas and Witches? I'm not sure, but this armor is pretty cool, so why not stop asking questions and just do the quest, eh? Whippersnapper. Go &6climb 90,000cm&r to prove your worth.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests0.title: Witch of the Hidden Leaf Village
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests1.descr: Congratulations, you have opened 10 trapped chests! An achievement worth celebrating. Now heal up.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests1.title: Unlucky or just Ignorant
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests2.descr: This quaint &cFisherman's Lodge&r is water-bound, and is a great place to go fishing.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests3.descr: The &cAncient Mines&r been to be seen to be believed. A massive underground chasm, once inhabited by those who delved too greedily and too deep. Beware what now lives there.
&dCW: Giant Cave Centipedes&r. Although they are disabled in most of the modpack, this structure has a spawner for them. Be prepared, should you go inside.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests4.descr: The &cPillager Fortress&r is best taken on with a group of friends. However, a particularly capable or tenacious witch could certainly try to go it alone.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests5.descr: To find the &cLabyrinth of the Serpent&r, you must purchase a map from a Villager.
Beware, though. Within lie many dangers, and even a final boss!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests6.descr: This world has a ton of different structures for you to encounter! Some are dangerous, others contain only &amild peril&r.
Most of them contain &ajuicy loot&r! Why not try to find all of them?
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests7.descr: Locate the &cApothecary's Abode&r, a large structure filled with bizarre machines and absolutely loaded with &eIllagers&r.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests8.descr: Would your life be complete without visiting a &cWitch's Stump&r? No. Unfortunately the coven that makes their home there is an unfriendly one. But once you conquer them, you can use their items for your own purposes.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests9.descr: Climb the &cWizard's Tower&r and you may find what happened to its previous inhabitant. Also, beware of the basement.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests10.desc: The best witches are those who are worldly. As such, &6prove your mettle by traversing all vanilla biomes&r!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests12.desc: Discover an &cEnchanting Tower&r, a small but cozy spire featuring a magical twist.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests13.desc: The &bCastle&r is home to several friendly &eVillagers&r, and their ruler sits atop a throne of stone.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests14.desc: Discover &cThe Catacombs&r, which are absolutely &acrawling with undead&r, but may have hidden treasures inside!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests15.desc: Find a &cFortress of the Undead&r, and survive!*
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests16.desc: What an odd statue. Who made these, and for what purpose?
Place it under a noteblock to get a Vine Boom, or set a few near each other so they can chat. Moyai love company!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests17.desc: The beginning of your journey should bring you to a &cTower&r, looming over the surrounding lands. Found most often in plains, forests, and mountains, these Towers &ahold countless treasures&r, as well as a &bmap to the next dungeon...&r
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests18.desc: There are &athree types&r of &cReanimated Ruins&r. Which one you complete will determine which &anew map you unlock&r. You only need to find one to complete this quest, but if you wish to &aobtain all the unique artifacts&r, you'll need to &6seek out more ruins&r!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests19.desc: The journals from which I discovered these dungeons had this to say: \"This &cancient skeleton&r can be found in &cdeserts&r and hides a secret beneath. Explore the ancient temple and &afind the treasures that rest within&r. Legend has it that this is where the &bLeviathan Blade&r resides. Along with treasure, the &ehusks&r that spawn here are &acapable of dropping &bsand&r with their normal loot.\"
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests20.desc: The journals from which I discovered these dungeons had this to say: \"This &cabandoned temple of old&r has long since been taken over by &eStrays&r. At the top, you’ll find the &bFrosted Cowl&r to aid you in your combat. Strays spawned within this structure &acan drop &bice&r, or rarely &bpacked ice&r, on death, and they’re the only mob allowed to spawn inside.\"
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests20.subt: not to be confused with shirley temple
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests21.desc: The journals from which I discovered these dungeons had this to say: \"This shell of an &cundersea town&r is home to many axe-wielding &edrowned&r and provides a renewable source of &bcoral blocks&r. Weapons from a time forgotten, such as the &bWarped Axe&r, can still be found inside.\"
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests22.desc: The journals from which I discovered these dungeons had this to say: \"Once you defeat the dragon and gain access to the &couter islands&r, you may be lucky enough to find this &cdilapidated structure&r. There isn’t much loot inside, but at the top of the tower, you can find a &bdragon egg&r. Be careful though, the &eendermen&r inside &aaren’t quite as peaceful&r as the ones outside of the structure.\"
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests23.desc: The journals from which I discovered these dungeons had this to say: \"Found in the lava pools of the Nether’s &csoul sand valley&r, you may find this &cprison of souls&r. With the amount of &eghasts&r surrounding it, approaching and reaching the top for your reward may prove to be no small task. Be wary as the ghasts are not opposed to &adestroying the structure around you&r with their fireballs. Should you survive, you may walk out with a &bSoul Cannon&r.\"
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests24.desc: The &bExplorer's Compass&r replaces &bEnder Eyes&r as the primary way to locate &aStrongholds and other Structures&r.
Simply &6right click while holding it&r in order to search for the structure you want to find.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests24.titl: Find Structures with the Explorer's Compass
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests25.desc: The &bNature's Compass&r is a magical tool, similar to a &bDowsing Rod&r, which will allow you to find your way to a particular type of biome.
Simply &6right click while holding it&r in order to search for the biome you want to find.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests25.titl: Find Biomes with the Nature's Compass
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests27.desc: &bWarp Plates&r function alongside &bAttuned Shards&r to teleport you between two defined places. Once placed and right clicked, a Warp Plate will create an Attuned Shard which is bound to that Warp Plate. The Shard will be &ainscribed with unique runes&r that match those in the Plate's GUI upper right corner.
In you &6insert the shard into another Warp Plate&r, it will now teleport you to the Plate inscribed on that stone. You can create multiple Shards with &bFlint&r and &bWarp Dust&r.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests28.desc: &bWaystones&r are a method for fast travel between places in the world. Once a Waystone has been &aactivated&r, it can be ported to from any other Waystone, or using other methods.
&bWaystones&r generate naturally in &dVillages&r, but they can also be crafted.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests29.desc: The &bBound Scroll&r is a single-use item which can teleport to you &aa Waystone to which it is bound&r. Simply &6crouch and right click&r the Waystone to bind the scroll. Each scroll must be bound individually. However, you can craft &bReturn Scrolls&r and bind an entire stack at once.
Simply &6hold right click with it in your hand&r in order to activate it. If you take damage or let go while it is charging, &dthe warp will cancel&r.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests30.desc: The &bWarp Scroll&r is a one-time use item which can &awarp to any Waystone from anywhere in the world&r. It does not have a cooldown, but the item is consumed upon use.
Simply &6hold right click with it in your hand&r in order to activate it. If you take damage or let go while it is charging, &dthe warp will cancel&r.
These should not be confused with the &bWarp Scrolls&r from &dArs Nouveau&r, which have the same name but a different function.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests31.desc: The &bWarp Stone&r is an item which will allow you to &awarp to any Waystone from anywhere in the world&r. It is a multi-use item, which has a cooldown between uses.
Simply &6hold right click with it in your hand&r in order to activate it. If you take damage or let go while it is charging, &dthe warp will cancel&r.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests32.desc: The &bPortstone&r is a method of accessing Waystone travel, but cannot be traveled to, itself.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests33.desc: &bSharestones&r allow for travel &aonly within their colored network&r. From a Red Sharestone, you can teleport to any other Red Sharestone. However, you cannot do so from an Orange Sharestone.
This makes them very useful for having private or separate networks of travel. They cannot be accessed from &bWarp Stones&r or any &bScrolls&r.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests34.desc: Long ago, wandering tribes of &aVillagers&r mastered the art of &amagical flight&r, and now exist in &cfloating cities&r across the land.
If one were to have a &bflying Broomstick&r, one could easily reach such a place!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests35.desc: Craft yourself some &bRope Ladders&r and &bWooden Rails&r to carefully traverse difficult terrain - easy to make, easy to place, and able to &achain across air gaps&r without support blocks below them. Vertical and Horizontal travel has never been so handy! Both can be placed similarly to &bScaffolding&r- &6right click one onto another&r and they’ll build in the direction you face. You can even &apull your rope ladder up&r behind you by right clicking the top piece!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests35.titl: Obtain Rope Ladder and a Wooden Rail
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests36.desc: &bMagnetite&r generates in small clusters underground, surrounded by lava and deepslate iron, &aencased in a shell of obsidian&r. Harvest this rare ore with your Pickaxe to get magnetite chunks… or for &bMagnetite ore&r, use a Hammer + Chisel (or &asilk touch&r). Both of these items will help you discover some strangely attractive new crafting recipes!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests37.desc: Cozy up to some bears in this lovely little den in the woods! It's probably totally safe! They're harmless! Probably!
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests38.desc: The &cTinker's Workshop&r appears to be a fairly innocuous place upon first glance. Perhaps an &eEngineer&r once lived here. Or perhaps someone a little less... sane.
Beware of &ePillagers&r, and should you find any ladders down... well, &aproceed with caution&r. And maybe bring your broom.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests39.desc: Should you happen upon a very large wagon, be sure to greet its inhabitants! These &ejolly fellows&r are nomadic people &abringing gifts&r to adventurers far and wide.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.quests40.desc: &aDeep underground&r is the structure known as &cThe Nexus&r. This carved deepslate monstrosity contains broken portals to other worlds, such as the &cNether&r and &cThe Twilight Forest&r.
These gateways are broken and in need of mending. Unfortunately it seems &amost are broken irreparably&r, and those worlds cannot be visited.
cottagewitch.globetrotting.title: Globetrotting
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests0.description: One of the most important tools in a witch's bag is their &bBook of Shadows&r, in which they record their knowledge and experience as they follow their path.
This one is helpfully &apre-filled with lots of information&r about the magic in the world around you, although it's not a complete guide to everything.
In order to read your &bBook of Shadows&r, you must first place it on an &bAltar&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests0.subtitle: A witch's best friend
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests1.description: You'll need an &bAltar&r to place your &bBook of Shadows&r on. In order to craft this magical pedestal, you'll need to find a &bMahogany Tree&r, located in &aJungle&r Biomes.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests1.subtitle: A focal point for magic
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests2.description: In order to locate much of the content of this mod, one must first locate a &aSwamp&r or &aJungle&r biome. These can be found either with the &bNature's Compass&r, or the &bDowsing Rod&r.

The &bDowsing rod&r's leaves will &achange colors when it points towards&r one of the aforementioned biomes. If one crafts it into the &bNature's Compass&r, you can &asearch the surrounding area&r for any biome.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests2.subtitle: A magical compass to lead the way
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests2.title: Craft a Dowsing Rod
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests3.description: A cauldron is fine and dandy, but you'll want something a little more magical for your endeavors. Enhance a regular &bCauldron&r with &biron&r and &btorches&r in order to create this advanced crafting tool.
&dBeware! Do not use your Infinity water bucket with this cauldron!&r. It will consume the water and the enchantment.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests3.subtitle: A Cauldron that's just cauld-right!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests3.title: Make a Mixing Cauldron
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests4.description: The &bCoffer&r is a storage box which functions similarly to a &bShulker Box&r, as it &aretains its inventory&r once broken. It also &adisplays its contents&r when the player draws near, making it both useful and decorative!
The Coffer can be both dyed and renamed.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests4.subtitle: Much better than a coffin
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests4.title: Obtain a Coffer
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests5.description: &bInfused Fabric&r is the basis for creating your very first set of &bWitch Robes&r. The warp and weft are perfectly balanced, giving this extra defense despite only being fabric.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests5.subtitle: Of course it's black
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests5.title: Obtain Infused Fabric
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests6.description: The &bDipper&r is used for making candles. It can be placed above a &bMixing Cauldron&b filled with &bTallow&r (rendered Animal Fat) and hung with String in order to &6create Candles&r.
Unlike basic Candles, these can be placed together with Candles of different colors, and may be lit separately!
&bTallow&r is created in the Mixing Cauldron with &bAnimal Fat and Honeycombs&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests6.subtitle: Is a \"big dipper\" joke too obvious?
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests6.title: Obtain a Dipper
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests7.description: The &bCandelabra&r is a decorative block which can be placed above or below blocks in order to light the surrounding area.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests7.subtitle: Abracandelabra!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests7.title: Obtain a Candelabra
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests8.description: The &bMortar and Pestle&r is a tool for grinding herbs. For right now, its primary use is to create a &bSeed Mixture&r to befriend &aCrows&r. A worthy use!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests8.subtitle: Pester a mortal
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests8.title: Obtain a Pestle and Mortar
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests9.description: The &bDrying Rack&r allows you to &6hang your herbs to dry&r. It also makes a lovely decoration.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests10.descriptio: The &bSage Burning Plate&r will allow you to burn &bSage Bundles&r, which &aprevents hostile mobs from spawning&r within a large radius.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests10.title: Obtain a Sage Burning Plate
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests11.descriptio: Burning Sage is an ancient and well-documented method of purifying an area of negative or wayward energy. In this world, this &aprevents hostile mobs from spawning in a rather large radius around the bundle&r.

To burn a &bSage Bundle&r, first hang it on a &bDrying Rack&r until the moisture is gone and the leaves are dessicated. Then, place the Bundle on the &bSage Burning Plate&r and light it with a &bFlint and Steel&r.
The Bundle can be &aextinguished&r (&6 shift right click with empty hand&r) during the daytime and it will &aretain its durability&r in order to be used again the next night.

A side note: Sage burning is a multicultural practice which is not to be confused with Smudging. Smudging is a closed practice, sacred to First Nations people, and should probably not be attempted in Minecraft.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests11.subtitle: A sage choice
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests11.title: Obtain a Sage Bundle
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests12.descriptio: Every witch needs a good &bhat&r. You can craft yours out of &bInfused Fabric&r, or find it in a &dWitch Coven&r in a Swamp biome.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests12.subtitle: The icon, the myth, the legend
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests13.descriptio: Adding mushrooms to your hat is a glorious aesthetic choice, although it doesn't offer any tangible benefits.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests13.subtitle: The best upgrade, honestly
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests13.title: Cover your Hat in Mushrooms
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests14.descriptio: The &bRobe&r is the second part of the 3-part &bWitch&r set. This set is slightly weaker than &bDiamond&r, but stronger than &bIron&r due to its inherent magically protective properties.
Unfortunately, witches seem not to care for pants - if you want those, you'll have to look elsewhere.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests14.subtitle: Timelessly stylish, and powerful too
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests14.title: Witch's Robe
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests15.descriptio: The &bWitch's set &agrants bonuses&r depending on how many pieces you're wearing (out of 3).
Hold shift on any item from this set to view what the bonuses are.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests15.subtitle: These boots were made for witchin'
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests16.descriptio: The &bHerb Jar&r can be crafted by smelting 8 &bSand&r in your &bMixing Cauldron&r. Each Herb Jar can carry &aonly one type&r of Herb, but can &acontain up to 1024&r of that herb!
The Herb Jar label will &areflect what is stored inside of it&r, and can be named using an &bAnvil&r. When broken, the Herb Jar retains its inventory.
&6Left click an &bHerb Jar to withdraw&r 1 item. &6Crouch and left click&r to remove a stack.
&eFamiliar Crows&r will &agather and deposit harvested herbs&r if the button inside the jar (&6crouch right click&r to access) is pressed.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests16.subtitle: Totally herbaceous, dude
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests16.title: Obtain an Herb Jar
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests17.descriptio: Crows love music! If you ever lose track of them, you can instantly summon them using the &bCrow Flute&r. You'll need &bMahogany Wood&r and some &bDye&r in order to craft.
&6Right click while holding the Flute&r to play a tune to call your &eFamiliars&r.

If you &6crouch and right click a Crow with the Flute&r, you can Select it with the &aSelect&r button. Then, you can select &aPerch&r, and &6crouch and right click a block/inventory item with the Flute&r in order to tell your Crow to perch there. Crows will bring items back to their perch when told to &aGather&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests17.subtitle: Utterly Charming
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests18.descriptio: Create some &bMixed Seeds&r in order to tame &eWild Crows&r. Once you tame a Crow Familiar, they will help you with tasks around your hut!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests18.subtitle: Squawk goals
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests18.title: Mix some Seeds in your Mortar
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests19.descriptio: There are three types of &bBrooms&r, &aWillow&r, &aWitch Hazel&r, and &aMahogany&r. The Witch Hazel and Willow brooms are affordable to make, but slower to control and flammable. The Mahogany broom is faster and fire resistant- a worthy upgrade!

You can &6crouch and right click&r your &bBroom&r in order to access its customization options, as well as switch it from &aFloat Mode&r to &aRest Mode&r, which determines what the Broom will do when you dismount.
You will also need a &bBroom Whistle&r.
Lost your broom? No worries! Just &6right click&r with your &bBroom Whistle&r to call it to you!
First, you'll need to &6place the &bWhistle&6 and &bBroom&r in a crafting grid&r to bind them. You can &aunbind&r them by &6putting the &bWhistle&r in alone.
Be aware that this &dworks best when your broom is in sight&r. It will try to fly to you, but it's just a broom so it's &anot very smart&r and often gets stuck on things.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests19.subtitle: Any kind works!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests19.title: Make A Broom and Whistle
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests20.descriptio: Normally, when you enter water while flying, your Broom will dismount you. However, by adding this tip to the end, you can remain in the water without getting thrown off, for a limited time.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests20.subtitle: You too can be a sea witch
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests20.title: Obtain Broom Waterproof Tip
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests21.descriptio: You can attach a &bSatchel&r to your &bBroom&r both as a cute decoration, and as a way to store items on the go!
There are three Satchel items: &bSmall Satchel&r, &bMedium&r, and &bLarge&r. Only one can be equipped at any given time.
The Medium Satchel requires a Small Satchel in order to craft. The Large requires one Small and one Medium, and combines them together on your Broom.
Crouch and right-click your Broom to access its &aaccessories and inventory&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests21.subtitle: Portable storage
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests21.title: Obtain a Small Satchel
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests22.descriptio: The &bEnhanced Broom Brush&r has increased durability. Don't forget to hang it out to dry once you've crafted it!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests22.subtitle: Fancy enhancery
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests22.title: Obtain an Enhanced Broom Brush
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests23.descriptio: &bMandrake Root&r is used to upgrade your &bBroom&r, and can also be used to create &bCompost&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests24.descriptio: Blood Sigils are used to collect blood for rituals. They are crafted with &bRedstone&r and &bPolished Blackstone&r.
Once you have crafted the Sigil, place it in the bottom of your &bMixing Cauldron&r (by &aright-clicking and placing it in the left slot of the crafting interface&r).

Once it is installed, make sure there is no liquid in your Cauldron, and then &ajump inside of it&r. Blood must be taken from a willing participant, and that means you! Jump 3 times to obtain enough Blood for 1 Bottle. Then, right click the Cauldron with a &bGlass Bottle&r to collect it.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests24.title: Obtain a Blood Sigil
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests25.descriptio: Much like the Waterproof Tip, the &bNetherite Broom Tip&r will prevent players getting dismounted due to lava. It is recommended to use this with a &bMahogany Broom&r, as it is fire resistant.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests25.subtitle: Resist the fire
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests25.title: Obtain Broom Netherite Tip
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests26.descriptio: As you use your Broom, the Brush will eventually lose durability and need replacing. Begin by making the standard &bWet Broom Brush&r, which can be either immediately upgraded to an &bEnhanced Broom Brush&r, or dried out for use on a &bDrying Rack&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests26.subtitle: Re-up your flight subscription
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests26.title: Obtain a Replacement Broom Brush
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests27.descriptio: &bBelladonna&r is used to upgrade your &bBroom&r, and can also be used to create &bCompost&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests28.descriptio: &bYellow Dock&r is used to upgrade your &bBroom&r, and can also be used to create &bCompost&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests29.descriptio: &bMugwort&r is used to upgrade your &bBroom&r, and can also be used to create &bCompost&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests30.descriptio: Once you meet your first &eCrow&r, you're ready to tame. Bring lots of &bSeed Mixture&r because they can be hard to win over!
Once you have tamed the Crow Familiar, you can &6crouch and right click it&r to &aaccess its menu&r.

If you &6right click without crouching&r, you will &achange its mode&r to Sit, Follow, and more. You can do that in the menu, as well. By default, it will Follow and sit on your shoulder, unless you crouch.
&aCrows can be equipped with hats and weapons&r via the menu. It can wear most helmets and wield most melee weapons. Unfortunately, &dthey cannot wear hats from the &lSimple Hats&r&d mod&r. :(
Through the menu, you can instruct your &eFamiliar&r to help you farm your crops, or to follow you in combat, or even to &apickpocket villagers&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests30.subtitle: You look oddly Familiar
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests30.title: Meet a Crow
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests31.descriptio: You can breed two tamed &eCrows&r by gifting one of them a shiny &bGolden Nugget&r. It will then bring it to its potential mate, and the two will pair up!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests31.subtitle: Oooh, shiny!
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests31.title: Breeding Crows
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests32.descriptio: Hidden away in &cSwamps&r is the &cDark Coven&r, a city of &eWitches&r who are up to no good. If you are &6wearing their robes&r, they will ignore you. But anyone not perceived to be one of them is considered an enemy.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests32.title: Discover the Dark Coven
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests33.descriptio: The &bReplacer Satchel&r is incredibly useful, as it will &areplace broken &bBroom Brushes&r with ones in its inventory, beginning with the &6top left&r.
