cottagewitch.hexerei.quests34.descriptio: The &bEnder Satchel&r is a storage upgrade which &agrants easy access to your Ender Chest inventory!&r.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests35.descriptio: Equip your &eCrow&r with this &bAnkh&r to protect it from danger. It will grant it &aRegen&r while it's playing dead, and &aacts as a &bTotem of Undying&r in case the &eCrow&r dies.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests37.descriptio: Similar to moon water in real life, you can obtain &bMoon Dust&r by combining &bRedstone&r and &bGlowstone&r &6during a Full Moon&r.

It's used for some important recipes, such high level &bStorage Glyphs&r, so it's a good idea to have some on hand! You can use a &bMoon Dial&r to tell what moon phase is currently active. You can &6hold it and right click&r to see how many days remain until the full moon.
cottagewitch.hexerei.quests37.title: Moon Dust
cottagewitch.hexerei.title: Hexerei
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests0.descr: You can send letters and packages to your friends! You can &asend and receive mail&r using a &bSnailbox&r. Placing it down claims it, and you can even give it a name by &6right clicking on it&r and entering text in the name field.

To &asend mail&r, you'll need a &bStamp&r and an &bOpen Envelope&r. These envelopes can be reused, so they're good for the environment. &6Place the Envelope in the upper right of the &bSnailbox&r. Then click &6\"Open Envelope&r.\"

In here, you can put your mail! You can send &bpostcards, wrapped parcels, and more&r! &aDon't forget to add a Stamp&r! Enter the name of the recipient, your name if desired, and then &6Hit Esc to go back to the previous window&r!
Once you've hit &dEsc&r, you can &aselect the Snailbox to send to&r, and ta-da! You're done!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests0.subti: A way to communicate in multiplayer
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests0.title: Snail Mail
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests1.descr: The &bSandcastle&r can be placed over &bTurtle Eggs&r in order to protect them from Zombies.
However, there is &da bug currently&r which prevents eggs in a &bSand Castle&r from hatching.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests2.descr: A piece of &bCarved Nephrite&r allows you to store your Experience in a network, to prevent it being lost or reduced on death. Connect multiple &bCarved Nephrite&r together to store even more.
It also allows you to &ashare experience with others&r!
Additionally, you can store up to 30 levels in a &bNephrite Ring&r.
Stand on the &bSiphon&r to drain your EXP, and activate the &bFountain&r to shower yourself in it.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests2.subti: Unfortunately not the experience you can put on your resume
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests2.title: Save your EXP
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests3.descr: The &bIron Grate&r works to keep animals inside, as they are afraid to walk over it, although you can lead them across by attaching a &bLead&r to them. &aItems will fall through it&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests3.title: Obtain some Iron Grates
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests4.descr: Found as loot in chests, the &bAncient Tomes&r are books of long-lost knowledge which will allow you to &aadd a level to the specified enchantment&r by combining the Tome with the &bEnchanted Book&r at an &bAnvil&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests4.title: Obtain an Ancient Tome
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests5.descr: You can obtain a &bCloud in a Bottle&r by ascending to &acloud height&r and &6right clicking the air with a glass bottle&r.

You can release the Cloud by right-clicking the bottle in the air. It will shortly disappear. However, if the cloud is &6replaced with another block&r, it returns to the bottle. This allows you to &aplace blocks in midair&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests5.subti: Lots of things can go in bottles.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests6.descr: The &bCinder Furnace&r is a unique item which &aonly functions on the back of a &eCindershell Tortoise&r, which live in the Nether Wastes.
You can befriend and breed them with &bFungus&r - but beware, they have a LOT of young at once.
If you place this &bFurnace&r on top of a &eCindershell&r, it will use the beast's volcanic heat to &asmelt items without fuel&r!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests6.subti: Cindershelly, cindershelly, oh we love our cindershelly
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests7.descr: Did you know that you can &aspeed up the tick speed of a block&r? This can be used on things like &bCompost&r to make them progress faster.
Craft the &bTime in a Bottle&r and hold it in your inventory to accumulate time. Then, you can &6shift right click&r on certain blocks to apply that time to them.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests7.title: Capture Time in a Bottle
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests8.descr: The &bCage&r is similar to the &bCapture Cell&r, in that you can &6right click it on a small mob&r to pick it up and transport it. You can &6right click a block to release&r the mob, or you can &6shift right click&r to place the &bCage&r down and display your new friend in their enclosure!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests8.subti: Despite all my rage, I am still just a...oh you know
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests9.descr: Did you know you can grind the enchantment off of the &bEnchanted Golden Apple&r?
That would be utterly ridiculous to do, and yet...
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests10.desc: The &bWrench&r is an item which can &arotate blocks&r. Just &6right click the block&r with the &bWrench&r, and it will adjust the position based on where you click it.
Does not work on objects which have the same texture on all sides (such as planks).
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests11.desc: The &bSleeping Bag&r is an item which will allow you to &apass the night without setting spawn&r. Simply carry it with you and &6right click it on the ground&r to use it.
You can &6shift right click&r in order to place it without sleeping.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests12.desc: Make a &bHammock&r to &asleep through the day&r, making it night easily. Then, get up to shenanigans!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests13.desc: Have you ever fallen in love with the color palette of one biome, but your base is somewhere else entirely? Well, worry not! With &bBiome Jars&r, you can &6pick up the biome and transport it!&r
Right click the &bBiome Jar&r on the ground of the biome you want to take. Wait just long enough to go - \"Is this worki -\"
&l&dBANG!&r Yes, it's working! Once it completes its capture, you can &6right click it&r to pick it back up.
Then, take your jar and &6right click it&r on the area you want to transfer the new biome to.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests14.desc: Villagers who have &abeen zombified and then cured&r will offer &asignificant discounts&r.
Should you find a &eZombie Villager&r, &6hit them with a Splash Potion of Weakness&r, and then &6give them a golden apple&r. After a time, they will be cured!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests15.desc: &bEmeralds&r! These are the bread and butter of the &eVillagers&r which live in your world. You will need these to obtain rare items such as the new &bEnd Portal Eyes&r.
To find a &alist of all villager professions and their job blocks&r, hover over an &bEmerald&r and &6press \"u\"&r, then &6choose the top tab with a villager face&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests16.desc: The first time you trade with a villager, their &aprofession and possible trades will become locked&r. This is a good way to ensure that the &aLibrarian&r who sells &bMending&r doesn't suddenly run away to join the circus.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests17.desc: Goblin Traders are friendly fellows who are always happy to do business with humans! They're not the smartest, though, so they tend to offer deals that are quite good.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests18.desc: As its name suggests, the &bRedstone Randomizer&r determines randomly whether to output the provided signal to the &aleft or to the right&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests18.subt: Flip a coin. Or a lever.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests19.desc: The &bCog Block&r performs the same way that &bplaced Redstone&r does. However, it doesn't wash away in water, and can be placed vertically both up and down to send a signal.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests19.subt: You know the joke I wanna make.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests20.desc: Depending on weather, this decorative block will output a redstone signal.
When it is &araining&r, it will output a signal of 1. When it is &athundering&r, it will output a signal of 2.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests21.desc: &bBellows&r are blocks that can &aspeed up furnaces&r, &aprevent fires from extinguishing&r, and even &apush entities&r.
The rate at which the Bellows pump is determined by the strength of the &aRedstone signal&r it is receiving.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests22.desc: Perhaps this is too obvious to explain, but the &bTurntable&r is a block that, when provided with a Redstone signal, will rotate the block it is touching.
When placed sideways, it can turn an &bHourglass&r to reset it.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests23.desc: The &bRedstone Illuminator&r is a light source which is on by default. It grows dimmer depending on how much &aRedstone signal&r it receives. One can use a &bCrank&r instead of a &bLever&r for more fine-tuned control.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests23.subt: Beware the power of the Illuminate-y
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests24.desc: The &bFaucet&r is an item which will &awithdraw, and drop, items from the sides of blocks&r (inventories, beehives, or jars). This is opposed to Hoppers, which can only withdraw from the bottom.
They also function like &bDripstone&r, slowly dripping liquids into a cauldron beneath them.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests24.subt: Just hope it's not too leaky
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests25.desc: The &bEnder Watcher&r transmits a Redstone signal when &aa player is looking at it&r. The signal intensity is determined by how far the player is.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests26.desc: The &bIron Rod&r is not just a decoration, it is also functional. When it is placed on a &bSticky Piston&r, it will &abreak the block&r the Piston pushes it into.
This only works on blocks which can be pushed, so blocks like &bObsidian&r will not be affected.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests27.desc: The &bObsidian Pressure Plate&r can &aonly be activated by players&r, making it very useful for base entrances and such.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests28.desc: This unique End-enchanted item will only &afall when provided with a Redstone signal&r. If it is provided a redstone signal and &acannot fall, it will float up instead&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests28.subt: This sand doesn't care about your RULES
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests29.desc: These special buttons function similarly to other &bButtons&r, except that the &bIron Button&r gives a &amuch longer signal&r than usual, and the &bGold Button&r a &amuch shorter signal&r than usual.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests30.desc: The &bChute&r is a block which draws items from above it and &adrops them&r perfectly in the center of the block below it.
It can be disabled with a Redstone signal, or by placing a block directly below it.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests32.desc: You no longer need to break a villager's job block to cycle through their trades. Simply &aask nicely&r (byt &6pressing the Cycle Trades button&r).
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests33.desc: &bPostcards&r and &bParcels&r are from the mod &lContact&r. Unfortunately, this mod's &bMailboxes&r have a &dbad habit of coming unclaimed&r, so that &dno one can receive mail&r. However, they can still be sent via &lSnail Mail&r, an idea come up with by a very smart witch.
Postcards can be &aobtained from the Wandering Trader&r or earned through quest rewards. You can &6right click&r while holding them to write on them.
You can wrap gifts up in &bWrapping Paper&r. Each parcel can hold 4 items. There is no functional difference between the regular and Ender versions when using them with &lSnail Mail&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests34.desc: Playing a fun game is its own reward, but here's an extra bonus for spending so much time with us!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests35.desc: Although not all mermaids are witches, there are some &anotable examples of some which are&r. You, too, can keep a creepy garden under the sea with the help of the &bSea Necklace&r, which will equip you with a &atail all your own!&r It will also &agrant you swim speed bonuses&r and the &aability to breathe&r underwater indefinitely.
To craft it, you'll need a &bSea Crystal&r, which you can craft with a little luck at treasure-hunting!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests36.desc: If you're playing with others, you can use Crates from the &lApple Crates&r mod to &asell items to one another&r!
(&cRed&r - A) This is the &aCrate's inventory&r, where you place your stock for sale.
(&1Dark Blue&r - B) This input is &athe item you want to receive&r as payment. Place one or more into the slot.
(&bLight Blue&r - C) This is the &aitem you're trading&r. Stack size matters - in this example the trade is &a1 Diamond for 4 Dark Oak Saplings&r.
(&aGreen&r - D) You must &apress this button to lock in your trade&r. Items in Slots B and C will be returned to your personal inventory.
(&dPink&r - E) This is where you can &aadd another player to the crate&r. Players added here are considered an owner and will have the same access as you!
(&5Purple&r - F) This is where your &apayment is stored&r. As people purchase from you, the items they use to pay will go here. This slot can store a higher stack size than 64 items.
(White - G) This is your personal inventory!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests36.titl: Apple Crates for Commerce and Deco!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests37.desc: Now that you've gotten your first &bSea Crystal&r, you can craft it into a &bSea Necklace&r. This can be worn in your &achest slot&r or &aas a curio&r.
Equipping the necklace will &aturn you into a mermaid while in water&r. This will allow you to &aswim quickly&r and &abreathe underwater&r.
You can also &6upgrade your appearance&r by crafting the &bNecklace&r with &bupgrade items&r.
You can dye your tail by &6crafting the &bNecklace&r with different &bdyes&r, just like &bleather armor&r.
To &dremove dyes or upgrades&r, you need to &6hold the necklace&r in your hand and &6right click&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests38.desc: This &bGlowing Pearl&r will make your mermaid top and tail shimmer as if &aenchanted&r!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests39.desc: Use this item to look like you're in h2o: Just Add Water!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests40.desc: Once you've dyed your tail, you can &aadd a gradient&r by &6crafting this item with &bdye&r and then &6crafting it with your necklace&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests41.desc: Want to be the Little Mermaid? This upgrade will &agive you Ariel's appearance&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests42.desc: Craft your necklace with this accessory to &aadd a bra to your mermaid look&r!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests43.desc: &bDimensional Tears&r are a fluid which &ateleports an entity&r to its point of origin. If a &eplayer&r has a &arespawn point&r set, it will bring them there. If they don't, and for &eall other entities&r, it will transport them to &cworld spawn&r.
You can obtain this item from &acertain chests&r, or by &6right clicking a bottle&r onto &bCrying Obsidian&r or an activated &bRespawn Anchor&r.
To use the item, either &6drink it from the bottle&r or &6place it in a cauldron&r and jump into it.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests44.desc: &bGlow Sticks&r are a light source that can be &aplaced on any surface&r or &athrown like a snowball&r (placing itself wherever it lands).
They can be &athrown and placed underwater&r, making them ideal for subnautical exploration.
Glow sticks also come in all 16 colors as well as the glow ink hue, making them ideal for &amarking out pathways&r to different locations.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests45.desc: &bMagnetite&r generates in small clusters deep underground, and are surrounded by &bLava&r and &bDeepslate Iron&r, encased in a shell of &bObsidian&r. These geodes are somewhat rare to come across.
You'll need &aSilk Touch&r or a &bHammer and Chisel&r to obtain the blocks, otherwise you will get &bMagnetite Chunks&r instead, which can be used in crafting.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests46.desc: Crafted with &bCinnabar&r and &bMagnetite&r, this incredibly useful tool will &adraw items on the ground to you&r for pickup!
Simply &6right click while holding it&r to activate it, and then &akeep it in your inventory&r. You can turn it off the same way.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests47.desc: &bRough Cinnabar&r is dropped from &bRedstone Ore&r. To gain the refined version, &6polish it on a Grindstone&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests48.desc: The &bDiamond Grindstone&r gives a finer polish and thus is suitable for &ararer gems&r such as &bDiamonds&r or &bEmeralds&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests49.desc: These rarer gems require a &bDiamond Grindstone&r to be polished.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests50.desc: Among its other duties, a &bGrindstone&r can be used to &apolish Rough minerals&r, as long as they're not too precious.
By &6right clicking the item&r on the &bGrindstone&r, you can polish &bRough Lazurite or Cinnabar&r.
Note that you can also use &bSandpaper&r to polish these gems.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests51.desc: Once you obtain a &bRough Ore&r, you can polish it into its more valuable (and usable) cousin using the &bGrindstone&r!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests52.desc: Okay, I admit, I have a Cauldron addiction. Can you blame me?
Anyway, the &bReinforced Cauldron&r has a few traits to set it apart from its brethren.
It &afunctions as an infinite water source&r when filling &bEmpty Bottles&r.
It can also be filled with potions, but don't try to mix different kinds!
There is supposedly a way to dip one's weapon in it, but this seems to be dysfunctional at this time.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests53.desc: The &bRudimentary Gauntlet&r is a weapon which, by itself, is not all that impressive. However, &aupgrading it&r will unlock its true potential!
As it is, it is &acomparable to an &bIron Sword&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests54.desc: The &bNetherite Gauntlet&r is slightly more powerful than its sword counterpart, but what is truly impressive is &aits final upgrade&r: the &bPotioneer Gauntlet&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests55.desc: The &bPotioneer's Gauntlet&r allows one to &ainject potions into their attacks&r using the &bPotion Injector&r. Up to 6 &bLingering Potions&r can be injected.
When attacking with the Gauntlet, you will deal both melee damage and the potion effect's damage. This can be toggled by pressing &6shift+right click&r.
Once one potion is used, it will automatically load up the next potion after a few seconds.
They will &aload in the order they were placed&r in the Injector UI. The potions are not consumed, but will be on cooldown after use.
To resupply your gauntlet, apply &bBlaze Powder&r in the &bPotion Injector&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests56.desc: Those who experiment with altering their states may find themselves in quite the situation, not entirely knowing how they arrived at this conclusion.
This achievement involves getting &aevery vanilla effect&r at once, as well as the following modded effects:
Sculk Affinity (Deeper and Darker), Panic, Serenity (both Environmental), Health Boost, Resilience (Quark).
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests57.desc: Even the most honest witch needs to sneak around sometimes. But you...well, you've snuck around &3a lot&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests58.desc: Wow, you've caught 999 fish? That's bonkers.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests59.desc: What soothes the soul more than houseplants?
Plant &a50 lovely green (or pink or blue) friends&r in basic &bFlower Pots&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests60.desc: The &bMagnum Torches&r are a set-it-and-forget-it method of preventing mob spawns.
The &bDiamond Magnum Torch&r prevents &ehostile mobs&r from spawning.
The &bEmerald Magnum Torch&r prevents &eneutral and passive mobs&r from spawning.
The &bAmethyst Magnum Torch&r prevents &lALL&r mob spawns.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests61.desc: Why not travel a while by Pig? It may not be fast, or efficient, or even particularly fun.
No, that's it, that's the whole sentence.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests62.desc: Winning a &aRaid&r can be a satisfying challenge. Even better, win a bunch of raids, and you'll get rewarded!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests63.desc: &bWind Chimes&r are not only a delightful visual and audible decoration, they are also useful! They have a &ePhantom&r &arepelling effect&r for up to 25 blocks vertically and 10 blocks horizontally!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests64.desc: There have long been superstitions about whether &aphotography holds magical sway&r in our world. Some say photographs steal souls - others say they grant a form of immortality.

Whatever you believe the power of the picture truly is, it cannot be denied that it &ais at least somewhat magical&r. The ability to capture light from a moment in time and look back on it long since it has passed? That's a small miracle without a doubt.

You, too, can &acapture photos with a camera&r! &6Right click&r the camera to enter photo mode. From here, you can &6crouch&r to access the &aphoto settings&r - Focal Length, Shutter Speed, Flash Mode, and Composition Guides.
But first, you'll need some &bFilm&r, and you can also upgrade your camera with &aother items&r!
&6Shift right click&r while holding the &bCamera&r to access the interface. Here you can load &bFilm&r - color, or black and white. You can also add the following:
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests65.desc: You &aprint your photographs&r using the &bLightroom&r. Here you can &aview your developed negatives&r in detail, as well.
&bBlack and White Film&r requires &bPaper&r and &bBlack Dye&r. Printing in &acolor&r additionally requires &bCyan&r, &bMagenta&r, and &bYellow Dyes&r.
Once you have &6chosen your photo with left click&r, you can then &6click the checkmark&r to begin printing. And ta-da! Photographs!
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.quests66.desc: In order to &aprint your photographs&r, you must first &adevelop the film&r.
This is done by crafting &bThick&r, &bAwkward&r, and &bMundane Potions&r together with the &bColor Film&r. For &bBlack and White Film&r, you only need a &bBottle of Water&r.
cottagewitch.miscellaneous.title: Miscellaneous
cottagewitch.scavenger_hunt.quests33.des: Looking for something to spend some time on? Why not &aa Scavenger Hunt?&r. Obtain these items for the ability to claim an incredible prize!
&6Click the checkbox in this quest to begin.&r. This can be done at any time.
cottagewitch.scavenger_hunt.quests34.des: &dCongratulations&r on collecting every item in the hunt! Please enjoy your fabulous prizes (and the sense of personal satisfaction, which is the real treasure).
The check mark above unlocks &6once all Scavenger Hunt Quests are done&r.
cottagewitch.scavenger_hunt.title: Scavenger Hunt
cottagewitch.storage.quests0.description: &bStorage Drawers&r are inventory items which can hold massive amounts of a single item in one block.
You can make multiple variations, holding from 1-4 items, and in many different wood types.
&bFramed Drawers&r can be made to show any block texture. &6Hold shift&r while hovering over a &bFramed Drawer&r to read instructions.
cottagewitch.storage.quests0.subtitle: I'm an artist, not a drawer
cottagewitch.storage.quests0.title: Craft a Functional Storage Drawer
cottagewitch.storage.quests1.description: This &bStorage Upgrade&r will &aincrease the amount of items&r your Drawers can hold.
There are multiple tiers of upgrades, which can be used together or mix-and-matched.
Each drawer can accept 7 different upgrades.
cottagewitch.storage.quests1.subtitle: We must have more storage!
cottagewitch.storage.quests1.title: Obtain your first Storage Upgrade
cottagewitch.storage.quests2.description: The &bVoid Upgrade&r is useful if you have a lot of an item importing into your drawers - it will &aautomatically delete&r any items which can't fit in the drawer, preventing your game from getting too laggy.
cottagewitch.storage.quests3.description: The &bCompacting Drawer&r is unique from other drawers because it allows you to access &amultiple compressions of an item&r.

The usual example would be something like &bIron&r, because it will give you access to &bIron Blocks&r, &bIron Ingots&r, and &bIron Nuggets&r. If you insert 9 Iron Ingots, you can withdraw either 1 Block, 9 Ingots, or 81 Nuggets, without having to craft.
However, this also works for items such as &bCrops&r, which can be withdrawn as Crates. This works with any item which has a &a3x3 compression recipe&r.
The &bSimple Compacting Drawer&r does the same thing, except for items which only have 2 variations, such as crops or eggs.
cottagewitch.storage.quests4.description: The &bDrawer Controller&r is very important for hooking your &bDrawers&r up to your &aStorage Network&r.
You can also use it to &aimport items&r to your drawers via a Hopper or &bPipez&r!
You will need to use a &bLinking Tool&r to connect each &bDrawer&r with the &bController&r by &6right clicking&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests5.description: &aConfiguration Tools&r alter the function of Drawers. &6Right click on a Drawer while holding a Key&r to activate its ability.
The basic mode, &bLocking&r, locks a Drawer so that it can only accept the item/s currently inside of it.
The &bHide/Show Amounts&r mode toggles whether or not the amount of items contained within the Drawer is visible on its surface.
The &bHide/Show Item Renders&r mode will completely hide the item image and all other labels from the front of the Drawer.
The &bHide/Show Upgrades&r will show or hide what upgrades a Drawer currently contains.
cottagewitch.storage.quests6.description: Oh I know, it's such a bother... your storage is just &olousy&r with &bGolden Apples&r - well worry no more, you can &acompress them&r into crates. These &bGolden Apple Crates&r can even be used to power a &bBeacon&r!
cottagewitch.storage.quests6.subtitle: Some have crateness thrust upon them
cottagewitch.storage.quests6.title: Obtain a Golden Apple Crate
cottagewitch.storage.quests7.description: There are a number of &ajar types&r in this modpack. This one holds liquids! Up to three buckets worth.
It can hold everything from &bWater&r to &bSoups&r to even &bExperience&r.
They can also function as &afish tanks&r or &acookie jars&r.
Right click the jar with an empty hand to eat or drink its contents. Don't worry, you won't eat the lava.
You can &aplace the jar by crouching and right clicking&r it. If you &asimply right click&r, you will instead capture small mobs such as &eSmall Slimes&r or &eBees&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests8.description: The &bBasket&r can be used as a chest, but also as a hopper! It has the &astorage capacity of a chest&r, and when dropped or thrown items land on top of it, they will &aautomatically go into its inventory&r.
For example, you could &6place one upside-down&r above a &bStove&r in order to collect the finished products! Or put one at the end of a &bConveyer Belt&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests8.subtitle: I wonder if you could play ball with it.
cottagewitch.storage.quests8.title: Obtain a Basket
cottagewitch.storage.quests9.description: An &bEnder Chest&r is like cloud storage for your items. This inventory is accessible through any &bEnder Chest&r, anywhere in the world.
It's not a bad idea to fill it with emergency items. You can &again more storage space&r by &6filling it with Shulker Boxes&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests10.descriptio: As you could guess, the &bRing of Enderchest&r allows you to access your Ender Inventory without needing an &bEnder Chest&r.
It &acannot be worn as a Curio&r but instead must be &6held and right clicked&r in order to be used.
cottagewitch.storage.quests11.descriptio: The &bItem Pipe&r is a way for you to easily transfer items from one inventory to another.
It can &aconnect to an individual chest, barrel, or a whole network&r via a &bInventory Connector&r.
You can use a &bWrench&r (either from &lPipez&r or &lCreate&r - the one from &lSupplementaries&r doesn't work) to &achange its mode&r.
&6Shift right click the wrench&r onto one side of the &bPipe&r to connect/disconnect it, and also to &aset to Extract mode&r.
Once in &aExtract Mode&r, you can &6right click on the pipe&r to access its menu.
cottagewitch.storage.quests11.subtitle: Organize your Storage Network
cottagewitch.storage.quests12.descriptio: The &bBasic Pipe Upgrade&r allows you to set a &aRedstone Mode&r for the Pipe. You can set it to &aonly be active&r when receiving a signal, or to &astop when it receives a signal&r. By default, it will &aignore Redstone input&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests13.descriptio: The &bImproved Upgrade&r gives you &aRedstone Mode&r control, and also allows you to change the &aDistribution mode&r, such as whether to deliver to the &afirst inventory&r, &aRound Robin&r, or &acompletely random&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests14.descriptio: The &bAdvanced Upgrade&r gives you access to the previous two modes, as well as &aFiltering&r. You can &awhitelist or blacklist&r selected items from being extracted by the pipes.
cottagewitch.storage.quests15.descriptio: The &bUltimate Upgrade&r gives you all the previous benefits, while also transporting &aone stack at a time&r, making it the fastest option.
It is also significantly more expensive.
cottagewitch.storage.quests16.descriptio: The &bEnder Drawer&r can be &aattuned to a frequency&a using the &bLinking Tool&r. Any other &bEnder Drawer&r attuned to the same frequency will contain the &asame inventory&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests17.descriptio: The &bCollector Upgrade&r will &apick up items&r dropped nearby.
The &bPulling Upgrade&r will &apull items from a nearby inventory&r.
The &bPushing Upgrade&r will... you guessed it! &aPush items&r to a nearby inventory.
cottagewitch.storage.quests17.title: Lateral Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests18.descriptio: There are many ways to carry items with you while you adventure, but not all of them are quite as terrifying as a &bLuggage&r. It has little concern for others, and loves to &agobble up dropped items&r. And yet, it's strangely endearing.
You can &6access its inventory with right click&r, and &6pick it up with shift right click&r. It &aretains its inventory&r when picked up, and it cannot die.

The &eLuggage&r can &awear a collar&r, which will grant it the enchanted abilities. However, &dplacing the Luggage in your inventory will delete the collar&r, so be sure to remove it before picking it back up.
cottagewitch.storage.quests18.subtitle: om nom nom nom
cottagewitch.storage.quests18.title: Not Exactly a Pet
cottagewitch.storage.quests19.descriptio: The &eLuggage&r, when &astruck by lightning&r, will have its inventory increased.

The easiest way for this to happen is to use a &aRitual of Zapping&r, for which you'll need a &bRitual Tablet&r and a &bBrazier&r. &6Place the tablet and right click&r to begin the ritual. If you want to zap &amultiple creatures&r, you must &aprovide Source&r to the ritual.
cottagewitch.storage.quests19.title: Upgrade your Luggage
cottagewitch.storage.quests20.descriptio: Did you know that you can &aTransmit items wirelessly using &bSculk&r? The communications sent along the &amycelial sculk network&r can carry data so complex that it &amanipulates reality&r. Thus, it can take an item from one place and transfer it to another.
To begin with, you'll want a &bGuidebook&r, and to &6harvest some &bSculk&r.
&6Read the chapter \"Gathering Materials\"&r to begin with, to find out what you will need.
cottagewitch.storage.quests21.descriptio: The first tools you'll need are an &bEmitter&r - to send out items - and a &bReceiver&r - to, well, receive them.

The &bEmitter&r must be &6placed on top of the &bSculk Barrel&r in order to function. The &bSculk Receiver&r, however, can input into &amost basic inventory blocks&r such as Chests, Barrels, and Drawers. It &acannot deposit directly&r into a &bDrawer Controller&r, but you can use &bPipez&r or &bPulling Upgrades&r to withdraw the items into your Drawers.
cottagewitch.storage.quests21.title: The Sculk Network Basics
cottagewitch.storage.quests22.descriptio: By default, &bEmitters&r and &bReceivers&r have to be &awithin 8 blocks of one another&r to function. However, you can &aextend that distance&r by &6placing down Sculk Transmitters&r.
The &bTransmitters&r can also be configured to &aaccept or deny&r certain items placed on their sides. You can &6read more about this&r in the Guidebook.
cottagewitch.storage.quests22.title: Extending the Range
cottagewitch.storage.quests23.descriptio: The different levels of &bQuantity Modifiers&r will allow &bSculk Emitters&r to transfer and store up to &a64 items&r at a time!
&bReceivers&r and &bTransmitters&r cannot receive these upgrades, but will work with the items sent to them by the &bEmitter&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests23.title: Quantity Modifiers
cottagewitch.storage.quests24.descriptio: As you could probably guess, &bSpeed Modifiers&r allow &bEmitters&r and &bReceivers&r to perform their tasks at higher speeds. Do note that &bTransmitters&r work as fast as they can, and can bottleneck transmission.
cottagewitch.storage.quests24.title: Speed Modifiers
cottagewitch.storage.quests26.descriptio: The &bFilter Destination Tool&r is a multi-use tool which will allow you to &aset the destination&r of a &bfiltered item type&r.
You can assign it an inventory by &6right clicking it &lon the face of the block the &bPipe&6 connects to&r. It will not work if you do not select the correct face of the inventory.
cottagewitch.storage.quests27.descriptio: &eEnder Luggages&r are a tight knit group- unlike regular &eLuggages&r, every&e Ender Luggage&r you own will share the same storage space!
it's just like an &bEnder Chest&r- with feet!
cottagewitch.storage.quests27.subtitle: A safer way to store
cottagewitch.storage.quests27.title: Not Quite A Chest
cottagewitch.storage.quests28.descriptio: Basic chests and barrels are fine for a while, but the canny witch knows that &athe rules of inventory space&r are meant to be broken. With a little magic, you can easily make your storage bigger - &aand smarter&r!
Let's begin with a simple &bBarrel&r. Place it in the world as usual, and then &6right click it with the &bBasic Tier Upgrade&r.
Now, once you enter the inventory, you'll see some new additions.
The slot to the left &aaccepts upgrades&r which allow your storage to perform certain functions.
The &acog wheel&r on the right gives you access to your &astorage settings&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests28.subtitle: Let's get sophisticated
cottagewitch.storage.quests28.title: Upgrading Your Storage
cottagewitch.storage.quests29.descriptio: Within your storage settings, you have the ability to change the way your storage behaves.
Select the &aBarrel icon&r to choose whether your settings apply to &aPlayer&r - ie, &oall&r your storages  - or &aStorage&r - ie, this container only.
Select the &aA/Z icon&r you can select (with &6left click&r) or deselect (with &6right click&r) slots to be auto-sorted.
Select the &aBrain icon&r to &6choose slots to be locked to the item currently in them&r.
Select the &aSword icon&r to choose a slot whose &aitem will be displayed&r on the front of your storage.
cottagewitch.storage.quests30.descriptio: There are two ways you can upgrade your storage, &alevel by level&r, or &abasic on upwards&r.
Assuming you used the reward from the last quest, you'll now have an &bIron Barrel&r. You can upgrade this to &aGold tier&r with an &bIron to Gold Upgrade&r. This is taking it up &alevel by level&r.
To upgrade from &aBasic upwards&r, you'll need the &bBasic to Gold&r (or other level) Upgrade. This will, as you could guess, take a &bBasic Storage&r and bring it directly to &aGold tier&r.
With each tier of upgrades, &ayour storage improves&r. At Gold tier it has &amore slots and an additional upgrade slot&r on the left.
cottagewitch.storage.quests30.subtitle: beyond basic
cottagewitch.storage.quests30.title: More Storage, More Upgrade
cottagewitch.storage.quests31.descriptio: Your Sophisticated &bBarrels&r and &bChests are capable of &aholding more than a stack per slot&r, if you use the &bStack Upgrades&r on them. The higher the tier, the more stacks each slot can hold.
You can also &ause more than one Stack Upgrade&r, and they will add &amultiplicatively&r!
So if you use a &bTier 1&r and a &bTier 2&r, you will hold 2 stacks by 4 stacks, meaning 8 stacks, or &d512 items per slot&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests31.subtitle: higher and higher
cottagewitch.storage.quests31.title: Stack Higher
cottagewitch.storage.quests32.descriptio: &bPacking Tape&r is an incredibly helpful item which can be used to &apackage up a storage block&r for transport. Although &dit can only be used on Sophisticated Storage&r.
You need to &6right click the &bTape&r onto the desired item. Then you can &6break the block&r and it will retain its inventory.
cottagewitch.storage.quests32.subtitle: Pack it up, Pack it in
cottagewitch.storage.quests33.descriptio: The &bVoid Upgrade&r is an item which will &aremove unwanted items from your storage&r. It will, quite simply, delete them, ensuring that your storage is both well-organized and your server un-crashed. &dIt is especially important to use this upgrade for farms&r!
You can configure it to &adelete only overflow items&r or, if you prefer, &adelete all items of specific type&r.
The &bAdvanced Void Upgrade&r is capable of sorting by NBT and Damage levels.
cottagewitch.storage.quests33.subtitle: A Very Important Upgrade
cottagewitch.storage.quests34.descriptio: These upgrades will help you &aprocess items in your storage&r, by smelting, blasting, or smoking. The &aautomatic versions&r will do so without the player needing to manually input the items.
cottagewitch.storage.quests34.subtitle: your storage has a right to due process
cottagewitch.storage.quests34.title: Process Your Inventory
cottagewitch.storage.quests35.descriptio: The &bFilter Upgrade&r is meant to be used in conjunction with &bPipez&r or other item transport system.
It will &ahelp control what items get placed&r in the storage you use it on.
cottagewitch.storage.quests36.descriptio: The &bCrafting&r and &bStonecutter&r upgrades provide those &acrafting interfaces&r in the storage you place them in.
cottagewitch.storage.quests36.title: Crafting Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests37.descriptio: To &aremotely link Sophisticated Storages&r which are not touching the main network, you need to &6place a &bStorage Link&6 on them&r, and then &6right click the &bStorage Tool&r on the &bLink&r and the &bStorage Controller&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests38.descriptio: This backpack is no kid's toy- this thing is multipurpose and heavy duty! With access to a &aplethora of unique upgrades to equip&r and the ability to improve the backpack's storage by &6crafting it with increasingly expensive ingots&r, this is truly an endgame storage solution for on-the-go witches.

You can place this backpack down/pick it up by &6shift right clicking&r it. You can &aopen it with &6b&r and &aequip it in your &bBack curio slot&r to free up inventory space. This keybind &dmay overlap&r with the backpacked keybind.
Backpacks can be found only in &cEnd City&r loot, making them an extremely valuable late game find.
Caution: although you can block other players from opening your backpack while you wear it, there is &dno way to protect against this backpack being stolen&r if you set it down or put it in a chest.
cottagewitch.storage.quests38.subtitle: finally!
cottagewitch.storage.quests38.title: A More Sophisticated Backpack
cottagewitch.storage.quests39.descriptio: Collecting lots of water or lava but don't want to carry all those buckets? The &bTank Upgrade&r allows you to &6add and remove buckets of fluid from the tank&r, storing far more while only sacrificing a few slots of the backpack. &bStack Upgrades&r also increase your tank size.

Going on a deep mining trip with your mending tools? Consider equipping the tank alongside an &bExperience Pump&r to store exp and dish it out as needed. Keep in mind, you will need to &dfully empty the previous fluid&r before using the pump.
To get the most of these upgrades, we suggest &6checking out the settings tab&r for each one.
Your settings will be saved for each upgrade &aeven if you remove it.&r
cottagewitch.storage.quests39.subtitle: baby got camelback
cottagewitch.storage.quests39.title: Fluid On The Go
cottagewitch.storage.quests40.descriptio: As you improve your backpack, you will unlock upgrade slots. Just like with &lSophisticated Storage&r, you can use those slots to &aincrease stack size&r with the &bStack Upgrades&r or &aautomatically compact items&r with the &bCompacting Upgrade&r to maximize storage space.
cottagewitch.storage.quests40.subtitle: mary poppins got nothin' on this
cottagewitch.storage.quests40.title: Inventory Management
cottagewitch.storage.quests41.descriptio: These upgrades will help you take your workshop with you. Each one does what it says on the tin... &bcrafting tables&r, &banvils&r, &bsmelters&r... who needs a base? You can live the life of a true adventurer.
To get the most of these upgrades, we suggest &6checking out the settings tab&r for each one.
Your settings will be saved for each upgrade &aeven if you remove it.&r
cottagewitch.storage.quests41.subtitle: live out of your backpack
cottagewitch.storage.quests41.title: Utility Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests42.descriptio: Don't you get tired of having to &aopen your backpack to get things&r? Isn't it annoying to have to &aput food in your mouth&r every time you're hungry? Who has time to &aswitch between their axe and pickaxe&r when harvesting materials?

Get yourself a backpack that does it all with these upgrades. No more wasted time &agrabbing the next stack of blocks&r or even &aopening your backpack to refill it.&r You're busy and have more important matters to attend to.
To get the most of these upgrades, we suggest &6checking out the settings tab&r for each one.
Your settings will be saved for each upgrade &aeven if you remove it.&r
cottagewitch.storage.quests42.subtitle: \"i don't like to do anything\" - Docm77
cottagewitch.storage.quests42.title: Shortcut Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests43.descriptio: You did it. You made the Perfect Backpack. a lever of infinite size could not pry this backpack from reality.
cottagewitch.storage.quests43.subtitle: this backpack is now a canon event
cottagewitch.storage.quests44.descriptio: These upgrades allow your backpack to operate outside the confines of its leather!
&6Pickup Upgrade&r will reroute any items you pick up to enter your backpack instead of your inventory.
&6Magnet Upgrade&r will draw items to your backpack from a distance!
&6Jukebox Upgrade&r will allow you to be that one hiker who always brings their bluetooth speaker with them to bless the entire trail with the soothing tunes of Nicki Minaj.
To get the most of these upgrades, we suggest &6checking out the settings tab&r for each one.
Your settings will be saved for each upgrade &aeven if you remove it.&r
cottagewitch.storage.quests44.subtitle: let 'em know you're coming
cottagewitch.storage.quests44.title: Environmental Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests45.descriptio: For an elegant and low-impact storage option, you need more than just magic: introducing Magitech, an unholy collaboration between computers and the arcane. This system is &acompatible with most storage options&r but we &dcaution you against&r combining the power of &lSophisticated Storage&r with &lApplied Energistics&r as it &dcan cause phantasmal warping (read: significant lag)&r.

The storage granted by this mod utilizes &agem resonance&r, &aplanar relay&r, and &aa Nexus network&r to contain your items in a very compact area. Because of this, it is &aentirely self-contained&r, and does not require &bmundane storage options&r such as &bchests&r, &bbarrels&r, or &bdrawers&r.
Oh, and take this &bsquirrel&r - &oit's a secret tool that will help us later!&r (It's not that secret, you need it for a later step.)
cottagewitch.storage.quests45.subtitle: the ultimate storage solution
cottagewitch.storage.quests45.title: Applying Crystallian Energistics
cottagewitch.storage.quests46.descriptio: To begin, familiarize yourself with the basic crafting ingredients of &lApplied Energistics&r: &bCertus Quartz&r can be found growing in &cGeodes underground&r.
&bCertus quartz buds&r will sprout from &bbudding certus blocks&r, similar to &bAmethyst&r. There are 4 tiers of budding certus blocks: &aFlawless, Flawed, Chipped, and Damaged&r.
With the lower 3 tiers, every time a bud grows by another stage, the &abudding block has a chance to &ddegrade by one tier&r, eventually turning into a plain &bCertus Quartz Block&r.

&bFlawless Budding Certus&r does not degrade, and can only be obtained by making it into a &lCreate&r railcart &bContraption&r. The lower tiers can be obtained by &6mining with &bSilk Touch&r, or by &6throwing the &bCertus Block&r and a &bConsecrated Certus Crystal&r into some &bwater&r and letting them combine.
You can grow buds faster by &6placing the budding blocks adjacent to a &bCrystal Growth Accelerator&r, which needs to be powered from the top or bottom.
Now, hold onto this &bBucket of Tomato Sauce&r, it's important.
cottagewitch.storage.quests47.descriptio: To obtain &bFluix Crystals&r, you need to &6submerge a &bConsecrated Certus Quartz&r with &bRedstone Dust&r and mundane &bQuartz&r in a &bliquid&r. Did you keep that &bTomato Sauce&r?
...You already drank it? Fine, you can &aalso use &bWater&r, I guess. Since you hate fun.
cottagewitch.storage.quests48.descriptio: Having every block directly connected to another can become a bit bulky. Here are some local options for spreading it out a bit.

The &bcable&r is extremely simple- use it to &aconnect various &lNexus&r &ablocks across a distance&r. We strongly recommend you use &bcables&r with your system instead of &lPipez&r as it is &dmuch more performant&r.
The &bQuartz Fiber&r works like the &bCable&r, however it only transfers power and doesnt connect things to the network.
To learn about &awireless options&r, move to the next quests!
cottagewitch.storage.quests48.subtitle: wire you doing this to me?
cottagewitch.storage.quests49.descriptio: The &bVibrant Interface&r allows your &aNexus&r to &acommunicate with other mods&r like &lPipez&r and &lCreate&r. It acts like a &amini inventory&r that you can connect your &aNexus&r to. Any item that gets piped into a &bVibrant Interface&r will be &adirectly stored&r inside your &aNexus&r storage &dif your &bGlyphstones&r &dhave space&r.

&6Right clicking&r on the &bVibrant Interface&r or the &bNexus Interface&r will allow you to &6select&r &aitems or fluids&r to &akeep stocked&r in your &bInterface&r inventory. The top part of the &bInterface&r inventory &aselects which item or fluid&r to pull out of the &aNexus&r storage and &akeep stocked&r in the bottom part. Items in the bottom part can then be &apiped out&r of the &bInterface&r using other mods.
cottagewitch.storage.quests49.title: Vibrant Interface
cottagewitch.storage.quests50.descriptio: The &bLodestone Core&r is the source from which your entire storage system &awill draw its power&r. &6Craft one&r using the &bStarbuncle Wheel&r you were given. Don't worry - they'll be fine in there! A &bBlock of Gold&r is more than enough to keep them happy!

Every other block in your storage system will &6have to be connected to this block&r, or &6connected to another storage block&r that is connected to this block (we'll get into &aremote access&r later!).
cottagewitch.storage.quests50.subtitle: infinite power...itty bitty living space
cottagewitch.storage.quests51.descriptio: Now that you have the power, you'll need a repository for holding your things! The &bGlyphic Repository&r is a block that allows you to store up to 10 Glyphstones, each capable of holding up to 63 &aunique item types&r, and anywhere between &a1,000 and 256,000 items of those types&r. For more information, check the next page. You can connect multiple Glyphic Repositories to the system, but let's start with the &bPrimal Glyphstone&r.

To start storing things, you will first need to &6craft&r a &bPrimal Resonant Gem&r and a protective &bGem Setting&r to house it. You can craft these two items together to create a &bGlyphstone&r. Empty &bGlyphstones&r (ones that are &anot currently storing items&r) can be disassembled into their separate parts by &6shift-clicking with it in your hand&r.
&aClick or scroll to move to the next page&r.

Regardless of &bGlyphstone&r tier, the number of item types are limited to 63. Unstackable items count as 1 type, so even if you had a &bTranscendent Glyphstone&r, capable of holding over 250k total items, you could still only hold 63 golden chestplates with different enchantments on or damage to them.
Which brings us nicely to our next order of business:
It seemed deserving of a graphic. &aNBT data is a form of eldritch curse, stemming from the depths&r.

It is used to determine things such as how much damage a tool has taken, what kind of animal is caught in the lasso, or what enchantments are placed on your armor. Due to the arcane nature of this data, it causes &dphantasmal warping (read: significant lag)&r when in the network, so it is recommended you &akeep your storage uncursed&r by &6periodically removing all items with NBT from your Resonance network&r. You can easily do this by &6searching \"nbt\"&r in your &bAperture&r &4(toggle on advanced tooltips with F3+H first)&r, and then &6removing those items&r to store elsewhere (such as &lSophisticated&r containers that are not connected to the &bResonance Network&r).
cottagewitch.storage.quests52.descriptio: The &bPlanar Relay&r is made using the fairy ring. Inside your fairy ring, toss an &bEye of Ender&r, &bRough Lazurite&r, &bTablet of Binding&r, and &bConsecrated Certus Quartz Crystal&r. You will need to &await about one minute&r and the items will combined into your &bPlanar Relay&r!

&6Exploding&r a &bPlanar Relay&r and an &bEnder Dust&r will &airreversibly entangle two smaller Planar Relays together&r, but also put a hole in your base. &6Try using the &bTiny TNT&r &6instead&r! These &bEntangled Planar Relays&r will help you gain interdimensional storage access.

The two &bEntangled Planar Relays&r you create represent &atwo halves of a shared connection&r, &dyou will need both, so don't lose them&r! If you want more than one cross dimensional &bResonant Aperture&r connected to your &aNexus&r, you will need to &aentangle a new&r &bPlanar Relay&r to link them.
cottagewitch.storage.quests52.subtitle: it's a quantum leap
cottagewitch.storage.quests53.descriptio: &aConnecting across the dimensions&r requires a bigger antenna than just one &bResonance Access Point&r. To accomplish this you'll need to build... a square! &6Build this 3x3 structure&r consisting of 8 &bPlanar Relay Tethers&r surrounding 1 &bPlanar Relay Link Chamber&r and &6connect it to your nexus network using a cable&r.
&6You'll need to insert 1 of the&r &bEntangled Planar Relays&r &6you made in to the&r &bPlanar Relay Link Chamber&r. &aDon't lose the other one - you'll need it in just a minute.&r

If you want to connect a second &bResonant Aperture&r, you will need to &6make a second Planar Relay Link 3x3 structure&r. You can &arepeat this process for as many&r &bResonant Apertures&r as you want &ainterdimensionally connected&r to your &aNexus&r.
&dMake sure to chunk load this location so you can access your system while you're away. &r
cottagewitch.storage.quests54.descriptio: The last step for your &ainterdimensional access&r is inputting the &bPlanar Bridge Card&r and the Linked &bEntangled Planar Relay&r into your &bResonant Aperture&r.
&dMake sure to be in range of your &bResonance Access Point&r &din order to open your&r &bResonant Aperture&r! See the image below for where to place these items inside your &bResonant Aperture&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests55.descriptio: So your storage is &awireless&r, but how do you &aaccess the contents when you're away&r? You'll need to &6craft&r a &bResonant Aperture&r, of course.
When you craft the &bResonant Aperture&r, it will start &aunattuned&r. &aTo attune it to your nexus&r you must &6insert it into a&r &bGuardian Ward&r.
After you've &aattuned&r your &bResonant Aperture&r, you must be within range of a &bResonance Access Point&r for it to work. With no upgrades, this is &dlimited to 16 blocks&r.

If you would like to &aextend the range&r beyond that of your access points, you can add on &bResonance Boosters&r to get a &amax range of 528 blocks&r. You can gain &ainfinite, cross dimensional access&r by creating a &bPlanar Bridge Card&r and a &bLinked Entangled Planar Relay&r to upgrade your &bResonant Aperture&r with (see the next quest).
Over time and with use, the &bResonant Aperture&r may &alose resonance&r, and if this occurs, you can &6place it in a &bCharging Gadget&r to fill it back up with resonance.
cottagewitch.storage.quests55.subtitle: akin to a bag of holding
cottagewitch.storage.quests56.descriptio: Although covens are common amongst modern witches, there is something to be said for &aprivacy&r. In order to claim your Nexus - and link your &bResonant Apertures&r - you will need a &bGuardian Ward&r and a &bWard Bypass&r.

The &eGuardian&r is a spirit which inhabits the mechanical chassis known as the &bWard&r, and they will protect your Nexus so long as they are &aproperly connected&r (it merely has to be touching the other blocks).

The &bWard Bypass&r is an item which allows you to claim ownership of a given Nexus, and also to configure the behavior of your Nexus. To alter the &bBypass&r, place it in the &bGuardian Ward&r and &6select the appropriate permissions&r, as in the image below.

This &bBypass&r is currently unclaimed, and if placed inside the &bGuardian Ward&r, it will apply the given permissions to anyone accessing the system. However, you can further configure access to your Nexus by having your coven &aclaim a Bypass&r with the permissions you've set on it.

To claim a &bWard Bypass&r, a player should &6hold it in their hand and shift-click&r. Once the &bBypass&r belongs to that player, you can &6place it inside the &bGuardian Ward&r to give that player the permissions enscrolled in that Bypass.

&dA quick note on Nexus owners&r - if you were the person to &aplace down the &bGuardian Ward&r, you cannot deposit a claimed &bBypass&r. This is designed to prevent witches from accidentally banning themselves from their own Nexus.
cottagewitch.storage.quests56.subtitle: magical security
cottagewitch.storage.quests57.descriptio: Now you've got your power, and your storage. Now you just need a way to access it! Build yourself a &bScrying Nexus&r to be able to add and remove items from your &bRepository&r. Make sure to place it upon a cable connected to the &bRepository&r. Remember- &aeverything must have direct contact&r with a cable or another part of your system.
If you'd like to be able to craft within your &bScrying Nexus&r, you can &6craft it together&r with a &bCrystal Ball&r and &bCrafting Table&r.

That's it- that's literally &aall you need to know&r for a basic setup. Everything else is a bonus! If you'd like to &alearn more&r or &aconnect up to your existing storage&r, check out the optional quests!
cottagewitch.storage.quests58.descriptio: The &bCable Anchor&r is an item which, when placed on the side of a &bCable&r, will prevent that cable from connecting to another compatible one.

For example, a &bcolored cable&r has compatibility with other cables of that same color, or &bFluix cables&r, meaning that if they are placed beside each other, &athey will connect&r. If you want to prevent this, placing a &bCable Anchor&r on the side will keep them from connecting. Alternatively, you can always &ause different colored Cables to hook up Nexus points without interfering with other processes.

The &bToggle Anchor&r functions similarly to the &bCable Anchor&r in terms of placement, however allows the connection to be enabled or disabled by redstone power. The basic &bToggle Anchor&r &arequires a redstone signal in order to allow the connection&r. The &bInverted Toggle Anchor&r is the opposite, &abeing always on unless provided with redstone signal&r.

The &bLevel Emitter&r will &aprovide a redstone signal based on configurable conditions&r. To access these, you can &6right click on the Emitter&r to access its interface. You can &adefine an item for the &bEmitter&r to monitor, and &achoose what set of rules you would like it to use&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests58.subtitle: don't get tangled
cottagewitch.storage.quests58.title: Cable Utilities
cottagewitch.storage.quests59.descriptio: Nearly every part of your &lApplied Energistics 2&r system can be coloured simply by &6attaching it to a colored cable&r!

To hide unsightly cables, you can &6craft any block with &b4 Cable Anchors&r to make 4 &bFacades&r. &bFacades&r can be &6applied to any side&r of a &bcable&r, including sides with attachments such as the &bNexus Crafting Aperture&r and will be &ainside the block &owith&r &athe cable&r- not taking up any extra space!
Facades &dcan be removed&r once they have been placed on a &bcable block&r by &6shift+right clicking them with a wrench&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests60.descriptio: You can easily connect external storage to your system using... the &bNexus Storage Anchor&r!
Simply &6place a &bCable&r &6and &bStorage Anchor &6against a storage block to connect it&r. This can then be linked back to the rest of the &aNexus&r.

You can &6right click on this block&r to access its GUI, where you can choose to &alimit how items flow into and out of your external storage&r via the functions on the lefthand side. Each one of the options has a helpful hover tooltip to better explain what it does.

Note: once you start connecting multiple storages, you will want to start Prioritising them. &aSetting the Priority&r of your storage blocks tells your &aNexus&r &awhere to store items&r that you add into the system, as well as &awhere to extract them from first&r when removing something from the system. &6Click to the next page&r to learn about &aPriority&r.
&aPriority&r can be adjusted for each &bGlyph Repository&r, &bStorage Anchor&r, and &bVibrant Interface&r. You'll find &aPriority&r especially helpful for &akeeping your storage tidy.&r
The number here can be &6adjusted using the buttons&r, or by &6typing a value&r into the box. &aPriority&r can be a positive or negative number.

&dHere's an example&r: you keep much of your storage in your &bGlyphic Repository&r. But you have a gold farm which feeds into a simple &lFunctional Storage&r &bdrawer&r setup. If you set a higher priority to the &bStorage Anchor&r connected to these drawers, any time you &aadd or remove gold from your console&r, the system will &acheck the priority list&r and choose this location first.
cottagewitch.storage.quests60.subtitle: bigger is better
cottagewitch.storage.quests61.descriptio: The &bResonance Access Point&r is the core of &awireless access&r. However, the magic of &awireless connectivity&r can only reach so far. By default the range is &a16 blocks&r. You can &aincrease this range&r by &6inserting&r &bResonance Boosters&r &6into the&r &bResonance Access Point&r!

Additional &bResonance Access Points&r can be &aadded to different physical sections&r of your &aNexus&r to enable another &a16 block radius&r of &awireless access&r around that &bResonance Access Point&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests62.descriptio: Each &bResonance Booster&r increases the &arange of your wireless access&r. To add a &bResonance Booster&r, &6right click&r your &bResonance Access Point&r and add anywhere from 1 to 64 &bResonance Boosters&r. The range of your &awireless access&r increases with each upgrade to a &amax of 528 blocks&r.
This upgrade is not needed if you use the &bPlanar Relay Link Ring&r for &across dimensional wireless access&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests62.subtitle: that resonates with me
cottagewitch.storage.quests63.descriptio: Collecting 8 mushrooms and &aplacing them in a ring&r will create a fairy ring. Make sure to place them on &ablocks that can grow mushrooms&r, such as &bmycelium&r. You can then &6drop items into the fairy ring&r to &acreate new items&r!
cottagewitch.storage.quests63.subtitle: a bit of help from the fae
cottagewitch.storage.quests64.descriptio: The &bDiscernment Glyphstone&r allows you to filter which items in your Nexus you view from a given &bAperture&r. You can program them by using the &bGlyph Workbench&r.

Place the &bGlyphstone&r in the &6upper right slot&r to alter its contents. Then, you can insert ghosts of items from &ayour inventory or even JEI&r by clicking and dragging the item into its inventory.
Once you have finished configuring the glyphstone, you can &6place the &bDiscernment Glyphstone&r into the upper right slots of your Nexus Aperture.
cottagewitch.storage.quests64.subtitle: viewer discretion is advised
cottagewitch.storage.quests65.descriptio: Depending on how robust your storage network is, you may find it useful to &aautomagically transfer items&r from - for example - your &lSophisticated Storage&r setup to your &lApplied Energistics&r Nexus.
To do this, you'll want &bImport and Export Fulcrums&r.

The &bImport Fulcrum&r and &bExport Fulcrum&r are a must for a busy witch. Consider them to be &aupgradeable, filterable hoppers&r that can feed &adirectly into and out of your system&r. This is particularly helpful for unloading or loading &bShulkers&r and &bBackpacks&r.

The &bVibrant Communicator&r is similar, but instead of interacting with external storage, it allows you to &atransfer items into and out of&r &bGlyphstones&r. &6Switch the Transfer Direction to &aNetwork &6or &aStorage Glyph&r and &6place your &bGlyphstone&r&6 in the left slot&r. When the transfer is complete your &bGlyphstone&r will be automatically &amoved to the right slot&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests65.title: Automation
cottagewitch.storage.quests66.descriptio: Every witch loves to tinker - we just can't leave well enough alone! And to support this habit, there are certain &bUpgrades&r to your &bStorage Nexus&r which can improve your overall experience.

They are deceptively simple to make, so long as you have some &bConsecrated Quartz&r (and perhaps other gems). Form these into a &bTablet&r, and then &6carve that tablet with certain components&r to create enhancements, which you can learn more about in the following quests!
cottagewitch.storage.quests66.title: Upgrading Your Nexus
cottagewitch.storage.quests67.descriptio: In addition to the &bCarved Certus Tablets&r, you can also craft &aadvanced upgrades&r using &bFluix Tablets&r.
Fluix as a crystal has certain properties - a pseudo-sentience, if you will. In order to perform tasks which require some \"smart\" functions, it's a much better choice than plain &bCertus&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests67.title: Even Better Nexus Upgrades
cottagewitch.storage.quests68.descriptio: When inserted, this upgrade allows you to &acontrol a certain component with &bRedstone&r. This can include &apowering, deactivating, and pulsing&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests68.subtitle: Chaos Control
cottagewitch.storage.quests69.descriptio: This upgrade &aallows you to add further filter refinement&r (say that five times fast) to certain objects.
cottagewitch.storage.quests69.subtitle: we heard u like filters so we added more filter to ur filter
cottagewitch.storage.quests70.descriptio: A very important upgrade - this tablet, when configured, will &avoid overflow items&r which would &dotherwise clog your system&r and cause lag.
cottagewitch.storage.quests71.descriptio: This tablet can be inserted into a &bFilter&r to allow you to discern between, or ignore the differences between, similar items with &aNBT data&r such as &adamage levels&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests72.descriptio: As you can imagine, the &bAcceleration tablet&r allows you to speed up certain aspects of your Nexus.
cottagewitch.storage.quests73.descriptio: The &bInverter Tablet&r changes Nexus filters from a whitelist to a blacklist.
cottagewitch.storage.quests74.descriptio: The &bEqual Distribution Tablet&r &asplits Glyphstone's resonations into equally sized sections&r, based on the filter that you set for the &bGlyphstone&r using the &bGlyph Workbench&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests75.descriptio: Is your &bportable aperture&r running low on &aresonance&r on a frequent basis? You can expand the capacity by &ainserting this upgrade&r.
cottagewitch.storage.quests76.descriptio: The &bGlyph Workbench&r is used to &aalter the behavior of &bGlyphstones&r. When accessing its interface, you can place the &bGlyph&r you wish to edit into the upper right slot, and then use the center inventory to &adefine what items this Glyph will accept&r.

You can define items by &6clicking and dragging them into the Workbench&r, either from your own inventory, or from JEI. Additionally, if you already have the desired items stored on the Glyphstone, you can &6choose the wrench icon in the upper left&r. You can also clear configured items by &aclicking the x icon&r.
You can insert an &bInverter Tablet&r to make the Glyphstone &areject the configured items&r instead.
cottagewitch.storage.quests76.subtitle: a glimpse into the gems
cottagewitch.storage.quests77.descriptio: To obtain &bConsecrated Certus Quartz&r, you need only &atake Certus and consecrate it&r! It's that easy!

...Oh, you want to know &ohow&r. Fine. To &aConsecrate&r an item, pass it over a candle's flame, and the power of the elements will sanctify it. To put it simply: &6right click the &bQuartz&6 onto a &bCandle&r. You can use both &lvanilla&r Candles, and those from &lHexerei&r.

Vanilla candles will &aextinguish with use&r, but Hexerei ones will not. Additionally, if you were to set a &bDeployer&r to do it for you, it handles the crystals so delicately that the flame does not go out.
cottagewitch.storage.quests78.descriptio: You can grow buds faster by &6placing the budding blocks adjacent to a &bCrystal Growth Accelerator&r, which needs to be powered from the top or bottom. You can tell when a &ablock is powered&r by &6observing the tooltip&r provided by &lJade&r that states &adevice online&r.
This includes &aother budding crystals&r such as &bBudding Amethyst&r, &bBudding Ametrine Ore&r, &bBudding Therium Crystal&r, and &bBudding Subzero Crystal&r!
cottagewitch.storage.title: Storage
cottagewitch.the_end.quests0.description: Normally, to get to &dThe End&r requires regular old &bEnder Eyes&r, for both seeking and filling the portal frames. However, magic has warped this world, making it more difficult to face the final dimension.
There are, instead, 16 other eyes (you'l,l need 12 unique eyes to open the portal), which can be found in various ways. &6See the following quests&r for more information on them.

To seek the &dStronghold&r, you can use any of these eyes the way you would use a regular &bEnder Eye&r. Be careful though- &athey still break!&r Maybe only use any doubles you've found for this. Alternatively, you can locate the Stronghold with an &bExplorer's Compass&r and save your eyes!
cottagewitch.the_end.quests0.subtitle: I've got my eye on the End
cottagewitch.the_end.quests0.title: Obtain an End Eye
cottagewitch.the_end.quests1.description: The first of these new items is called &bThe Old Eye&r, which once belonged to one of the now-extinct Great Sandworms. This sallow eye can be looted from &dDesert Temple&r chests.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests2.description: The &bNether Eye&r once belonged to a demon, who lost it in a might battle between the Aether and Nether. It can be found in chests inside - you guessed it - &dNether Fortresses&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests3.description: The &bCold Eye&r once belonged to an Iceologer, and can be found hidden in &dan igloo's hidden basement&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests4.description: A &bRogue Eye&r can be found in a &dJungle Temple&r, and is rumored to have given our ancestors Redstone.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests5.description: The &bBlack Eye&r, which once gave sight to the mighty Black Pearl, is now hidden beneath the surface in some &dBuried Treasure&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests6.description: Starting a &aRaid&r might be the easiest way of obtaining the &bMagical Eye&r, which are used by &eEvokers&r for their powerful properties.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests7.description: Forged in the time before history began by ancient Blacksmiths, the &bLost Eye&r is said to be found in &dMineshafts&r, deep beneath the crust of the earth.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests8.description: Rumors swirl about the &bCorrupted Eye&r, of its ability to bring infinite fortune to its owner. However, the greedy king who last owned it faded into obscurity, so perhaps those rumors are just that. Legend has it that it's kept in a &dPillager Tower&r somewhere.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests9.description: You can perhaps guess where the &bGuardian Eye&r can be located. Beneath the surface of the choppy sea, in the belly of an &eElder Guardian&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests10.descriptio: To obtain the &bWitch Eye&r, you must first &dslay an evil witch&r and get the &bWitch’s Pupil&r, then craft it together with an &bEnder Eye&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests11.descriptio: The &bCursed Eye&r is found within the &dTreasure Bastion&r’s chests. It is a powerful, destructive artifact which the Piglins will defend with their lives.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests12.descriptio: The &bEvil Eye&r is a symbol of protection, staring down the foes of its owner. It can be purchase from a &dMaster Cleric&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests13.descriptio: This eye is said to be favored by Chosen Undead. The &bUndead Eye&r can be crafted using an &bUndead Soul&r, acquired from killing a &eSkeleton Horse&r, or a large number of &eWraiths&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests14.descriptio: The &bExotic Eye&r is associated with Atlantis - the legends say that folks used it to find the sunken city, but they never returned to confirm the tale. &6Craft it with aquatic items&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests15.descriptio: You did it! You beat the game. Congrats, you can all go home now.
...oh, you're staying. Well, hooray! Maybe check out the other quests, since you're here!
cottagewitch.the_end.quests16.descriptio: You killed the Dragon twice? Well, my goodness.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests16.subtitle: Well that's just excessive
cottagewitch.the_end.quests17.descriptio: You've found your way to &dThe End&r, congratulations. With luck, your journey will continue.
Remember that if you need to explore out over the void, you can do so on your &bBroom&r, or by taming a &eSpace Whale&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests17.subtitle: Haha, get it? \"The End\"?
cottagewitch.the_end.quests17.title: The Beginning of the End
cottagewitch.the_end.quests18.descriptio: You may only need 12 &bEyes&r to pass into &cThe End&r, but if you go above and beyond, and collect all possible eyes, you will be granted a reward.
Once you have &6collected at least 1 of each Eye&r, you may check this button and receive a unique armor set.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests20.descriptio: Swimming in &bEggs&r? That sounds unpleasant. You can &atrade in a &bDragon Egg&r to receive a &bDragon Head&r.
cottagewitch.the_end.quests20.subtitle: you egghead
cottagewitch.the_end.quests20.title: Getting Ahead in the End
cottagewitch.the_end.quests21.descriptio: Some eyes have a pretty low chance of being found, but not this eye! Killing the&e Wither&r give you two 90%% rolls on getting a &bWither Eye&r. You might even get two!
And all you need to do is &6defeat a Wither&r,
cottagewitch.the_end.title: The End
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests0.des: Welcome to the Twilight Forest! This dimension can be dangerous to navigate, although it is convieniently laid out with its &amajor landmarks in a grid&r.
The first thing you will want is a &bMap&r, and for that, you'll need to find a &eRaven&r.
And remember! &6If you get lost or wander into an inaccessible zone, look for Kobolds&r. They will be carrying the journal of previous adventurers, which will clue you in to your next goal.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests1.des: &dThe Twilight Forest&r is a night-ridden dimension filled with mysteries and odd creatures both friendly and hostile. Freely traveling the dimension is difficult - you must conquer each challenge in turn in order to traverse.

To &amake the portal&r, you must &6dig a 3x3x1 (or 2x2x1) hole and fill it with water&r. Then, &6surround the pond with flowers or mushrooms&r. Finally, &6throw a Diamond into the pool&r. Beware, opening a portal can be dangerous!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests1.sub: Throw it in a limpid pool and then back away
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests2.des: The &eForest Raven&r is a creature that can often be found near &aObsidian Obelisks&r in the Twilight Forest. It can be &6slain for it's feathers&r, which are important for making the &bMagical Map Focus&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests2.sub: Unfortunately, you have to kill it
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests3.des: Craft a &bMagic Map Focus&r with a &bRaven Feather&r, some &bGlowstone Dust&r, and &bTorchberries&r (which can be found in Twilight Forest caves).
Then you can surround it with &bPaper&r to create a Magic Map, which will prove invaluable to your quest through the &dTwilight Forest&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests4.des: One of the features in the Twilight Forest is the &aHedge Maze&r. It is a labyrinth filled with spawners and chests full of loot!
It does not count towards, nor require, any progression through the Forest.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests4.sub: Now you can be a Hedge Witch!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests5.des: The &bOre Magnet&r can sometimes be found inside &dHollow Hills&r, and when used, will &apull entire veins of ores from the ground&r! Simply &6hold right click while aiming at the ground&r and the ores will be moved up to you!
It can be enchanted with Unbreaking or Mending.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests6.des: &bSteeleaf&r is a material which can be used to create pre-enchanted armor that is slightly better than Iron.
Additionally, blocks of Steeleaf will reduce fall damage by 25%% when landed on.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests7.des: Break down the &aLiveroots&r beneath a Tree in order to obtain them. This item can be combined with &bIron&r and &bGold&r in order to create &bIronwood&r, which can be used to create pre-enchanted pieces of gear.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests8.des: The &bPeacock Feather Fan&r is an item which sends out a mighty gust of wind when &6right clicked&r.
You can use this to gain an advantage in combat, or even to give yourself a boost in midair, when jumping or using &bElytra&r!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests9.des: &bThe Moonworm Queen&r is an...item...that is filled with Moonworms. When you &6right click her&r, they will be dispensed - either directly onto a surface, or shot like an arrow. The moonworms serve no purpose other than &aas a light source&r. You can replenish the Queen by crafting her with &bTorchberries&r, and get...even more worms. Yay.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests9.sub: You might want to sit down for this one
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests10.de: One of the most valuable items in the game, &bThe Uncrafting Table&r allows you to &arecoup materials from crafted items&r in exchange for experience levels. &6Place the unwanted item in the left slot&r and then &6click one of the ingredients&r in the center to remove it.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests11.de: The first boss you must face is the block-destroying &eNaga&r. It is a long serpent who slowly shrinks in length as you damage him.
If the player flees the courtyard, the Naga will return to the center.
Once he's defeated, &6be sure to loot the chest that he spawns&r, as you will need the &bNaga Trophy&r inside of it.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests12.de: Defeat &eNaga&r in the &dTwilight Forest&r to obtain their scales. Then, relinquish those scales in exchange for loot!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests12.su: A chance to use unwanted scales
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests13.de: Inside the &dLich Tower&r is the undead noble of the Twilight Forest. His &aCastle&r is fraught with mobs, but also filled with loot.
It is recommended to be well-geared before attempting this structure.
At the top of the tower, you will find the &eLich&r, who is surrounded by a shield which protects him. &6He must be defeated first with his own magic&r, then martial might can finish the fight.
And beware of the copies he summons during the fight!
Defeating the &eLich&r grants you access to the &dYeti's Lair&r, the &dDark Forest&r, and the &dSwamp&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests14.de: The Labyrinth, found in the depths of &dthe Swamp&r, houses a number of nasty creatures, culminating in the vicious &eMinotaurs&r and &eMinoshroom&r.
The Minoshroom will drop &bMeef Stroganoff&r, which when eaten, will innoculate you against the curse of the &dFire Swamp&r, allowing you to progress.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests15.de: The &eHydra&r is a fearsome foe that is only weak in one place: within its fire-spewing maw!

It is best to take on this fight with &a Fire Resistance&r, and make sure you &aim attacks at the Hydra's open mouths&r! You can use a &branged weapon&r, or use a sword to &adeflect their bombs&r back at them.
Once you have defeated the beast, you have completed one task which will let you challenge the Highlands.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests15.su: Remove one head, and two appear!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests16.de: There is little point trying to mine through the incredibly tough blocks of the Labyrinth. Unless, however, you loot this item: &bThe Mazebreaker&r.
This tool mines Labyrinth blocks faster, and with less durability loss, than any other. It can be looted from the Labyrinth chests.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests16.su: Now why would you break a perfectly good maze?
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests17.de: Earn yourself some loot by slaying a few Hydras and trading in their blood for a chance at something valuable!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests17.su: A chance to use unwanted blood
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests18.de: Located in the gloomy depths of the &dDark Forest&r, the Knight Stronghold is infested with &eGoblins&r, and you cannot enter without one of the &bTrophies&r from the previous bosses.
You can use &bMaze Maps&r here, but the structures are so massive that you may need a number of them.
It is recommended to &6mark your path with torches&r to ensure that you don't double back by mistake.

The end of this dungeon contains a fight against the &eKnight Phantoms&r. These will not follow you out of the room, and can swarm you if you simply charge in. It is recommended to &6retreat out to the hallway periodically if healing is needed&r.
Once you defeat them, you can now challenge the &dDark Tower&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests19.de: In the Center of the &dDark Forest&r, the Dark Tower can be found. It is a massive structure, filled with monsters, and ruled over by a deadly &eUr-Ghast&r.
