There are four smaller turrets, each containing a &bTower Key&r. These keys are used to unlock the central tower. There are many challenges here to undergo, so be prepared for a long expedition.
To defeat the &eUr-Ghast&r, you must defeat his &eCarminite Ghastlings&r in the nearby rooms, near the Ghast Traps. Then and when the beast draws near, activate the trap.
The Ur-Ghast is one of the 3 bosses you must defeat to access the &dHighlands&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests19.su: I ain't afraid of no ghast
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests20.de: The Yeti Cave can be found in the Snowy Forest, and houses both &eYetis&r (which are neutral), and the &eAlpha Yeti&r, who is the boss you must face in this area.
Engaging this foe in melee combat can be dangerous, but even at range one must &abeware of falling icicles&r!
His death will grant you access to &dthe Glacier&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests21.de: The &eSnow Queen&r is found at the top of the &dAurora Palace&r, a treacherous mansion filled with icy monsters and slippery parkour.
The Queen herself has three phases, and cannot be damaged through her &aIce Throne&r, so only her upper body can be targeted.
When she is defeated, you have completed one of three tasks to gain access to &dThe Highlands&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests21.su: There's an Elsa joke in here somewhere
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests22.de: You've finally reached the Highlands! This is going to sound suspicious, but hear me out: you need to find some &bMagic Beans&r.
You can obtain some either by killing &eTrolls&r underground, or by looting their obsidian-bound Caches.
Then, find a large patch of &bUberous Soil&r, above which the &eGiants&r live. You'll need to defeat their Miner to obtain his &bGiant Pickaxe&r.
Then, you can &6return underground and use the Giant Pick&r to break open the large Obsidian Vault. It will take a while.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests23.de: In the heart of the &cThorns&r lies a castle which used to hold the final boss - a &epowerful Kobold&r strong enough to &abreak the back of the Warden with ease&r. Who knows where it's gone?
Some day, the Twilight Forest may rise again... but hey- good job! You did it! Here's a reward.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests23.su: your kobold is in another castle
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests23.ti: Gain Access to the Final Castle
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests32.de: Find yourself a &eQuest Ram&r and you'll notice it seems to be missing something.
Maybe give it some &amore wool&r. Specifically, &6one of each color of wool&r.
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.quests33.de: Once you complete the &eFinal Castle&r, obtained the &bLamp of Cinders&r, and even &6Completed the &eQuest Ram&r, you will finally have earned this unique armor set. Wear it with pride!
cottagewitch.twilight_forest.title: Twilight Forest
cottagewitch.welcome.quests0.description: This modpack has a number of building and decoration mods which are all worth looking into. &dMost of them do not have associated quests&r.

So how are you supposed to know they're there? Why, &lJEI&r of course. &6Opening your inventory&r will show you a wall of items to your right. You can search through these items at the bottom right. Type &d@&r and the name of a mod to search for only items from that mod.
For example, you can &asearch \"@another\"&r to view everything from Another Furniture. &6Left click the item&r to view its crafting recipe. &6Right click it&r to view what recipes it's used in.
This will let you view how to make anything in the game!
cottagewitch.welcome.quests0.subtitle: Take a little look-see
cottagewitch.welcome.quests1.description: This modpack adds a lot of new sounds. So to help you filter the ones you don't like, it also incl.udes &aSuper Sound Muffler&r.
&6Press F6 to open the menu&r. From here, you can click &aRecent&r to see what you've recently heard. You can play the sound to confirm it's the one you don't like, and then &6mute it!&r
cottagewitch.welcome.quests1.subtitle: Selective hearing. Literally.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests1.title: Extreme Sound Muffler
cottagewitch.welcome.quests2.description: If you want your base to stay active even when you're not there, you want &achunk loading&r. This will also help if you &ahave a vanilla-style mob farm&r.
Open your inventory and look at the top left of your screen. The &amap icon&r will lead you to the &aFTB Chunks&r screen.

Choose &bClaimed Chunks&r and &6left click&r on a chunk to claim it for your own. To unclaim, &bright click&r it. To &aload the chunk when you're not in it&r, &6shift and left click the claimed chunk&r. You can unload it by holding &6shift and right clicking&r.
When a chunk is claimed, &dother server members cannot break or interact with blocks in it&r. In order to grant someone access to your chunks, you need to &aadd them or their Team as an Ally&r.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests2.subtitle: When you're away, your base will play
cottagewitch.welcome.quests2.title: Claiming Your Space \& Chunk Loading
cottagewitch.welcome.quests3.description: FTB Teams allows you to add other players to your party, which can allow you to &ashare quest progress&r if desired, and also &aallow access to your claimed chunks&r.

The Teams screen is accessible in the &ctop left of your inventory&r. From there, you can &acreate a party&r. You can invite others if you want to share quest progress, otherwise you can simply add other players as allies via the &bManage Allies&r screen.

Note that &din order for Deployers and such to work in claimed chunks&r, you have to &6allow Fake Player access&r via FTB Teams. Press E and click on \"My Team\" in the top left. Then click the gear in the top right, and you'll see this menu:
Set \"Allow All Fake Players\" to true.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests4.description: You might be wondering where all the quests are, when your screen looks like this:
See that &aarrow on the left bar&r? &6Hovering over that&r will show you all the categories.
Be sure to &6click the Pin in the upper right&r to keep this sidebar open permanently!
cottagewitch.welcome.quests5.description: Did you know you can &apin quests&r so they &ashow on your main screen&r? You can!
Just &dbe warned that this overlaps your pinned Notes&r.
Also, perhaps I should mention that you can &apin notes&r to your screen as well! &6Press N to access your Notes menu&r.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests5.title: Pinning Other Things
cottagewitch.welcome.quests6.description: To read a book in your &bAkashic Tome&r, &6right click&r while holding the book and &6select the book you want&r.
To &areturn the Akashic Tome&r to its regular form, &6hold it and left click in the air&r.
To &aremove a book from the tome&r, you need to &6crouch and throw&r the item (default keybind is Q).
To &aadd a book&r, you should &6craft the book with the &bTome&r.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests6.title: Akashic Controls
cottagewitch.welcome.quests8.description: Looking for a particular item in a nearby inventory?
Hover over the item in JEI or your inventory and &6press the keybind&r. This &dneeds to be bound by the user&r, so find a key you like and change it in your &akeybindings menu&r.
Then, inventories containing that item will be highlighted with these little particle effects:
cottagewitch.welcome.quests8.tasks0.titl: I know how to find things now
cottagewitch.welcome.quests8.title: Finding Items In Containers
cottagewitch.welcome.quests9.description: This modpack comes with &aa lot of resourcepacks&r for you to use! Most of them should be enabled by default thanks to &lResource Pack Overrides&r, but they don't always work perfectly. If you find yourself needing to do something manually -
We recommend enabling all of them, except for the following:
- Fresh Animations (a spider and phantom-free version is already enabled!)
- Fresh Animations All Extensions (a spider and phantom-free version is already enabled!)
The order in which you enable the resourcepacks &ashould not matter&r, as they are &dedited to be compatible with one another&r.
cottagewitch.welcome.quests10.descriptio: Have you found that your &lSophisticated Storage&r or &lChipped&r textures seem messed up?
This is a known bug which is currently unfixed by the mod developers. It occurs most often when &aresourcepacks are changed with the game running&r. It can be fixed by &6restarting Minecraft&r.
cottagewitch.welcome.title: Welcome
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests0.descriptio: The &eCosmaw&r is a being which, when tamed, will &arescue its owner from falling into the void&r. It does not defend the player in other ways, however.
It can be &6tamed with Cosmic Cod&r, its natural prey.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests0.subtitle: So very Cosmaw-politan, don't you think?
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests0.title: Meet the Cosmaw
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests1.descriptio: The &eMungus&r can be found in Mushroom biomes and is a living meme. It drops &bMungal Spores&r periodically every few days, and this item can be used to breed it.
&bMushrooms&r can be placed upon it, at which point it will target that same type of mushroom and attempt to spawn more of it, or turn it to its giant variant.
A &eMungus&r which has 5 mushrooms on its back will explode when slain, changing the small nearby area to a Mushroom Fields.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests1.subtitle: Pretty sus ngl
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests1.title: Meet a Mungus
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests2.descriptio: Feed a &eRabbit&r some &bMungal Spores&r to create a &eBunfungus&r, a rather large and disturbing neutral creature which will defend the nearby area. They can be healed with &bCarrots&r, and drop &bBunfungus&r meat, which can be used in cooking.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests2.title: Create a Bunfungus
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests3.descriptio: The &eMimicube&r is a defender of End Cities, and is capable of mimicking its attacker by developing armor, shields, and even weapons to match those of the player. When defeated, they drop &bMimicream&r, which can be used in crafting, or to &aduplicate almost any item, including enchantments&r!
Simply &6surround the desired item&r with 8 Mimicream, and ta-da! The result will have no durability, but it's a powerful tool nevertheless.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests3.title: Meet the Mimicube
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests4.descriptio: The &eSnuffle&r is a passive creature with a permanent blep. It can be found in snowy biomes, and &atamed with potatoes&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests4.subtitle: So warm and snuffly
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests4.title: Meet a Snuffle!
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests5.descriptio: Quacklings are bizarre, yet friendly creatures that primarily live in Swamps. They can be traded with, just like human villagers!
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests5.subtitle: queck
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests5.title: Meet the Quacklings
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests6.descriptio: The &eGuster&r is an elemental spirit which can appear during storms. It will throw nearby entities or items up into the air, and are &aresistant to arrows&r.

Once defeated, they can drop their &bEyes&r, which can be used either to make a &bPocket of Sand&r, to throw in the face of your enemies - or the &bGustmaker&r, a block which acts as a fan when provided with a Redstone signal.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests7.descriptio: Earn this by successfully &abreeding two Froststalkers&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests8.descriptio: The &bFroststalker&r helmet is worn to convince &eFroststalkers&r that the player is one of them.
It must be crafted from one of their horns. Once it is worn, you can &6breed them with pork&r - but be warned, taking off the helmet will &dmake the babies hostile as well&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests9.descriptio: These can be obtained by &acrafting&r, and are used to &afully tame a &eTusklin&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests10.descripti: The &eTusklin&r, found in snowy biomes, can be saddled and ridden wild, but will buck the player off after a while. They can be bred with &bBrown Mushrooms&r, but their young will still be mostly feral.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests10.subtitle: A neutral but defensive beast
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests10.title: Meet the Tusklin
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests11.descripti: The &eStraddler&r is a bizarre and hostile creature who will throw their young at you to do damage. For the most part, defeating them yields &bBasalt&r, however they can rarely drop &bStraddlite&r.

&bStraddlite&r is a material which can be crafted into a Straddleboard, an enchantable board which can &asurf quickly across lava&r. This is an improvement over the &bObsidian Boat&r due to its speed, enchantability, and ability to jump!
And, as a side note, the &eStradpoles&r can be nabbed in a bucket and also &asurvive in water&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests11.subtitle: Just gonna throw my baby at you real quick
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests11.title: Meet the Straddler
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests12.descripti: The &eVoid Worm&r is a boss fight which can be summoned by throwing a &bMysterious Worm&r into the void in &dThe End&r. He summons crystalline projectiles, has a devastating bite, and is capable of opening portals.

When defeated, it drops its &bEyes&r and &bBeak&r. These can be crafted into a &bDimensional Carver&r: a pickaxe which can mine a temporary portal through space and to the player's spawn point, and the &bVoid Worm Effigy&r: a trophy that, when provided with redstone signal, chomps down on whatever is in front of it.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests12.subtitle: A multi-phase boss fight
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests12.title: Summon the Void Worm
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests13.descripti: The &eRocky Roller&r dwells in Dripstone Caves and will roll at its prey to crush them. It is weak but the strong armor on its back will protect it from most blows.

If it drops its &bRocky Hide&r, this can be crafted into a chestplate which allows the player to &aroll into mobs&r and damage them while sprinting. It will also cause the player to &asink in water&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests13.subtitle: I don't give a damn about my reputation
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests13.title: Meet the Rocky Roller
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests14.descripti: This item seeks out the rarest creature in the world: the &eDevil's Hole Pupfish&r, a creature which spawns only in a single chunk, ever, in a given world.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests14.subtitle: Based on a true story
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests15.descripti: The &eSkelewag&r is a common mount for &eDrowned&r, and lives near Shipwrecks. It is a fearsome foe, but is worth defeating, as it can drop &bFish Bones&r, which allow the player to craft the &bStrange Fish Finder&r.
The &aSkelewag&r also has an exceptionally small chance at dropping the &bNovelty Hat&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests15.subtitle: Yarrr, something' be fishy
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests15.title: Meet the Skelewag
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests16.descripti: Should one happen upon an &eEndergrade&r - an extremophile living in the void of The End - they can place a saddle on its back. However, in order to control its extremely slow flight, a &bChorus Fruit on a Stick&r is needed.
They can be lured and bred with &bChorus Fruit&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests16.subtitle: Don't be tardi
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests17.descripti: The &eCapuchin Monkey&r is a friendly beast which can be tamed with &bBananas&r, which drop from Jungle Tree Leaves. They can be bred with &bMaggots&r, which drop from &eFlies&r, and healed with &bEggs&r.
These monkeys can also be told to &aperch on your shoulder&r, where they will throw items at your enemies. If you find a rare &bAncient Dart&r, you may give it to them to grant them extra damage.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests17.subtitle: Not to be confused with the delicious cappuchino monkey
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests17.title: Meet the Capuchin Monkey
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests18.descripti: A saddle which allows the player to ride a &eLavathian&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests18.subtitle: oh whoa, straddlite of love
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests19.descripti: The &eMimic Octopus&r is an incredible being that is found in &aWarm Oceans&r. They can be tamed with &bLobster Tails&r, at which point they will follow you and transform to try to scare off any enemies you may encounter.
Give your Octopus an &bInk Sac&r to toggle whether it can randomly change color.
Give it some &bPrismarine Shards&r to give it a Guardian-like appearance.
Give it a &bPufferfish&r if you'd like it to look like one of those, and hmm. I wonder what happens if you give one &bGunpowder&r?
Feed it some &bMimicream&r to teach it the abilities of whatever creature you've given it!
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests19.subtitle: Much nicer than the other kind of mimic
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests20.descripti: These beasts cannot be tamed, but they can be ridden.
Place a &bStraddlite Saddle&r and &bStraddlite Pack&r on their backs, and up to 4 players can ride these massive creatures.
They can be placed in water to &aharden into an obsidian variant&r, and can be &ahealed&r with &bMagma Cream&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests20.subtitle: Not to be confused with lavasioth
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests21.descripti: The &eSpectre&r is a ghostly creature that dwells in The End. It can be lured in with a &bSoul Heart&r (obtained from Vultures in the Nether), and leashed with a Lead, then ridden like a balloon.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests22.descripti: The &eFlutter&r is a passive mob which loves flowers.
It can be tamed if given some, but &deach flower must be a different type&r or it won't accept them.

cottagewitch.wildlife.quests64.descripti: The &eSlabfish&r is a rectangular entity which can be &atamed&r with &bTropical Fish&r.

&eSlabfish&r will toggle sitting or standing if you &6shift right click&r them.

cottagewitch.wildlife.quests65.descripti: Looking for a challenge? Why not craft yourself a &bGate Pearl&r? &dYou can craft any one you'd like for this quest&r.
A &bGate Pearl&r allows you to summon a &eGateway&r by using it on a block.There will need to be &asufficient space&r available, and &aanother Gateway cannot already be open&r.

An open Gateway will &dfail in a burst of lightning&r if it &acannot spawn a mob&r, any active &amob gets too far away&r, or the &awave timer&r elapses. Rewards will spawn from the Gateway as they are obtained.
These &eGateway&r provide a challenge for powerful players, and are a great source of &bMob Drops&r.
Additionally, some mobs which have been &dremoved for phobia reasons&r can be found only in Gatepearls. If you wish to encounter snakes or insects, the Gatepearl is the only way to find them!

cottagewitch.wildlife.quests68.descripti: The &bDimensional Carver&r is an item which can &atear through space&r to teleport you to &cyour spawn point&r. Aim it at the air and &6hold right click&r to use. Be aware that this is &dsomewhat unstable&r.
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests69.descripti: You can obtain the &bShattered Dimensional Carver&r by &aplacing a Dimensional Carver inside a &bCapsid block&r.
It will then slowly break down the Carver without untethering its pieces from one another. This is &astrange, very old magic&r.
The &bShattered Dimensional Carver&r can be used to teleport 1 million blocks in whichever direction you're facing. &aNormally one must do this 30 times&r to access the Farseers.
However, this is &dboth buggy and very hard on servers&r, so we recommend &dnot using the Carver as intended&r.
Instead, use it to craft a &bFarseer Gate Pearl&r, an item which brings all the luxury and delight of fighting &eFarseers&r, right to your doorstep!
cottagewitch.wildlife.quests70.descripti: The &bTransmutation Table&r is an item which will drain your &aexperience&r in exchange for &atransforming your items&r.

&6Press shift&r while hovering over the Pearl in your inventory to view information about the &acombat challenge&r. Good luck!

In the early days of the world, &eDucks&r swarmed the world, roving over rivers and quacking incessantly. It led to the &aGreat Duck War&r, in which witches wished wistfully for success against their foes. And killed a lot of ducks.

cottagewitch.wildlife.quests72.title: Hatching the Duck

cottagewitch.wildlife.quests90.descripti: These loveable fellows may not do much besides grunt and dance and sit pretty, but they happen to be my &dfavourite animal&r, and I require nothing more than their existence.

&eKākāpō&r, often called owl parrots, are nocturnal flightless parrots endemic to &cNew Zealand&r. These chubsters are some of the longest living birds on the planet- capable of living up to 100 years! Though they were &dnearly wiped out&r by the introduction of mammals to the island, there are many &aconservation efforts&r on nearby islands and they have recently been &asuccessfully reintroduced&r to the &cSanctuary Mountain Maungatautari&r on the mainland.

There are currently only &d247 living Kākāpō in existence&r. As such, they have been made &aincredibly scarce&r in the modpack here as well- being found only in the &cGuiana Shield&r biome. To increase your chances of finding this bird, &6try using the&r &bSummoning Ritual&r &6from&r &lArs Nouveau&r in a &cGuiana Shield&r.
If you are interested in the conservation of these precious creatures, you can learn more here: &9www.doc.govt.nz/kakapo-donate&r

cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description0: &lTom's Simple Storage&r is a mod which allows you to &aaccess all your inventory from a single interface&r. Who Tom was has been lost to legend, but his storage systems remain. &lSophisticated Storage&r is a storage solution with a focus on &aproviding lots of space in a small footprint&r. The two systems can work together!
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description1: To begin with, you'll need a &bStorage Terminal&r from &lTom's&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description2: Then, you need to make a choice between the &bInventory Connector&r from &lTom's&r, or a &bStorage Controller&r from &lSophisticated&r. Inventory Connectors work with both vanilla and Sophisticated containers, whereas &bStorage Controllers&r connect only to Sophisticated's containers. However, the remote capabilities of the &bStorage Controller&r are superior to those of the &bInventory Connector&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description3: This quest has multiple pages, &6please go to the next page&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description4: The &bInventory Connector&r and &bStorage Controller&r are blocks which act as a hub, connecting all touching storages to itself. &dAll touching storages are added to the network automatically&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description5: With the &bStorage Controller&r you can link distant storages using a &bStorage Link&r. You can do this with the &bInventory Connector&r as well, by utilizing the &bInventory Trim, or Inventory Cables and Cable Connectors&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description6: The &bStorage Terminal&r is the block which lets you see, deposit, and withdraw from your network. It can later be upgraded to a &bCrafting Terminal&r, which also allows you to craft from your inventory network.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description7: Here is an example of a &ahybrid Tom's and Sophisticated setup&r. As you can see, it &duses only inventory containers from&r &lSophisticated Storage&r, with the &bTom's Storage Terminal&r attached to the &bSophisticated's Storage Controller&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description8: The remote storages are connected via a &bStorage Link&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description9: This is an example of a &aTom's only&r setup, with vanilla containers (though it also supports containers from Sophisticated).
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.description10: The remote containers are hooked into the &bInventory Connector&r via &bCables&r and &bCable Connectors&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.subtitle: networking is important
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.tasks0.title: Any #forge:inventory_controllers
cottagewitch.wip.quests11.title: Network Interface
cottagewitch.wip.quests12.description0: The &bCrafting Grid&r, although more expensive, is a worthy upgrade because it allows you to &acraft from JEI or the Recipe Book&r using anything in your storage network.
cottagewitch.wip.quests12.subtitle: It's not just serious - it's terminal
cottagewitch.wip.quests13.description0: &bInventory Trim&r is an item which helps to fill in the gaps between connected inventories. As long as the Trim is touching both a valid inventory block, and a block in your system, it will connect all it touches to your network.
cottagewitch.wip.quests13.subtitle: Trim and tidy
cottagewitch.wip.quests14.description0: While &bInventory Trim&r is what the majority of people will use to connect their network, you can also do it with &bInventory Connectors&r and &bInventory Cables&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests14.description1: &6Place the Connectors on the blocks you wish&r, and then &6place the cabling between them&r.

cottagewitch.wip.quests14.tasks1.title: Any #forge:connector
cottagewitch.wip.quests14.title: Connected at a Distance
cottagewitch.wip.quests15.description0: The &bWireless Terminal&r is an incredibly useful item, as it allows you to access your inventory network remotely, at a &arange of 16 blocks&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests15.subtitle: We're going wireless
cottagewitch.wip.quests16.description0: The &bAdvanced Wireless Terminal&r not only extends the range of its previous version (64 blocks instead of 16), but can be made to have &ainfinite range&r if one &6places a level 1 beacon nearby&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests16.description1: If you should &6place a level 4 beacon nearby&r, then the signal can transmit &aacross dimensions&r as well!
cottagewitch.wip.quests16.description2: Can be &6worn as a Belt&r and &aaccessed via a hotkey&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests16.subtitle: A beacon of hope
cottagewitch.wip.quests17.description0: The &bInventory Proxy&r is a niche item which extends access to inventory blocks it's placed adjacent to. It specifically extends &athe face it's touching&r,
cottagewitch.wip.quests17.description1: This is useful in case your inventories are hard to access due to being inside an automation system, etc.
cottagewitch.wip.quests18.description0: The &bInventory Hopper&r imports and exports items from your network.
cottagewitch.wip.quests18.description1: &6Right click it with an item&r to set the filter. This is optional when importing, but required if exporting.
cottagewitch.wip.quests18.description2: &6Shift right click with an empty hand&r to clear the filter.
cottagewitch.wip.quests19.description0: The &bLevel Emitter&r transmits a redstone signal based on the contents of an inventory.
cottagewitch.wip.quests19.description1: The signal is based on whether the inventory contains &amore or less than the set amount&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests20.description0: &bFramed blocks&r are ones which can &atake on the appearance of another block&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests20.description1: Place your &bFramed Blocks&r in the world, then &6hold the Paint Kit and shift right click&r the block you want them to look like. Then &6right click the framed block&r with the paint kit, and voila!
cottagewitch.wip.quests20.subtitle: Don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious
cottagewitch.wip.quests20.title: Framed Blocks
cottagewitch.wip.quests21.description0: To begin your &acrabby journey&r, you will need a &bCrab Trap&r. Place it in the water and &afill it with bait&r to lure in creatures.
cottagewitch.wip.quests21.description1: You can use &bregular Fish&r as bait to obtain &bKelp and Nautilus Shells&r, but if you want to catch &eCrabs&r, &bClams&r, &bShrimp&r, or &bClawsters&r, you'll need &b&lChum&r&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests21.subtitle: it's a trap!
cottagewitch.wip.quests21.title: Beginner Crabbing
cottagewitch.wip.quests22.description0: &bSelenite&r can only be found in Geodes, located in &aJungle&r or &aSwamp&r Biomes. Selenite is a crystal with powerful purification properties.
cottagewitch.wip.quests22.description1: Selenite can be used to craft the &bNetherite Broom Tip&r, to brew into purifying &bMilk Bottles&r, or to &aclean stained glass&r.
cottagewitch.wip.quests22.subtitle: The power of positivity
cottagewitch.wip.quests23.title: Meet the Warped Toad
cottagewitch.wip.title: WIP
cottagewitch.botania.quests15.descriptio: The &aPure Daisy&r is one of the first flowers you'll create!
This flower will convert up to 8 nearby &2Wooden Logs&r or &9Stone&r into &2Livingwood&r or &9Livingrock&r, respectively. This only converts in a 1 block radius around the flower.
cottagewitch.botania.quests15.title: Our First Flower
cottagewitch.botania.quests16.descriptio: Use a &bPure Daisy&r to convert Stone into Livingrock!
cottagewitch.botania.quests16.title: &7Livingrock
cottagewitch.botania.quests17.descriptio: Use a &bPure Daisy&r to convert Wooden Logs into Livingwood!
cottagewitch.botania.quests17.title: &2Livingwood&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests18.descriptio: With our &bLivingrock&r we've created, we can now make the &9Mana Pool&r.

The Mana Pool is our storage for our Mana we generate. Once it has some mana stored inside, we can begin converting specific resources into Mana resources, like Manasteel, Mana Diamonds. To create these resources, throw the item into the pool with enough mana inside to convert the item.
To &bgenerate mana&r, you'll need to create a &2Generating Flower&r, like the &9Hydroangeas&r or the &cEndoflame&r.
Note: The Mana Pool stores a massive amount of mana. To see how much Mana is stored, try looking at one while holding the &2Wand of the Forest&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests18.title: &bMana&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests19.descriptio: By tossing in certain items into a &bMana Pool&r, you can infuse them with &9Mana&r.
To see how much mana is needed for the item, make sure to check the recipe in JEI!
Pro Tip: If you have enough mana, try creating Manasteel or Mana Diamond blocks to save time!
cottagewitch.botania.quests19.title: Creating Mana-Infused Resources
cottagewitch.botania.quests20.descriptio: &aBotania&r is a tech mod disguised as a magic mod, but with TONS of cool trinkets and toys to play with!
To start your journey in Botania, you'll need plenty of &9Mystical Flowers&r!
For more information on the items in the mod, make sure to check out the &aLexica Botania&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests20.title: Welcome to &aBotania&r!
cottagewitch.botania.quests21.descriptio: Now that we have some flowers, we can start converting the basic flora into functioning and generating flora using the &9Petal Apothecary&r!

To start harnessing the energy from Mystical Flower Petals, we will need to fill the Apothecary with &bWater&r. This can be done by right clicking with a water bucket, or by throwing the water bucket on the Apothecary.
To create items, just throw the appropriate items for the recipe into the Apothecary. Right clicking with an empty hand will remove items from it as well.
Once a recipe has been completed, you will have about 20 seconds where &aright clicking with an empty hand&r will refill the last recipe, making it easier to create multiple of the same items!
cottagewitch.botania.quests22.descriptio: You can make yourself some &aFloral Fertilizer&r which works like bone meal but for Botania Flowers!
cottagewitch.botania.quests23.descriptio: The &cEndoflame&r will absorb any combustible items or blocks dropped nearby, one at a time. It will then burn them to generate &bMana&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests23.title: &cBurning Items&r to Create Mana
cottagewitch.botania.quests24.descriptio: This is considered a miscellaneous flower that is used to measure if you are turning a profit or loss in your Mana Pools.
To do this, place the &dManastar&r next to a pool, and watch for the color of the flower to change. If it shines red, the pool is operating at a loss. If it shines blue, there is a profit!
cottagewitch.botania.quests28.descriptio: These flowers generate Mana by consuming &bWater Source Blocks&r in a 3x3 area around it. These are very slow, and will eventually decay.
Below is an example of a basic setup.
cottagewitch.botania.quests28.title: Using &9Water&r to Create Mana
cottagewitch.botania.quests63.descriptio: Found only in treasure chests, the &0Black Lotus&r can be thrown into a non-empty Mana Pool to give it a good deal of concentrated Mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests63.title: The Elusive Mana-infused Lotus
cottagewitch.botania.quests64.descriptio: The &2Mana Spreader&r is used to direct the flow of Mana by shooting out Mana Bursts.
You can set the direction that the Spreader shoots by binding it to a block using the &2Wand of the Forest&r. While holding the Wand, you can also see the mana buffer, as well as the Mana Bursts.
cottagewitch.botania.quests64.title: Directing Mana
cottagewitch.botania.quests65.descriptio: The &2Wand of the Forest&r is a must-have item if you want to continue your journey in Botania.
The wand has two modes: &aBind&r and &9Function&r.

&aBind mode&r is used to bind flowers and blocks together in Botania. Start by sneak-right clicking the first block or flower you want, then sneak-right click another block or flower to bind them together.
&9Function Mode&r essentially acts like a wrench, and is used to rotate blocks.
cottagewitch.botania.quests65.title: Botania's Wrench
cottagewitch.botania.quests66.descriptio: To upgrade the &2Mana Spreader&r, you can attach &9Mana Lenses&r to the front of the Spreader. However, the most basic Mana Lens does nothing.

You'll need to upgrade the Mana Lens to give it different effects on the bursts of Mana it sends out. Lenses can also be dyed by crafting it with any color, or with a Mana Pearl to create a Rainbow Lens.

By combining a Mana Lens with specific runes and items, we can use them to upgrade our Spreaders. You can also combine 2 lenses together with a &aSlime Ball&r to create &9Composite Lenses&r, combining the powers to create even stronger effects.
cottagewitch.botania.quests66.title: Upgrading Mana Spreaders
cottagewitch.botania.quests67.descriptio: The &bMana Splitter&r can be used as a way of splitting incoming Mana bursts into several Mana Pools at once.
&dSparks&r are used to transfer Mana to specific blocks, which are needed for in the progression of Botania.
To use a Spark, place one over a Mana Pool, then another over a nearby block that can accept it. Think of this like \"wirelessly\" transferring Mana from your Mana Pools to the desired nearby block.
To remove a Spark, sneak-right click it with a &2Wand of the Forest&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests67.title: Manipulating Mana Storage
cottagewitch.botania.quests68.descriptio: The &dAlchemy Catalyst&r can be placed under a &bMana Pool&r to allow it to perform &9Alchemy&r. This is useful to convert certain items into more useful items, like Rotten Flesh into Leather.
cottagewitch.botania.quests69.descriptio: Similar to the Alchemy Catalyst, when placed under a Mana Pool, the &9Conjuration Catalyst&r unlocks the abillity to use conjuration recipes.
cottagewitch.botania.quests70.descriptio: The &9Mana Tablet&r is a portable Mana Pool!
Tossing the tablet into a Mana Pool will allow it to either give or take Mana from the pool. You can switch between the modes by sneak-right clicking with a &2Wand of the Forest&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests70.title: Transferring Mana from Pools
cottagewitch.botania.quests71.descriptio: The &9Band of Mana&r is a wearable Mana Tablet that can be equipped like a trinket.
cottagewitch.botania.quests72.descriptio: By upgrading the Band of Mana with an ingot of Terrasteel, it creates the &dGreater Band of Mana&r which allows it to hold up to 4x the amount of mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests73.descriptio: By upgrading the Band of Aura with an ingot of Terrasteel, it increases the mana generation rate of the band significantly.
cottagewitch.botania.quests74.descriptio: When equipped, the &9Band of Aura&r will slowly generate a trickle of Mana over time, and stores it into Mana-containing items within your inventory.
cottagewitch.botania.quests75.descriptio: While the &bManaweave Robes&r don't offer the greatest overall protection, the set bonus is pretty powerful!
When all four pieces are worn, you'll get a discount on Mana cost for mana tools and rods. The set can also repair itself using Mana from one's inventory.
cottagewitch.botania.quests75.title: Manaweave Robes
cottagewitch.botania.quests76.descriptio: Similar to the qualities of Iron, &9Manasteel Armor&r has superior enchantability and durability. Manasteel items can also repair themselves with Mana from the user's inventory.
cottagewitch.botania.quests76.title: Manasteel Armor
cottagewitch.botania.quests83.descriptio: Just like Manasteel armor, &aTerrasteel Armor&r can repair itself using Mana. It has the durability comparable to Diamond armor as well.
cottagewitch.botania.quests85.descriptio: Using Mana, the &2Terra Truncator&r will feel entire trees in one fell swoop.
cottagewitch.botania.quests86.descriptio: With the damage of a Diamond Sword, the &2Terra Blade&r will sometimes fire a beam that will deal as much as a melee hit would.
cottagewitch.botania.quests88.descriptio: It's not just a pickaxe, the &9Terra Shatterer&r also acts just like a Mana Tablet when tossed into a Mana Pool and can store a ton of mana. However, you will not be able to release the absorbed mana from the Shatterer.
The higher the amount of Mana stored in the tool, the higher the rank that it has, with D being the lowest and SS being the highest.

Increasing the tool's rank does not increase the speed of it, but instead increases the AoE of its &bActive Ability&r, which can be toggled on and off by sneak-right clicking. When active, it increases the Shatterer's mining width and height based on the rank. Being at a rank of D will not have an ability.
Note: As long as the tool is active, it will consume its stored mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests90.descriptio: Tired of using a shovel to level out grass? Try using the &2Rod of Terra Firma&r!
At the cost of Mana, this will flatten the surrounding land to your own altitude by charging up the rod by holding right click.
Note: Blocks removed by the rod are not recoverable.
cottagewitch.botania.quests90.title: Flattening the Land
cottagewitch.botania.quests91.descriptio: &9Runes&r are vital crafting components in many of the more advanced recipes in Botania, and these are created on a &aRunic Altar&r.

To use the Altar, start by placing the components of the rune you want on it. This can be done either by right clicking or dropping the item. It will also need Mana, so make sure to point a Mana Spreader that is getting Mana towards it as well.

Once you've finished placing the items, you can hover over the Altar with your wand and it will show you the progress of the recipe. When it completes, drop a piece of Livingrock on the Altar, then use your wand to collect your rune.

Note: Runes used for recipes in the Runic Altar function as catalysts, and will not be consumed. Just like the Petal Apothecary, right-clicking the Altar with an empty hand after a recipe is complete will refill it with the items used in the last recipe.
cottagewitch.botania.quests91.title: Creating Runes
cottagewitch.botania.quests92.descriptio: Using vials, Mana, and reagents in a &aBotanical Brewery&r, you can create &9Brews&r which are just like Potions.
cottagewitch.botania.quests93.descriptio: &2Incense Sticks&r can be infused with Brews in a Botanical Brewery. These can be lit using flint and steel on an &9Incense Plate&r to provide the brew effect for sixty times longer than its liquid counterpart, in a 30-block radius around the plate.
cottagewitch.botania.quests94.descriptio: To create &aTerrasteel&r, we'll first need to set up the multiblock for it. The first part of this is crafting the &9Terrasteel Agglomeration Plate&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests94.title: Creating More Powerful Ingots
cottagewitch.botania.quests95.descriptio: Now it's time to create our platform for the &9T.A. Plate&r so we can make &aTerrasteel&r!

To create the platform, you'll need to place 5 pieces of Livingrock and 4 Blocks of Lapis in a checkerboard pattern, like in the image below. Place the plate on the center Livingrock block, and the platform will be complete!
Terrasteel needs a lot of Mana to craft, requiring the use of &9Sparks&r. Place several Sparks over your Mana Pools, then one over the T.A. Plate to direct your mana for crafting.
Once you have the platform ready for crafting, toss one Manasteel Ingot, Mana Diamond, and a Mana Pearl on the plate to start crafting Terrasteel.
cottagewitch.botania.quests95.title: &aCreating&r &dTerrasteel&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests96.descriptio: With the new Elven materials, we're able to upgrade our sparks using &dAugments&r. With the Augment in hand, you can right click a spark with it to upgrade it. Using the wand, you can sneak-right click to remove it.
Dispersive Augment: Allows a Spark to drain the Mana in its pool to charge nearby players' Mana-containing items.
Dominant Augment: Makes a Spark pull Mana from nearby non-augmented Sparks' pools into its own.
Recessive Augment: Makes a Spark distribute all of the Mana in its pool into nearby non-augmented or Dispersive Sparks' pools.
Isolated Augment: Prevents a Spark from interacting with any Dominant or Recessive Sparks.
cottagewitch.botania.quests96.title: Spark Augments
cottagewitch.botania.quests97.descriptio: While you may not be able to enter the &dPortal to Alfheim&r, you can perform an &2Elven Trade&r by tossing in certain items through the portal. This does use mana for each trade! These materials can also be used to upgrade some of your items, like creating &2Elven Mana Spreaders&r.
Throwing in our &aLexica Botania&r will also upgrade it with &6Elven Knowledge&r, giving you more insight into your journey in Botania.
cottagewitch.botania.quests97.title: Communing with Elves
cottagewitch.botania.quests98.descriptio: To create a &dPortal to Alfheim&r, start with the frame. We'll need to use 8 Livingwood blocks, 3 Glimmering Livingwood blocks, and an &9Elven Gateway Core&r to create the frame.

Once the frame is created, we'll need to open it by using at least &d2 Mana Pools&r, a huge amount of mana, and a &aNatura Pylon&r over the 2 pools. These mana pools can be within an 11x11x11 area around the core.
With everything set up, right click the Elven Core with your wand to activate the portal.

Note: Even though the Mana Pools need a large amount of Mana to activate the portal, activating the portal does not cost Mana itself. However, converting materials over will use a little each time. If there is not enough mana, the portal will close.
You can also use the &aLexica Botania&r to help you build it.
cottagewitch.botania.quests98.title: Opening the Portal
cottagewitch.botania.quests99.descriptio: To continue your journey, you will need to get your hands on &6Gaia Spirits&r. To do this, you will need to perform the &9Ritual of Gaia&r.

You will need 4 Gaia Pylons around an &aActive Beacon&r, as well as a single Terrasteel ingot. Once the structure is built, sneak-right click the Beacon with the Terrasteel ingot and prepare for the fight of your life.
If you need help with building the structure, you can always use the &aLexica Botania&r to help you build it. Look for the &9Ritual of Gaia&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests99.title: &aSummoning the&r &5Guardian of Gaia&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests100.descripti: Just like most armor in Botania, the &9Elementium&r set can repair itself with mana.
It also has a chance to spawn a &aPixie&r whenever the wearer is harmed.
cottagewitch.botania.quests101.descripti: Has an ability to clear away Cobblestone, Dirt, Netherrack, and other common materials, leaving behind only ores and fine resources.
Can combine with the Terra Shatterer in a crafting grid, which will allow the latter to take on the former's power. This cannot be undone.
cottagewitch.botania.quests102.descripti: When breaking a block that is affected by gravity, this will auto-break all blocks above or below it.
cottagewitch.botania.quests103.descripti: Can drop skulls from certain mobs or players when dealing the finishing blow. Can also be enchanted with Looting.
cottagewitch.botania.quests104.descripti: Instantly moisten farmland it creates. Do we know if there is a better word for that?
cottagewitch.botania.quests105.descripti: Increases the chance of a Pixie spawning when hit, and augments the strength of any Pixies that are spawned.
cottagewitch.botania.quests107.descripti: Combining an &2Elven Mana Spreader&r with the power of Dragonstones and a &6Gaia Spirit&r creates the best Mana Spreader you can get.
cottagewitch.botania.quests108.descripti: Upon defeating the &9Guardian of Gaia&r, you'll be rewarded with &6Gaia Spirits&r.
Both the game difficulty and the number of people participating in the ritual determine the amount of drops you will receive.
cottagewitch.botania.quests108.title: &6Gaia Spirits&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests109.descripti: Want more of a challenge, or need more &6Gaia Spirits&r from the fight? Try combining 4 Gaia Spirits with a Terrasteel ingot, and use that to activate the Ritual of Gaia. :)
cottagewitch.botania.quests109.title: &5Guardian of Gaia 2.0&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests110.descripti: Using Gaia Ingots to summon the harder version of the &5Guardian of Gaia&r will get you more &6Gaia Spirits&r, but the Guardian can also drop the &6Dice of Fate&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests110.title: &6Dice of Fate&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests111.descripti: The &9Corporea Funnel&r is a simple version of the Index, and can be used to request items from the Network by giving it a redstone signal.

To tell the Funnel which item to request, place the item in an Item Frame on the block. If the Funnel has more than one item frame on it, the Funnel will pick one at random. Rotating the item in the frame will change the request quantity.
For more information, make sure to check out the &aLexica Botania&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests112.descripti: With Botania, you can create a &dCorporea Network&r by using &9Corporea Sparks&r over inventories.

While the network will need at least one &bMaster&r &9Corporea Spark&r to work, you can expand the network with as many Corporea Sparks as you want. When these Sparks are placed, it will connect to all of the same colored Corporea Sparks and form an item network. Each Spark only has a range of 8 blocks.

These Sparks can only see the inventory directly beneath it, but can only access items from its top side. Each Spark can also see every item in the Corporea network, and can be accessed by other Corporea blocks, like the Funnel or Index.
cottagewitch.botania.quests112.title: &dThe Corporea Network&r
cottagewitch.botania.quests113.descripti: The &5Corporea Index&r is the interface block you need to access and request items from the &9Corporea Network&r of the Corporea Spark placed above it.

To use this, approach the Index and it will intercept Chat Messages from nearby players. These players can request items from the network by typing in what they are looking to get. For example, you could say &b10 Iron Ingots&r, and if the system has it, it will drop it out for you.
For more information, you can always check your &aLexica Botania&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests114.descripti: The &9Corporea Crystal Cube&r is used to show the total count of an item in the Corporea Network of the Spark placed above it by right clicking it with that item.
cottagewitch.botania.quests121.descripti: Using the Petal Apothecary, we can create several different types of flowers that can help us on our journey, and these are broken down into two different categories: &9Functional Flowers&r and &aGenerating Flowers&r.

&9Functional Flowers&r are flowers that help you with everyday tasks. For example, the &7Hopperhock&r will function like a hopper, and pick up items within a certain range around it. Some of the Functional Flowers will require &dMana&r to operate.

&aGenerating Flowers&r are flowers that produce &dMana&r using different methods, depending on the flower. The most common flower used to generate mana is the &cEndoflame&r, which generates Mana by consuming nearby combustible like coal.

In this questline, Flowers with the quest shape of a &cSquare&r are Generating Flowers, where as flowers with the shape of a &9Circle&r are Functional Flowers. You can also find out what each flower does by using the &aLexica Botania&r.
cottagewitch.botania.quests121.title: Functional And Generating Flora
cottagewitch.botania.quests122.descripti: When you combine a piece of &4Redstone&r with a &2Mana Spreader&r, it creates a &9Pulse Mana Spreader&r.
These can be controlled to only shoot a mana pulse when given a redstone pulse.
cottagewitch.botania.quests123.descripti: Dramatically increases the speed of the Mana Bursts at the expense of initial capacity and faster mana loss.
cottagewitch.botania.quests124.descripti: Doubles the amount of Mana a Mana Burst can carry, at the cost of speed and increased mana loss over longer distances.
cottagewitch.botania.quests125.descripti: Significantly increases the amount of time a Mana Burst can go without starting to lose Mana, but slows it down as well.
cottagewitch.botania.quests126.descripti: Decreases the amount of time that it takes for a Mana Burst to start losing its Mana, but will also decrease its rate of loss.
cottagewitch.botania.quests127.descripti: Allows Mana Bursts to bounce off of walls.
cottagewitch.botania.quests128.descripti: Makes gravity affect a Mana Burst, making it move in an arc. It also slightly increases the time before it starts to lose mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests129.descripti: Allows Mana Bursts to break through blocks by using its own mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests130.descripti: Allows Mana Bursts to use its own mana to damage any living being it hits.
cottagewitch.botania.quests131.descripti: This lens allows a Mana Burst to pass through blocks, while decreasing the amount of time it can survive without losing mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests132.descripti: Allows a Mana Burst to home in on any nearby blocks that can receive Mana. This also slightly decreases the speed of the burst.
cottagewitch.botania.quests133.descripti: Imbues a Mana Burst with entropic forces, or in simple terms, turns it into a bomb when it hits something that can't receive Mana.
cottagewitch.botania.quests134.descripti: Allows a Mana Burst to influence nearby dropped items, experience orbs, and falling blocks, having them move in the exact same vector of the motion as the burst itself.
cottagewitch.botania.quests135.descripti: When a block is hit by a Mana Burst from this lens, the block will fall as if it were Sand or Gravel.
cottagewitch.botania.quests136.descripti: Needs to be dyed with a color first.
Allows the Mana Bursts to paint any colorable block it hits, as well as any colorable block it is connected to. It also works on sheep.
cottagewitch.botania.quests137.descripti: Allows the Mana Bursts to launch festive fireworks when they hit a block.
cottagewitch.botania.quests138.descripti: This converts the Mana Spreader's bursts to only fire a continuous particle rather than short bursts. No mana is consumed. Great for decorative uses.
cottagewitch.botania.quests139.descripti: Using this on a Spreader will cause it to only fire a Mana Burst only if it can hit a mob or player.
cottagewitch.botania.quests140.descripti: Greatly decreases the amount of Mana a Mana Burst carries and dramatically increases the burst's speed and distance.
cottagewitch.botania.quests141.descripti: This lens will redirect any Mana Spreaders or entities it collides with to face towards teh block or entity that fired the burst.
cottagewitch.botania.quests142.descripti: Causes the Mana Burst to create flame on the block it hits. This flame provides light and is purely decorative. It can be put out by using another Mana Burst on it.
cottagewitch.botania.quests143.descripti: Allows the Mana Burst to move a block just as if a piston would.
cottagewitch.botania.quests144.descripti: Allows the Mana Burst to catch blocks on fire. It will not work on living beings.
cottagewitch.botania.quests145.descripti: Refer to the &aLexica Botania&r on how to use this lens.
